# file opened: zpolice.asm
   1  0000              ;==============================================================================
   2  0000              ; Z-POLICE  -  3D vector city flight for the ZX Spectrum Next
   3  0000              ;
   4  0000              ;  Z80N assembler (sjasmplus --zxnext).  Layer 2 256x192x8bpp, double buffered.
   5  0000              ;  The 3D viewport is the top 256x128; the bottom third is an instrument panel.
   6  0000              ;  Maths: world positions are 16-bit integers (one city cell = 256 units),
   7  0000              ;         trig values are S7.8 fixed point (1.0 = $0100).
   8  0000              ;  Hidden line removal: painter's algorithm. Buildings are walked over the
   9  0000              ;  grid far-to-near (no sort needed). Each visible face is filled in its
  10  0000              ;  shade (roof lighter, side turned away darker) and optionally outlined, so
  11  0000              ;  nearer buildings overwrite those behind them. Faces with every corner on
  12  0000              ;  screen use cached projections; faces crossing the view frustum are
  13  0000              ;  clipped in 3D (Sutherland-Hodgman, 5 planes). Rasterisation then only
  14  0000              ;  ever sees on-screen 8-bit coordinates.
  15  0000              ;
  16  0000              ;  Controls: Q/A speed up/down   Z air brake O/P turn left/right
  17  0000              ;            W/S climb/descend   E/D nose up/down
  18  0000              ;            SPACE fire          1-5 select weapon slot
  19  0000              ;            0 change the centre slot's weapon
  20  0000              ;
  21  0000              ;  Source files: zpolice.asm (resident main code), memory_bank_defs.asm
  22  0000              ;  (slots and pages).  Game logic pages, swapped into slot 6 at $C000:
  23  0000              ;  player.asm (input/movement), weapons.asm, menu.asm (main menu).  Core
  24  0000              ;  function pages, swapped into slot 7 at $E000: city.asm (Layer 2
  25  0000              ;  drawing), hud.asm (ULA HUD), input.asm (redefinable keys, joysticks), sprites.asm
  26  0000              ;  (hardware sprites).  Always mapped: zombie.asm at $2000, human.asm and
  27  0000              ;  map.asm (the city map) at $7000.
  28  0000              ;
  29  0000              ;  Memory while running:
  30  0000              ;    $0000-$1FFF  Layer 2 back buffer, one 8K section at a time (slot 0)
  31  0000              ;    $2000-$3FFF  zombie page (slot 1)
  32  0000              ;    $4000-$7FFF  occlusion data; cell colours, humans, map (slots 2-3)
  33  0000              ;    $8000-$9FFF  ULA screen (slot 4)
  34  0000              ;    $A000-$BFFF  resident code, tables, variables, stack (slot 5)
  35  0000              ;    $C000-$DFFF  game logic page (slot 6)
  36  0000              ;    $E000-$FFFF  core function page (slot 7)
  37  0000              ;==============================================================================
  38  0000
  39  0000                      DEVICE ZXSPECTRUMNEXT
  40  0000                      SLDOPT COMMENT WPMEM, LOGPOINT, ASSERTION
  41  0000                  IFDEF RELEASE
  42  0000 ~                    CSPECTMAP "release_tmp/zpolice.map"
  43  0000                  ELSE
  44  0000                      CSPECTMAP zpolice.map
  45  0000                  ENDIF
  46  0000                      OPT --zxnext=cspect --syntax=a --reversepop
  47  0000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  48  0000              ; Build options
  49  0000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  50  0000              ; RELEASE: the build for players (-DRELEASE: build.bat release).  Turns off
  51  0000              ; everything for testing, whatever is set below: the DEBUG_ settings, DRAW_FPS
  52  0000              ; and DOTS_ALL, a START_LEVEL_SET, a START_SALVAGE.  It's assembled into
  53  0000              ; release_tmp/, so the debug build's files (and the tests') stay as they are.
  54  0000
  55  0000              ; REAL_HARDWARE: the build for a real Next (-DREAL_HARDWARE: build.bat
  56  0000              ; hardware), which may use DMA+ (the zxnDDMA, the blitter of core 3.03.00, see
  57  0000              ; layer2_cls.asm).  Off, the DMA routines use only the plain zxnDMA, as CSpect
  58  0000              ; doesn't have DMA+ yet.  The .nex then also asks for core 3.03.00: on an older
  59  0000              ; core DMA+'s commands would be misread, not ignored.
  60  0000                      ;DEFINE REAL_HARDWARE
  61  0000                  IFDEF REAL_HARDWARE                 ; (said in the build's output)
  62  0000 ~                    DISPLAY "REAL_HARDWARE set: the build for a real Next (DMA+, core 3.03.00 or later)"
  63  0000                  ELSE
  64  0000                      DISPLAY "REAL_HARDWARE not set: the CSpect build (plain zxnDMA, no DMA+)"
  65  0000                  ENDIF
  66  0000
  67  0000              ; DRAW_LINES: outline building faces with EDGE_COL vectors.  Comment it out for solid-colour buildings only; the HUD
  68  0000              ; is always drawn.  Can also be set from the command line: -DDRAW_LINES
  69  0000                      ;DEFINE DRAW_LINES
  70  0000
  71  0000              ; WAIT_FOR_VBLANK: wait for the raster to leave the display area before
  72  0000              ; flipping the Layer 2 buffers (no tearing).  Comment it out to flip as soon
  73  0000              ; as a frame is drawn: faster, but the flip may tear mid-screen.
  74  0000              ; Command line: -DWAIT_FOR_VBLANK
  75  0000                      ;DEFINE WAIT_FOR_VBLANK
  76  0000
  77  0000              ; DRAW_FPS: measure frames per second from the raster (vtick) and show it at
  78  0000              ; the top left of the ULA screen.  Comment it out to drop the measuring and
  79  0000              ; the display.  Command line: -DDRAW_FPS
  80  0000                      ;DEFINE DRAW_FPS
  81  0000
  82  0000              ; SKY_IS_WALL: the camera can never rise above the perimeter wall, so fill
  83  0000              ; the sky in the wall's colour and draw wall cells only up to camera height
  84  0000              ; (their top edge is then exactly the horizon).  No sky is ever seen.
  85  0000              ; Command line: -DSKY_IS_WALL
  86  0000                      DEFINE SKY_IS_WALL
  87  0000
  88  0000              ; OCCLUSION_CULL: in level flight, record the buildings, then cull those
  89  0000              ; completely hidden behind nearer ones (a per-column cover buffer, front to
  90  0000              ; back) before drawing the rest.  Uses pages PAGE_OCC0/1 at $4000-$7FFF.
  91  0000              ; Command line: -DOCCLUSION_CULL
  92  0000                      DEFINE OCCLUSION_CULL
  93  0000
  94  0000              ; OCC_PITCHED: OCCLUSION_CULL pitched too, up to OCC_PMAX (18, city2.asm;
  95  0000              ; past it the plain way).  Pitched, occ_pretest has bounds of its own
  96  0000              ; (occ_pretest.pit), and a building covers only the columns of both its top
  97  0000              ; and bottom corners (its vertical edges lean).  Pixel-identical (124 random
  98  0000              ; pitched views; test_render.py checks 16 against the painter's path).
  99  0000              ; Comment it out for level flight only.  Command line: -DOCC_PITCHED
 100  0000                      DEFINE OCC_PITCHED
 101  0000
 102  0000              ; LEVEL_FAST_PATH: while pitch is 0 (level flight) a building's top corners
 103  0000              ; have the same camera X and Z as the bottom corners below them, so each top
 104  0000              ; corner reuses its bottom corner's screen x and 1/Z and only works out its
 105  0000              ; screen y.  Comment it out to project every corner in full.
 106  0000              ; Command line: -DLEVEL_FAST_PATH
 107  0000                      DEFINE LEVEL_FAST_PATH
 108  0000
 109  0000              ; CLIP_2D: a face that crosses only the screen's sides, top or bottom, and is
 110  0000              ; within a guard band (|X| <= 2Z, |Y| <= Z), has its corners projected to
 111  0000              ; 16-bit screen coordinates and is clipped against the screen in 2D, not in
 112  0000              ; 3D (no new points to project, one multiply per new point, not three).
 113  0000              ; Faces crossing the near plane, or outside the guard band, are clipped in
 114  0000              ; 3D as before.  Comment it out to clip every face in 3D.
 115  0000              ; Command line: -DCLIP_2D
 116  0000                      DEFINE CLIP_2D
 117  0000
 118  0000                  IFDEF RELEASE
 119  0000 ~                  IFDEF DRAW_FPS
 120  0000 ~                    UNDEFINE DRAW_FPS
 121  0000 ~                  ENDIF
 122  0000 ~                  IFDEF DOTS_ALL
 123  0000 ~                    UNDEFINE DOTS_ALL
 124  0000 ~                  ENDIF
 125  0000 ~                  IFDEF START_LEVEL_SET
 126  0000 ~                    UNDEFINE START_LEVEL_SET
 127  0000 ~                  ENDIF
 128  0000                  ENDIF

# file opened: memory_bank_defs.asm
   1+ 0000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ 0000              ; Z-POLICE - memory bank definitions
   3+ 0000              ;
   4+ 0000              ; The Next maps its RAM into the Z80's 64K as eight 8K MMU slots, each set by
   5+ 0000              ; a NextReg ($50-$57) to an 8K page (page n = half of 16K bank n/2).  This
   6+ 0000              ; file names the slots, their registers and addresses, what each slot is
   7+ 0000              ; used for, and which page holds what.  Use:
   8+ 0000              ;   nextreg CODE_MMU,PAGE_CITY            ; page the city code in at $E000
   9+ 0000              ;   MMU CODE_SLOT e, PAGE_CITY, CODE_ADDR ; (sjasmplus) assemble into it
  10+ 0000              ;
  11+ 0000              ; Memory map (see README.md):
  12+ 0000              ;   slot 0 $0000  Layer 2 sections (32 rows each) while drawing; the sine
  13+ 0000              ;                 table (PAGE_SIN) whenever get_sin reads it
  14+ 0000              ;   slot 1 $2000  zombie page, always mapped: zombies, humans, the HUD
  15+ 0000              ;                 map, the IM 2 table
  16+ 0000              ;   slot 2 $4000  occlusion data; the 320x256 graphics (PAGE_L320) on the
  17+ 0000              ;                 screens outside the game
  18+ 0000              ;   slot 3 $6000  the city bank (always mapped): city_col at $6000,
  19+ 0000              ;                 city_map at $7000, loaded from the level's city file
  20+ 0000              ;   slot 4 $8000  ULA screen (page 10, the first half of bank 5)
  21+ 0000              ;   slot 5 $A000  resident main code, variables, stack (page 11, the unused
  22+ 0000              ;                 second half of bank 5)
  23+ 0000              ;   slot 6 $C000  game logic pages, swapped: player, weapons, menus, level
  24+ 0000              ;                 loading
  25+ 0000              ;   slot 7 $E000  core function pages, swapped: city (Layer 2 drawing), HUD,
  26+ 0000              ;                 keys, sprites; a sprite bank while it is loaded; the
  27+ 0000              ;                 start-up set-up (initialise.asm) once
  28+ 0000              ; So game logic in slot 6 can call any core page in slot 7: main_loop pages
  29+ 0000              ; the keys in at $E000 while the player and weapons pages run at $C000.
  30+ 0000              ; At start-up the NEX loader's default mapping is in place (slot 6 = page
  31+ 0000              ; 0), so the entry point is a stub in PAGE_BOOT at $C000 (boot, zpolice.asm)
  32+ 0000              ; that maps the resident page into slot 5 and jumps to start.
  33+ 0000              ;==============================================================================
  34+ 0000
  35+ 0000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  36+ 0000              ; MMU slots: number, NextReg, address
  37+ 0000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  38+ 0000              MEMBANK_SIZE            equ $2000       ; 8K a slot / page
  39+ 0000
  40+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_0              equ 0
  41+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_1              equ 1
  42+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_2              equ 2
  43+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_3              equ 3
  44+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_4              equ 4
  45+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_5              equ 5
  46+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_6              equ 6
  47+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_7              equ 7
  48+ 0000
  49+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_0_REGISTER     equ $50
  50+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_1_REGISTER     equ $51
  51+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_2_REGISTER     equ $52
  52+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_3_REGISTER     equ $53
  53+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_4_REGISTER     equ $54
  54+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_5_REGISTER     equ $55
  55+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_6_REGISTER     equ $56
  56+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_7_REGISTER     equ $57
  57+ 0000
  58+ 0000              membank0                equ $0000
  59+ 0000              membank1                equ $2000
  60+ 0000              membank2                equ $4000
  61+ 0000              membank3                equ $6000
  62+ 0000              membank4                equ $8000
  63+ 0000              membank5                equ $A000
  64+ 0000              membank6                equ $C000
  65+ 0000              membank7                equ $E000
  66+ 0000
  67+ 0000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  68+ 0000              ; What each slot is used for: <use>_SLOT, <use>_MMU (its NextReg) and
  69+ 0000              ; <use>_ADDR (the ORG of code or data assembled for it)
  70+ 0000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  71+ 0000              ; slot 0: one 32-row section of a Layer 2 buffer at a time (seg_map etc.)
  72+ 0000              L2SEC_SLOT              equ MMU_SLOT_0
  73+ 0000              L2SEC_MMU               equ MMU_SLOT_0_REGISTER
  74+ 0000              L2SEC_ADDR              equ membank0
  75+ 0000              ; slot 0 also: the sine table, paged in by get_sin (resident).  Only the
  76+ 0000              ; game logic calls it, never the drawing, and every Layer 2 writer maps its
  77+ 0000              ; own section first, so the two never meet.  Nothing may write to
  78+ 0000              ; $0000-$1FFF while it is mapped.
  79+ 0000              SIN_SLOT                equ MMU_SLOT_0
  80+ 0000              SIN_MMU                 equ MMU_SLOT_0_REGISTER
  81+ 0000              SIN_ADDR                equ membank0
  82+ 0000
  83+ 0000              ; slot 1: zombie.asm, human.asm, map.asm, interrupts.asm, always mapped
  84+ 0000              ZOMBIE_SLOT             equ MMU_SLOT_1
  85+ 0000              ZOMBIE_MMU              equ MMU_SLOT_1_REGISTER
  86+ 0000              ZOMBIE_ADDR             equ membank1
  87+ 0000
  88+ 0000              ; slot 2: occlusion buffer, draw list and building records (OCCLUSION_CULL)
  89+ 0000              OCC_SLOT                equ MMU_SLOT_2
  90+ 0000              OCC_MMU                 equ MMU_SLOT_2_REGISTER
  91+ 0000              OCC_ADDR                equ membank2
  92+ 0000              ; slot 2 also: the 320x256 Layer 2 graphics (layer2-320x256.asm), for the
  93+ 0000              ; screens outside the game (menus, load-out, level complete, game over),
  94+ 0000              ; which never draw the city.  The occlusion page goes back before the game
  95+ 0000              ; (l2_game_mode).
  96+ 0000              L320_SLOT               equ MMU_SLOT_2
  97+ 0000              L320_MMU                equ MMU_SLOT_2_REGISTER
  98+ 0000              L320_ADDR               equ membank2
  99+ 0000
 100+ 0000              ; slot 3: the city bank, always mapped: city_col at $6000, city_map at
 101+ 0000              ; $7000, read from the level's city file (level_load.asm) in one go
 102+ 0000              TABLES_SLOT             equ MMU_SLOT_3
 103+ 0000              TABLES_MMU              equ MMU_SLOT_3_REGISTER
 104+ 0000              TABLES_ADDR             equ membank3            ; city_col
 105+ 0000              CITYMAP_ADDR            equ membank3+$1000      ; city_map
 106+ 0000
 107+ 0000              ; slot 4: the ULA screen (bank 5's first 8K: bitmap and attributes)
 108+ 0000              ULA_SLOT                equ MMU_SLOT_4
 109+ 0000              ULA_MMU                 equ MMU_SLOT_4_REGISTER
 110+ 0000              ULA_ADDR                equ membank4
 111+ 0000              ; slot 4 also: the second city page (city2.asm), over the ULA screen while
 112+ 0000              ; main_loop draws the city (nothing then uses the ULA screen)
 113+ 0000              CITY2_SLOT              equ MMU_SLOT_4
 114+ 0000              CITY2_MMU               equ MMU_SLOT_4_REGISTER
 115+ 0000              CITY2_ADDR              equ membank4
 116+ 0000
 117+ 0000              ; slot 5: resident main code (zpolice.asm), tables, variables, stack
 118+ 0000              MAIN_SLOT               equ MMU_SLOT_5
 119+ 0000              MAIN_MMU                equ MMU_SLOT_5_REGISTER
 120+ 0000              MAIN_ADDR               equ membank5
 121+ 0000
 122+ 0000              ; slot 6: game logic pages, swapped (player, weapons, menu)
 123+ 0000              LOGIC_SLOT              equ MMU_SLOT_6
 124+ 0000              LOGIC_MMU               equ MMU_SLOT_6_REGISTER
 125+ 0000              LOGIC_ADDR              equ membank6
 126+ 0000              ; slot 6 at start-up: the boot stub (the NEX loader maps page 0 there)
 127+ 0000              BOOT_SLOT               equ MMU_SLOT_6
 128+ 0000              BOOT_ADDR               equ membank6
 129+ 0000
 130+ 0000              ; slot 7: core function pages, swapped (city / Layer 2, HUD, keys, sprites)
 131+ 0000              CODE_SLOT               equ MMU_SLOT_7
 132+ 0000              CODE_MMU                equ MMU_SLOT_7_REGISTER
 133+ 0000              CODE_ADDR               equ membank7
 134+ 0000              ; slot 7 also: a sprite pattern bank (sprite_data.asm), paged in to run
 135+ 0000              ; its own loader, spr_load_bank
 136+ 0000              SPRBANK_SLOT            equ MMU_SLOT_7
 137+ 0000              SPRBANK_MMU             equ MMU_SLOT_7_REGISTER
 138+ 0000              SPRBANK_ADDR            equ membank7
 139+ 0000
 140+ 0000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 141+ 0000              ; 8K pages
 142+ 0000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 143+ 0000              PAGE_BOOT               equ 0           ; the NEX entry stub (slot 6 at load)
 144+ 0000              PAGE_CITY               equ 1           ; city.asm: Layer 2 drawing (slot 7)
 145+ 0000              PAGE_HUD                equ 2           ; hud.asm: ULA (Layer 1) HUD (slot 7)
 146+ 0000              PAGE_PLAYER             equ 3           ; player.asm: input, movement,
 147+ 0000                                                      ; collision (slot 6)
 148+ 0000              PAGE_WEAPONS            equ 4           ; weapons.asm: player weapons (slot 6)
 149+ 0000              PAGE_ZOMBIE             equ 5           ; zombie.asm (slot 1, always)
 150+ 0000              PAGE_OCC0               equ 6           ; occlusion buffer, draw list and
 151+ 0000                                                      ; building records (slot 2)
 152+ 0000              PAGE_OCC1               equ 7           ; the city bank: city_col and
 153+ 0000                                                      ; city_map (slot 3, always)
 154+ 0000              PAGE_MENU               equ 8           ; menu.asm: game over, game complete,
 155+ 0000                                                      ; the load error (slot 6)
 156+ 0000              PAGE_SPR0               equ 9           ; sprite_data.asm: sprite pattern
 157+ 0000                                                      ; bank 0 (slot 7 while loading);
 158+ 0000                                                      ; more banks: the next free pages
 159+ 0000              PAGE_ULA0               equ 10          ; the ULA screen, bank 5 (slot 4)
 160+ 0000              PAGE_MAIN               equ 11          ; zpolice.asm, resident (slot 5): the
 161+ 0000                                                      ; second half of bank 5
 162+ 0000              PAGE_INPUT              equ 12          ; input.asm: keyboard, joysticks (slot 7)
 163+ 0000              PAGE_SPRITES            equ 13          ; sprites.asm: hardware sprites
 164+ 0000                                                      ; (slot 7)
 165+ 0000              PAGE_SIN                equ 14          ; sin_tables.asm: the sine table
 166+ 0000                                                      ; (slot 0, read by get_sin)
 167+ 0000              PAGE_INIT               equ 15          ; initialise.asm: start-up set-up,
 168+ 0000                                                      ; initgame (slot 7, once)
 169+ 0000              PAGE_FILE               equ 16          ; file_handler.asm: SD card loading
 170+ 0000                                                      ; and saving (slot 7)
 171+ 0000              PAGE_AUDIO              equ 17          ; audio.asm: sound set-up (slot 7)
 172+ 0000              PAGE_SPECIAL            equ 31          ; specials.asm: special monsters
 173+ 0000                                                      ; (slot 6)
 174+ 0000              PAGE_LOADOUT            equ 32          ; loadout.asm: the load-out screen
 175+ 0000                                                      ; between levels (slot 6)
 176+ 0000              PAGE_KEYDEF             equ 33          ; keydef.asm: the redefine keys
 177+ 0000                                                      ; screen (slot 6)
 178+ 0000              PAGE_CITY2              equ 34          ; city2.asm: more Layer 2 drawing
 179+ 0000                                                      ; (slot 4, with the city page)
 180+ 0000              PAGE_L320               equ 35          ; layer2-320x256.asm: Layer 2 320x256
 181+ 0000                                                      ; graphics for the menu screens (slot 2)
 182+ 0000              PAGE_MAINMENU           equ 36          ; mainmenu.asm: the main menu (slot 6)
 183+ 0000              PAGE_LEVELEND           equ 37          ; levelend.asm: level complete (slot 6)
 184+ 0000              PAGE_L320_BG            equ 86          ; 86-95: a copy of a 320x256 screen's
 185+ 0000                                                      ; background (l320_bg_save), to put back
 186+ 0000                                                      ; under text that changes (l320_restore).
 187+ 0000                                                      ; Shared: the figures' last 10 pages
 188+ 0000                                                      ; (shared_pg; gfx_reload puts them back)
 189+ 0000              PAGE_GFX0               equ 38          ; the figures' graphics (pages 38-95,
 190+ 0000                                                      ; GFX_PAGES_MAX at most), loaded from
 191+ 0000                                                      ; ZPDATA/SPRITES.ZPG at start-up; each
 192+ 0000                                                      ; mapped at $C000 (slot 6) to draw
 193+ 0000              GFX_SHARED              equ PAGE_L320_BG - PAGE_GFX0    ; (its first shared page)
 194+ 0000              PAGE_LEVEL              equ 30          ; level_load.asm: level and city
 195+ 0000                                                      ; files (slot 6); pages 18-29 are
 196+ 0000                                                      ; the Layer 2 buffers
 197+ 0000
 198+ 0000              ; Layer 2 double buffer, in 16K banks (NextReg $12 / $13 take banks; the
 199+ 0000              ; pages are bank * 2).  Layer 2 is clipped to 192 rows, so each buffer
 200+ 0000              ; uses three banks.
 201+ 0000              L2_BANK_A               equ 9           ; 16K banks 9-11 (pages 18-23)
 202+ 0000              L2_BANK_B               equ 12          ; 16K banks 12-14 (pages 24-29)
 203+ 0000              PAGE_L2_A               equ L2_BANK_A*2
 204+ 0000              PAGE_L2_B               equ L2_BANK_B*2
 205+ 0000
 206+ 0000              PAGE_ROM                equ $FF         ; MMU value: ROM in slots 0-1

 132  0000
 133  0000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 134  0000              ; Tuning constants
 135  0000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 136  0000              ; Scale: one map tile (cell) is 20 m x 20 m = 256 world units, and one
 137  0000              ; height unit (building heights, the ceiling, the pad) is 10 m = 128 world
 138  0000              ; units.  World units are the same size on every axis, so 1 m = 12.8 units
 139  0000              ; and 1 unit = 7.8 cm.  The city is 64 x 64 tiles = 1280 m.
 140  0000              ; Speeds are per rendered frame, so real speed depends on the frame rate
 141  0000              ; (figures below are at 14 fps).
 142  0000              GRID            equ 64          ; the city is GRID x GRID tiles (gentables.py)
 143  0000              ; A city_map byte: bits 0-4 the cell code (0 road, 1-15 building height

 721  0000              ; HL = HL * GRID  (a map row offset)
 722  0000              ; DE = -DE (vproj)
 723  0000                      MACRO NEG_DE
 724  0000 ~                    xor a
 725  0000 ~                    sub e
 726  0000 ~                    ld e,a
 727  0000 ~                    sbc a,a
 728  0000 ~                    sub d
 729  0000 ~                    ld d,a
 730  0000                      ENDM
 731  0000
 732  0000              ; HL = n (>= 0), BC = R (zpatch's reciprocal for Z) -> A = round(n * 128 /
 733  0000              ; Z) as scale_comp, after its shift: n over 511 clamped; P = n_lo R / 256 +
 734  0000              ; 256 (the rounding, first: at most 65535), plus R if bit 8 of n is set (the
 735  0000              ; carry bit 16); A = bits 9-16 of P.  Uses DE.  (vproj)
 736  0000                      MACRO VP_SCALE
 737  0000 ~                    ld a,h
 738  0000 ~                    cp 2
 739  0000 ~                    jr c,$+5
 740  0000 ~                    ld hl,511
 741  0000 ~                    ld d,l
 742  0000 ~                    ld e,c
 743  0000 ~                    mul d,e                         ; n_lo Rl
 744  0000 ~                    ld a,d
 745  0000 ~                    ld d,l
 746  0000 ~                    ld e,b
 747  0000 ~                    mul d,e                         ; n_lo Rh
 748  0000 ~                    add a,e
 749  0000 ~                    ld e,a
 750  0000 ~                    ld a,d
 751  0000 ~                    adc a,1
 752  0000 ~                    ld d,a                          ; DE = n_lo R / 256 + 256, carry 0
 753  0000 ~                    bit 0,h
 754  0000 ~                    jr z,$+5
 755  0000 ~                    ex de,hl
 756  0000 ~                    add hl,bc                       ; + 256 n_hi R / 256: carry = bit 16
 757  0000 ~                    ex de,hl
 758  0000 ~                    ld a,d
 759  0000 ~                    rra
 760  0000                      ENDM
 761  0000
 762  0000              ; The cell walks' call of try_cell (draw_row, occ_row), skipped for a cell
 763  0000              ; whose centre (the walk's yaw-space X, Z1 in HL', DE') is surely out of
 764  0000              ; view: in level flight |X| - Z1 >= WALK_R (outside the left or right
 765  0000              ; edge), pitched Z1 < -WALK_R (behind: no multiply by draw_bld's cull_c).
 766  0000              ; WALK_R is over draw_bld's BLD_R, so every building it skips draw_bld
 767  0000              ; would reject, and the 64 over leaves room for a figure standing at a
 768  0000              ; street cell's edge (an off-screen figure draws nothing and notes
 769  0000              ; nothing: fig_draw returns before fig_seen).  The walk still steps every
 770  0000              ; cell, so the cells drawn have the same positions.  Uses A, BC'.
 771  0000              WALK_R          equ 320
 772  0000                      MACRO WALK_TRY
 773  0000 ~                    exx
 774  0000 ~                    ld a,(pitch)
 775  0000 ~                    or a
 776  0000 ~                    jr nz,.pt
 777  0000 ~                    ld b,h
 778  0000 ~                    ld c,l
 779  0000 ~                    bit 7,b
 780  0000 ~                    jr z,.ap
 781  0000 ~                    xor a
 782  0000 ~                    sub c
 783  0000 ~                    ld c,a
 784  0000 ~                    sbc a,a
 785  0000 ~                    sub b
 786  0000 ~                    ld b,a                          ; |X|
 787  0000 ~            .ap:    ld a,c
 788  0000 ~                    sub e
 789  0000 ~                    ld c,a
 790  0000 ~                    ld a,b
 791  0000 ~                    sbc a,d
 792  0000 ~                    ld b,a                          ; |X| - Z1
 793  0000 ~                    ld a,c
 794  0000 ~                    sub low WALK_R
 795  0000 ~                    ld a,b
 796  0000 ~                    sbc a,high WALK_R
 797  0000 ~                    exx
 798  0000 ~                    jp p,.out                       ; |X| - Z1 >= WALK_R
 799  0000 ~                    jr .try
 800  0000 ~            .pt:    ld a,e
 801  0000 ~                    add a,low WALK_R
 802  0000 ~                    ld a,d
 803  0000 ~                    adc a,high WALK_R
 804  0000 ~                    exx
 805  0000 ~                    jp m,.out                       ; Z1 + WALK_R < 0
 806  0000 ~            .try:   call try_cell
 807  0000 ~            .out:
 808  0000                      ENDM
 809  0000
 810  0000                      MACRO ROWOFS
 811  0000 ~                    add hl,hl
 812  0000 ~                    add hl,hl
 813  0000 ~                    add hl,hl
 814  0000 ~                    add hl,hl
 815  0000 ~                    add hl,hl
 816  0000 ~                    add hl,hl
 817  0000                      ENDM
 818  0000
 819  0000              ; A building's 8 corners (vtx, 16 bytes each; index = x + 2*z + 4*top) from
 820  0000              ; corner 0, component C (0 X, 2 Y, 4 Z) at a time: v1 = v0 + vx, v3 = v1 +
 821  0000              ; vz, v2 = v0 + vz (vx, vz: vecs0, its edge vectors), and each top corner
 822  0000              ; its bottom corner + vy (vy_vec, the vertical edge).  The sums the corners
 823  0000              ; share are made once, in registers (draw_bld, city.asm).
 824  0000                      MACRO VBOX C
 825  0000 ~                    ld hl,(vtx+C)                   ; v0
 826  0000 ~                    ld de,(vecs0+C)                 ; vx
 827  0000 ~                    ld bc,(vecs0+6+C)               ; vz
 828  0000 ~                    push hl
 829  0000 ~                    add hl,de
 830  0000 ~                    ld (vtx+16+C),hl                ; v1 = v0 + vx
 831  0000 ~                    push hl
 832  0000 ~                    add hl,bc
 833  0000 ~                    ld (vtx+48+C),hl                ; v3 = v1 + vz
 834  0000 ~                    ld de,(vy_vec+C)                ; vy
 835  0000 ~                    add hl,de
 836  0000 ~                    ld (vtx+112+C),hl               ; v7 = v3 + vy
 837  0000 ~                    pop hl
 838  0000 ~                    add hl,de
 839  0000 ~                    ld (vtx+80+C),hl                ; v5 = v1 + vy
 840  0000 ~                    pop hl
 841  0000 ~                    add hl,bc
 842  0000 ~                    ld (vtx+32+C),hl                ; v2 = v0 + vz
 843  0000 ~                    add hl,de
 844  0000 ~                    ld (vtx+96+C),hl                ; v6 = v2 + vy
 845  0000 ~                    ld hl,(vtx+C)
 846  0000 ~                    add hl,de
 847  0000 ~                    ld (vtx+64+C),hl                ; v4 = v0 + vy
 848  0000                      ENDM
 849  0000              ; The same for a component of vy that is 0 (X always; Z in level flight):
 850  0000              ; each top corner is its bottom corner
 851  0000                      MACRO VBOX0 C
 852  0000 ~                    ld hl,(vtx+C)                   ; v0
 853  0000 ~                    ld (vtx+64+C),hl                ; v4 = v0
 854  0000 ~                    ld de,(vecs0+C)
 855  0000 ~                    ld bc,(vecs0+6+C)
 856  0000 ~                    push hl
 857  0000 ~                    add hl,de
 858  0000 ~                    ld (vtx+16+C),hl                ; v1 = v0 + vx
 859  0000 ~                    ld (vtx+80+C),hl                ; v5
 860  0000 ~                    add hl,bc
 861  0000 ~                    ld (vtx+48+C),hl                ; v3 = v1 + vz
 862  0000 ~                    ld (vtx+112+C),hl               ; v7
 863  0000 ~                    pop hl
 864  0000 ~                    add hl,bc
 865  0000 ~                    ld (vtx+32+C),hl                ; v2 = v0 + vz
 866  0000 ~                    ld (vtx+96+C),hl                ; v6
 867  0000                      ENDM
 868  0000
 869  0000              ; Copy cached screen corner of face vertex (HL)+ into p2buf (DE)+ with the
 870  0000              ; outline flag for edge bit EB taken from df_mask.  B = high vtx.
 871  0000                      MACRO FACEVTX EB
 872  0000 ~                    ld a,(hl)
 873  0000 ~                    inc hl
 874  0000 ~                    add a,7
 875  0000 ~                    ld c,a
 876  0000 ~                    ld a,(bc)
 877  0000 ~                    ld (de),a
 878  0000 ~                    inc e
 879  0000 ~                    inc c
 880  0000 ~                    ld a,(bc)
 881  0000 ~                    ld (de),a
 882  0000 ~                    inc e
 883  0000 ~                    ld a,(df_mask)
 884  0000 ~                    and EB
 885  0000 ~                    ld (de),a
 886  0000 ~                    inc e
 887  0000 ~                    inc e
 888  0000                      ENDM

 890  0000              ;==============================================================================
 891  0000              ; NEX entry: the loader leaves its default mapping (slot 6 = page 0, slot 5
 892  0000              ; = page 5), so the entry point is this stub in PAGE_BOOT at $C000.  It maps
 893  0000              ; the resident page into slot 5 and jumps to start.
 894  0000              ;==============================================================================
 895  0000                      MMU BOOT_SLOT e, PAGE_BOOT, BOOT_ADDR
 896  C000                      ORG BOOT_ADDR
 897  C000              boot:
 898  C000 F3                   di
 899  C001 31 1B C0             ld sp,boot_stack
 900  C004 ED 91 55 0B          nextreg MAIN_MMU,PAGE_MAIN
 901  C008 C3 99 A3             jp start
 902  C00B              boot_stack_bottom:
 903  C00B 00 00 00...              ds 16                       ; the loader's stack, until start
 904  C01B              boot_stack:
 905  C01B
 906  C01B                      MMU MAIN_SLOT e, PAGE_MAIN, MAIN_ADDR
 907  A000                      ORG MAIN_ADDR

 913  A061                      INCLUDE "levels.asm"            ; the current level's record
# file opened: levels.asm
   1+ A061              ;==============================================================================
   2+ A061              ; Z-POLICE - the current level's settings (resident, so any page can read
   3+ A061              ; them)
   4+ A061              ;
   5+ A061              ; level_cur holds the record of the level being played, loaded from its file
   6+ A061              ; ZPDATA/LEVELnn.ZPL by load_level (level_load.asm).  LV_SIZE bytes:
   7+ A061              ;   +0  LV_NUM          level number
   8+ A061              ;   +1  LV_NAME         city name, 8 characters (ASCII, space padded)
   9+ A061              ;   +9  LV_ZOMBIES      number of zombies a wave (at most NZOMB)
  10+ A061              ;   +10 LV_WAVES        number of zombie waves (1..LV_MAX_WAVES)
  11+ A061              ;   +11 LV_FAST         number of fast zombies (of LV_ZOMBIES)
  12+ A061              ;   +12 LV_VIEW_R       draw distance in tiles, 2..VIEW_R (fewer: night or
  13+ A061              ;                       fog); load_level sets view_r / dot_r from it
  14+ A061              ;   +13 LV_WAVE_DATA    the special monsters of each wave, waves 1 to
  15+ A061              ;                       LV_MAX_WAVES (wave 1 is the level's start), LV_WAVE_REC
  16+ A061              ;                       bytes each:
  17+ A061              ;         +0  LV_SPECIAL_ID   LV_SPEC_SLOTS special types (SPEC_*;
  18+ A061              ;                             SPEC_NONE, 255: none in that place)
  19+ A061              ;         +5  LV_SPECIAL      how many of each (in the same places)
  20+ A061              ; The levels and their cities are made by gentables.py (ZPDATA/); a level
  21+ A061              ; file can be replaced by a hand-made one (or its text form, .TXL, edited).
  22+ A061              ;==============================================================================
  23+ A061
  24+ A061              LV_NUM          equ 0
  25+ A061              LV_NAME         equ 1
  26+ A061              LV_NAME_LEN     equ 8
  27+ A061              LV_ZOMBIES      equ LV_NAME+LV_NAME_LEN
  28+ A061              LV_WAVES        equ LV_ZOMBIES+1
  29+ A061              LV_FAST         equ LV_WAVES+1
  30+ A061              LV_VIEW_R       equ LV_FAST+1
  31+ A061              LV_WAVE_DATA    equ LV_VIEW_R+1
  32+ A061              LV_MAX_WAVES    equ 10              ; waves a level can have specials for
  33+ A061              LV_SPEC_SLOTS   equ 5               ; special types a wave
  34+ A061              LV_SPECIAL_ID   equ 0               ; (in a wave's data) the types,
  35+ A061              LV_SPECIAL      equ LV_SPEC_SLOTS   ;   then how many of each
  36+ A061              LV_WAVE_REC     equ 2*LV_SPEC_SLOTS
  37+ A061              LV_SIZE         equ LV_WAVE_DATA+LV_MAX_WAVES*LV_WAVE_REC   ; 113 bytes
  38+ A061                      ASSERT LV_SIZE == 113           ; (gentables.py writes it)
  39+ A061              ; Special monster types in the level files (specials.asm: spec_types)
  40+ A061              SPEC_GHOST      equ 0
  41+ A061              SPEC_BANSHEE    equ 1
  42+ A061              SPEC_GHOUL      equ 2
  43+ A061              SPEC_LICH       equ 3
  44+ A061              SPEC_DEVIL      equ 4               ; the final boss (devil.asm): alone, last
  45+ A061              SPEC_IDS        equ 5               ; (how many types)
  46+ A061              SPEC_CLUSTER    equ 5               ; not a monster: the wave's zombies spawn in
  47+ A061                                                  ; this many clusters (zcluster, zombie.asm)
  48+ A061                      ASSERT SPEC_CLUSTER >= SPEC_IDS ; (spec_wave skips it)
  49+ A061              SPEC_NONE       equ 255
  50+ A061
  51+ A061              ; -> HL = the current level's record
  52+ A061              level_entry:
  53+ A061 21 65 A0             ld hl,level_cur
  54+ A064 C9                   ret
  55+ A065
  56+ A065 00 00 00...  level_cur:  ds LV_SIZE                  ; the level being played (load_level)
  57+ A0D6
# file closed: levels.asm

   1+ A0D6              ;==============================================================================
   2+ A0D6              ; Z-POLICE - text (resident): menu_print / menu_char, 8x8 characters
   3+ A0D6              ; (font8, ASCII 32-95) on the ULA screen by row and column with an
   4+ A0D6              ; attribute, for the boxes over the game (PAUSED, PREPARE FOR COMBAT); and
   5+ A0D6              ; screen320, the start of a Layer 2 320x256 screen (every screen outside the
   6+ A0D6              ; game: layer2-320x256.asm draws them), from whichever page is in slot 6.
   7+ A0D6              ;==============================================================================
   8+ A0D6
   9+ A0D6              MENU_ATTR       equ P_PANEL<<3 | 7          ; white on the panel colour
  10+ A0D6              MENU_TITLE      equ P_PANEL<<3 | C_YEL      ; yellow
  11+ A0D6              MENU_OK         equ P_PANEL<<3 | C_OK       ; green
  12+ A0D6              MENU_BAD        equ P_PANEL<<3 | C_WARN     ; red
  13+ A0D6
  14+ A0D6              ; A Layer 2 320x256 screen (the main menu, redefine keys): sprites hidden,
  15+ A0D6              ; the AY chips silent, the keys in slot 7, the 320x256 page in slot 2 (and
  16+ A0D6              ; left there: the screen draws with it), cleared with a frame and shown
  17+ A0D6              ; (l320_screen, layer2-320x256.asm)
  18+ A0D6              screen320:

  20+ A0D9 ED 91 52 23          nextreg L320_MMU,PAGE_L320
  21+ A0DD C3 8D 40             jp l320_screen
  22+ A0E0
  23+ A0E0              ; No HUD sprites, silence (the engines off), no screen shake (a level can
  24+ A0E0              ; end mid-shake: Layer 2's scroll left set would move a whole 320x256
  25+ A0E0              ; screen), and the input page in slot 7 (the screens read the keys)
  26+ A0E0              menu_quiet:

  28+ A0E3 ED 91 57 0D          nextreg CODE_MMU,PAGE_SPRITES

  30+ A0EA CD 2E E0             call spr_update

  34+ A0F8 C9                   ret
  35+ A0F9

  37+ A0F9              ; Prints it; HL ends past the 0.

  40+ A0FA 23                   inc hl
  41+ A0FB B7                   or a
  42+ A0FC C8                   ret z

  46+ A100 CD 09 A1             call menu_char

  49+ A105 E1                   pop hl
  50+ A106 1C                   inc e
  51+ A107 18 F0                jr .ch
  52+ A109
  53+ A109              ; A = ASCII 32-95, D = row, E = column, C = attribute: draw one character
  54+ A109              menu_char:

  56+ A10B 6F                   ld l,a
  57+ A10C 26 00                ld h,0
  58+ A10E 29                   add hl,hl

  64+ A116 D1                   pop de

  67+ A119 0F                   rrca
  68+ A11A 0F                   rrca
  69+ A11B 0F                   rrca
  70+ A11C 47                   ld b,a
  71+ A11D E6 E0                and %11100000
  72+ A11F B3                   or e
  73+ A120 E5                   push hl
  74+ A121 6F                   ld l,a
  75+ A122 78                   ld a,b
  76+ A123 E6 03                and %00000011

  79+ A128 71                   ld (hl),c
  80+ A129 E1                   pop hl
  81+ A12A D1                   pop de

  94+ A13A 06 08                ld b,8

 102+ A143              ; Wait for the start of the next video frame (the raster reaching line 192)
 103+ A143              menu_frame:
 104+ A143 CD 4E A1     .in:    call menu_line                  ; let any current blanking end
 105+ A146 30 FB                jr nc,.in
 106+ A148 CD 4E A1     .out:   call menu_line                  ; then wait for the next one
 107+ A14B 38 FB                jr c,.out
 108+ A14D C9                   ret
 109+ A14E
 110+ A14E              ; Carry clear if the raster is at line 192 or later (blanking).  The line is
 111+ A14E              ; read as high byte ($1E), low byte ($1F), high byte again: if the high
 112+ A14E              ; byte changed in between (line 255 -> 256) the pair is torn, so read again.
 113+ A14E              menu_line:
 114+ A14E 01 3B 24             ld bc,$243B
 115+ A151 3E 1E                ld a,$1E
 116+ A153 ED 79                out (c),a
 117+ A155 04                   inc b
 118+ A156 ED 58                in e,(c)                        ; high byte
 119+ A158 05                   dec b
 120+ A159 3E 1F                ld a,$1F
 121+ A15B ED 79                out (c),a
 122+ A15D 04                   inc b
 123+ A15E ED 50                in d,(c)                        ; low byte
 124+ A160 05                   dec b
 125+ A161 3E 1E                ld a,$1E
 126+ A163 ED 79                out (c),a
 127+ A165 04                   inc b
 128+ A166 ED 78                in a,(c)
 129+ A168 BB                   cp e
 130+ A169 20 E3                jr nz,menu_line                 ; torn: again
 131+ A16B E6 01                and 1
 132+ A16D C0                   ret nz                          ; line >= 256 (carry clear)

 134+ A16F FE C0                cp 192

  33+ A372              ; DMA+ (zxnDDMA, core 3.03.00, port $6B only; REAL_HARDWARE builds):
  34+ A372              ; docs/ZXNDDMA.md
  35+ A372              DDMA_MODE                    equ $df    ; then the flags: each sets them all
  36+ A372                                                      ; (with DDMA_FLAG_XY: X lo, X hi, Y)
  37+ A372              DDMA_FILL_VALUE              equ $f7    ; then the value
  38+ A372              DDMA_ROW_LEN                 equ $e3    ; 2D: then bytes a row (word)
  39+ A372              DDMA_ROWS                    equ $e7    ; 2D: then the rows (word)
  40+ A372              DDMA_B_STRIDE                equ $ef    ; 2D: then port B's stride (word)
  41+ A372              DDMA_A_EXT                   equ $d7    ; then port A address bits 23:16
  42+ A372              DDMA_B_EXT                   equ $db    ; then port B address bits 23:16
  43+ A372              DDMA_A_STRIDE                equ $eb    ; 2D: then port A's stride (word)
  44+ A372              DDMA_TRANS_COL               equ $f3    ; then the transparent colour
  45+ A372              DDMA_FLAG_PHYS               equ %00000001  ; 22-bit physical addresses
  46+ A372              DDMA_FLAG_2D                 equ %00000010  ; rows (row length, rows, strides)
  47+ A372              DDMA_FLAG_TRANS              equ %00000100  ; source bytes = the colour skipped
  48+ A372              DDMA_FLAG_FILL               equ %00001000  ; no reads: the fill value
  49+ A372              DDMA_FLAG_XY                 equ %00010000  ; port B from a Layer 2 X,Y
  50+ A372              DDMA_FLAG_HIDDEN             equ %00100000  ;   on the hidden screen ($13)
  51+ A372              ; A filled rectangle in the buffer being drawn, by its physical address
  52+ A372              ; (seg_base's pages): no paging (dd_rect, city.asm)
  53+ A372              DDMA_RECT                    equ DDMA_FLAG_PHYS|DDMA_FLAG_2D|DDMA_FLAG_FILL
  54+ A372

  61+ A377 ~            l2_fill_value           DB 0                    ; as fast as a fixed source

  70+ A385                  IFDEF REAL_HARDWARE

  72+ A385                  ENDIF                                       ; and occ_dma are plain copies
  73+ A385              l2_fill_cmd_len	        EQU $ - l2_fill

  75+ A385
  76+ A385              ; DMA fill: HL = destination, BC = length (non-zero), A = the byte.  Any
  77+ A385              ; memory mapped in now (the Layer 2 sections in slot 0, the occlusion page,

1211  A5FD              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1212  A5FD              ; After a frame (its view shown) that started a level (WP_START: no figures
1213  A5FD              ; drawn if their pages are being read back) or the devil's wave (WP_DEVIL:
1214  A5FD              ; it isn't drawn yet): PREPARE FOR COMBAT over the view (as PAUSED is)
1215  A5FD              ; while
1216  A5FD              ;   * at a level's start, the figures' pages a screen's background copy
1217  A5FD              ;     (shared_pg) or the devil's graphics (devil_gfx) went over are read
1218  A5FD              ;     back from the figures' file (gfx_stale, gfx_reload);
1219  A5FD              ;   * in the devil's wave, its graphics go over the other monsters' pages
1220  A5FD              ;     (devil_load: from the figures' kept pages on, gfx_keep);
1221  A5FD              ; (one can't be read: the SD card's at fault, the load error screen), and
1222  A5FD              ; for WPREP_TICKS interrupts (2 s) at least from its start (isr_ticks; the
1223  A5FD              ; interrupts are off while the SD card is read, so a long read adds to it).
1224  A5FD              ; Then the box goes and the game runs.
1225  A5FD              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1226  A5FD              WPREP_ROW       equ 7               ; ULA character row and column of the box
1227  A5FD              WPREP_COL       equ 6
1228  A5FD              WPREP_TICKS     equ 100             ; at least 2 s (interrupts)
1229  A5FD              WP_START        equ 0               ; wave_prep bits: a level's start,
1230  A5FD              WP_DEVIL        equ 1               ;   the devil's wave
1231  A5FD              wave_prepare:
1232  A5FD 3A 87 A6             ld a,(wave_prep)
1233  A600 32 88 A6             ld (wp_what),a
1234  A603 AF                   xor a
1235  A604 32 87 A6             ld (wave_prep),a
1236  A607 21 00 00             ld hl,0
1237  A60A 22 9A 3C             ld (isr_ticks),hl               ; (one instruction: no tearing)
1238  A60D 21 5D A6             ld hl,txt_wprep
1239  A610 11 06 07             ld de,WPREP_ROW<<8 | WPREP_COL
1240  A613 0E 17                ld c,PAUSE_ATTR
1241  A615 CD F9 A0             call menu_print
1242  A618 ED 91 56 1E          nextreg LOGIC_MMU,PAGE_LEVEL    ; (level_load.asm)
1243  A61C 3A 88 A6             ld a,(wp_what)
1244  A61F CB 47                bit WP_START,a
1245  A621 28 11                jr z,.dv
1246  A623 CD 89 A6             call gfx_stale                  ; pages to read back?
1247  A626 38 05                jr c,.fresh
1248  A628 CD C1 C2             call gfx_reload
1249  A62B 38 13                jr c,.err
1250  A62D AF           .fresh: xor a                           ; the figures' pages all theirs
1251  A62E 32 61 A7             ld (shared_pg),a
1252  A631 32 4F A7             ld (devil_gfx),a
1253  A634 3A 88 A6     .dv:    ld a,(wp_what)
1254  A637 CB 4F                bit WP_DEVIL,a
1255  A639 28 0C                jr z,wp_wait
1256  A63B CD 1F C3             call devil_load                 ; its graphics over the others'
1257  A63E 30 07                jr nc,wp_wait
1258  A640 ED 91 56 08  .err:   nextreg LOGIC_MMU,PAGE_MENU     ; couldn't: the SD card's at fault
1259  A644 C3 30 C1             jp load_error_screen            ; (menu.asm)
1260  A647              wp_wait:                                ; (tests: zptest skips the wait here)
1261  A647 2A 9A 3C             ld hl,(isr_ticks)
1262  A64A 11 64 00             ld de,WPREP_TICKS
1263  A64D B7                   or a
1264  A64E ED 52                sbc hl,de
1265  A650 38 F5                jr c,wp_wait
1266  A652 21 72 A6             ld hl,txt_wprep_off             ; the box gone: the view again
1267  A655 11 06 07             ld de,WPREP_ROW<<8 | WPREP_COL
1268  A658 0E 47                ld c,VIEW_ATTR
1269  A65A C3 F9 A0             jp menu_print

1271  A65D 20 50 52 45  txt_wprep:      db " PREPARE FOR COMBAT ", 0
1271  A661 50 41 52 45
1271  A665 20 46 4F 52
1271  A669 20 43 4F 4D
1271  A66D 42 41 54 20
1271  A671 00
1272  A672 20 20 20 20  txt_wprep_off:  db "                    ", 0
1272  A676 20 20 20 20
1272  A67A 20 20 20 20
1272  A67E 20 20 20 20
1272  A682 20 20 20 20
1272  A686 00
1273  A687                      ASSERT txt_wprep_off - txt_wprep == $ - txt_wprep_off
1274  A687 00           wave_prep:      db 0                    ; wave_prepare after this frame: bits
1275  A688                                                      ; WP_START, WP_DEVIL
1276  A688 00           wp_what:        db 0                    ; (wave_prepare: what it's for)
1277  A689
1278  A689              ; A = the first figure page to read back from the figures' file at a
1279  A689              ; level's start: a screen's background copy took the shared ones
1280  A689              ; (shared_pg), the devil's graphics went over those from the kept ones on
1281  A689              ; (devil_gfx, gfx_keep).  Carry set if none (or no graphics at all).
1282  A689              gfx_stale:
1283  A689 0E 3A                ld c,GFX_PAGES_MAX
1284  A68B 3A 61 A7             ld a,(shared_pg)
1285  A68E B7                   or a
1286  A68F 28 02                jr z,.d
1287  A691 0E 30                ld c,GFX_SHARED
1288  A693 3A 4F A7     .d:     ld a,(devil_gfx)
1289  A696 B7                   or a
1290  A697 28 07                jr z,.c
1291  A699 3A 4E A7             ld a,(gfx_keep)

1293  A69D 30 01                jr nc,.c
1294  A69F 4F                   ld c,a
1295  A6A0 3A 4D A7     .c:     ld a,(gfx_pages)
1296  A6A3 B7                   or a
1297  A6A4 37                   scf
1298  A6A5 C8                   ret z                           ; (no graphics)
1299  A6A6 3D                   dec a                           ; its last page before the first stale
1300  A6A7 B9                   cp c                            ; one: carry, none to read
1301  A6A8 79                   ld a,c
1302  A6A9 C9                   ret
1303  A6AA
1304  A6AA              ;==============================================================================
1305  A6AA              ; Frames per second, shown on the ULA layer above Layer 2.
1306  A6AA              ;
1307  A6AA              ; Interrupts stay off (the span filler borrows SP), so time is taken from the
1308  A6AA              ; raster: vtick reads the current video line and counts a new 50Hz video
1309  A6AA              ; frame whenever the line number has gone backwards.  It must be called at
1310  A6AA              ; least once per video frame (~560K T at 28MHz); the main loop and draw_cell
1311  A6AA              ; do that.  Every 50 video frames (1 second) the number of frames rendered
1312  A6AA              ; becomes the FPS figure.
1313  A6AA              ;==============================================================================
1314  A6AA                  IFDEF DRAW_FPS
1315  A6AA ~            vtick:
1316  A6AA ~                    ld bc,$243B
1317  A6AA ~                    ld a,$1E
1318  A6AA ~                    out (c),a
1319  A6AA ~                    inc b
1320  A6AA ~                    in d,(c)                        ; line MSB
1321  A6AA ~                    dec b
1322  A6AA ~                    ld a,$1F
1323  A6AA ~                    out (c),a
1324  A6AA ~                    inc b
1325  A6AA ~                    in e,(c)                        ; line LSB
1326  A6AA ~                    dec b
1327  A6AA ~                    ld a,$1E
1328  A6AA ~                    out (c),a
1329  A6AA ~                    inc b
1330  A6AA ~                    in a,(c)
1331  A6AA ~                    cp d
1332  A6AA ~                    jr nz,vtick                     ; MSB changed mid-read: try again
1333  A6AA ~                    and 1
1334  A6AA ~                    ld d,a                          ; DE = video line 0..311
1335  A6AA ~                    ld hl,(fps_line)
1336  A6AA ~                    ld (fps_line),de
1337  A6AA ~                    or a
1338  A6AA ~                    sbc hl,de                       ; previous - current
1339  A6AA ~                    ret c
1340  A6AA ~                    ret z
1341  A6AA ~                    ld hl,fps_vframes               ; line went backwards: new frame
1342  A6AA ~                    inc (hl)
1343  A6AA ~                    ret
1344  A6AA ~
1345  A6AA ~            ; Once per rendered frame, after the flip
1346  A6AA ~            fps_tick:
1347  A6AA ~                    call vtick
1348  A6AA ~                    ld hl,fps_count
1349  A6AA ~                    inc (hl)
1350  A6AA ~                    ld a,(fps_vframes)
1351  A6AA ~                    cp 50
1352  A6AA ~                    ret c
1353  A6AA ~                    sub 50
1354  A6AA ~                    ld (fps_vframes),a
1355  A6AA ~                    ld a,(fps_count)
1356  A6AA ~                    ld (fps_value),a
1357  A6AA ~                    xor a
1358  A6AA ~                    ld (fps_count),a
1359  A6AA ~                    jp fps_draw                     ; HUD page (paged in by main_loop)
1360  A6AA                  ENDIF
1361  A6AA
1362  A6AA              ; A = NextReg number -> A = its value
1363  A6AA              read_nextreg:
1364  A6AA 01 3B 24             ld bc,$243B
1365  A6AD ED 79                out (c),a
1366  A6AF 04                   inc b
1367  A6B0 ED 78                in a,(c)
1368  A6B2 C9                   ret
1369  A6B3
1370  A6B3              ; Select the shadow Layer 2 buffer for drawing: remember the 8K page of its
1371  A6B3              ; first row.  Sections are then paged in on demand by seg_map / line_seg.
1372  A6B3              map_shadow:
1373  A6B3 3E 13                ld a,$13
1374  A6B5 CD AA A6             call read_nextreg
1375  A6B8 87                   add a,a                         ; 16K bank -> 8K page
1376  A6B9 32 C2 B4             ld (seg_base),a
1377  A6BC C9                   ret
1378  A6BD
1379  A6BD              ; Back from the screens outside the game (320x256, layer2-320x256.asm) to
1380  A6BD              ; the game's Layer 2, 256x192 and hidden, and the occlusion page back in
1381  A6BD              ; slot 2 where the 320x256 page was.  (Nothing changes if it wasn't.)
1382  A6BD              l2_game_mode:
1383  A6BD ED 91 52 23          nextreg L320_MMU,PAGE_L320
1384  A6C1 CD 56 40             call l320_mode256
1385  A6C4 ED 91 52 06          nextreg OCC_MMU,PAGE_OCC0
1386  A6C8 C9                   ret
1387  A6C9
1388  A6C9              ; Show the shadow buffer and make the old active buffer the new shadow
1389  A6C9              l2_flip:
1390  A6C9 3E 12                ld a,$12
1391  A6CB CD AA A6             call read_nextreg
1392  A6CE 5F                   ld e,a                          ; old active
1393  A6CF 3E 13                ld a,$13
1394  A6D1 CD AA A6             call read_nextreg
1395  A6D4 ED 92 12             nextreg $12,a                   ; shadow -> active
1396  A6D7 7B                   ld a,e
1397  A6D8 ED 92 13             nextreg $13,a                   ; old active -> shadow
1398  A6DB C9                   ret
1399  A6DC
1400  A6DC              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1401  A6DC              ; Layer 2 writes go through MMU slot 0 ($0000-$1FFF) only.  Each 8K page of
1402  A6DC              ; the buffer is a 32-row section, so row y is page seg_base + y/32 and its
1403  A6DC              ; pixels are at (y & 31)*256 + x.  Sections are paged in as drawing reaches
1404  A6DC              ; them.  Slots 4-5 keep the ULA screen.
1405  A6DC              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1406  A6DC
1407  A6DC              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1408  A6DC              ; Screen shake, when the VTOL hits a building (player.asm sets shake_t to
1409  A6DC              ; SHAKE_LEN), and heavier when a wreck hits the ground (shake_big:
1410  A6DC              ; SHAKE_BIG_LEN of shake_big_xy, up to 4 pixels).  Each rendered frame, as it
1411  A6DC              ; is shown, the Layer 2 view is offset by the next pair of the table
1412  A6DC              ; (shake_tab) through the scroll registers, dying away; the last pair (0, 0)
1413  A6DC              ; puts it back, and the table back to shake_xy.  Only
1414  A6DC              ; Layer 2 moves: the HUD is on the ULA.  (X wraps at 256, Y at 192: -n is
1415  A6DC              ; 256-n and 192-n.  An edge row or column of the view shows the far side's
1416  A6DC              ; meanwhile.)
1417  A6DC              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1418  A6DC              SHAKE_LEN       equ 6               ; rendered frames (about half a second)
1419  A6DC              SHAKE_BIG_LEN   equ 16              ; a wreck's (over a second)
1420  A6DC              shake_tick:
1421  A6DC 3A 4B A7             ld a,(shake_t)
1422  A6DF B7                   or a
1423  A6E0 C8                   ret z
1424  A6E1 3D                   dec a
1425  A6E2 32 4B A7             ld (shake_t),a
1426  A6E5 2A 49 A7             ld hl,(shake_tab)
1427  A6E8 20 07                jr nz,.t
1428  A6EA 11 1D A7             ld de,shake_xy                  ; (the last: the usual table again)
1429  A6ED ED 53 49 A7          ld (shake_tab),de
1430  A6F1 87           .t:     add a,a
1431  A6F2 ED 31                add hl,a
1432  A6F4 7E                   ld a,(hl)
1433  A6F5 ED 92 16             nextreg $16,a                   ; Layer 2 scroll X
1434  A6F8 23                   inc hl
1435  A6F9 7E                   ld a,(hl)
1436  A6FA ED 92 17             nextreg $17,a                   ; Layer 2 scroll Y
1437  A6FD C9                   ret
1438  A6FE
1439  A6FE              ; The heavy shake (a wreck hitting the ground), over any going
1440  A6FE              shake_big:
1441  A6FE 21 29 A7             ld hl,shake_big_xy
1442  A701 22 49 A7             ld (shake_tab),hl
1443  A704 3E 10                ld a,SHAKE_BIG_LEN
1444  A706 32 4B A7             ld (shake_t),a
1445  A709 C9                   ret
1446  A70A
1447  A70A              ; Stop any shake: the view back in place
1448  A70A              shake_off:
1449  A70A 21 1D A7             ld hl,shake_xy
1450  A70D 22 49 A7             ld (shake_tab),hl
1451  A710 AF                   xor a
1452  A711 32 4B A7             ld (shake_t),a
1453  A714 ED 91 16 00          nextreg $16,0
1454  A718 ED 91 17 00          nextreg $17,0
1455  A71C C9                   ret
1456  A71D
1457  A71D              ; (x, y) pixels, used from the last pair back to the first
1458  A71D 00 00 01 00  shake_xy:   db 0,0, 1,0, 256-1,192-1, 1,1, 256-2,192-1, 2,1
1458  A721 FF BF 01 01
1458  A725 FE BF 02 01
1459  A729                      ASSERT $ - shake_xy == 2*SHAKE_LEN
1460  A729              shake_big_xy:
1461  A729 00 00 01 00          db 0,0, 1,0, 256-1,1, 1,192-1, 256-2,1, 2,192-1, 256-2,2, 2,192-2
1461  A72D FF 01 01 BF
1461  A731 FE 01 02 BF
1461  A735 FE 02 02 BE
1462  A739 FD 02 03 BE          db 256-3,2, 3,192-2, 256-3,3, 3,192-3, 256-4,3, 4,192-3, 256-4,4, 4,192-4
1462  A73D FD 03 03 BD
1462  A741 FC 03 04 BD
1462  A745 FC 04 04 BC
1463  A749                      ASSERT $ - shake_big_xy == 2*SHAKE_BIG_LEN
1464  A749 1D A7        shake_tab:  dw shake_xy                 ; the table shake_tick uses
1465  A74B 00           shake_t:    db 0                        ; frames of shake left (0: none)
1466  A74C 00           gfx_ok:     db 0                        ; 1: the figures' graphics are loaded
1467  A74D 00           gfx_pages:  db 0                        ;   in this many pages (gfx_load),
1468  A74E 00           gfx_keep:   db 0                        ;   the kept figures' in those before
1469  A74F                                                      ;   this one (the devil's go after)
1470  A74F 00           devil_gfx:  db 0                        ; 1: the devil's graphics are over the
1471  A750                                                      ; other monsters' (devil_load)
1472  A750 00           dv_dark:    db 0                        ; the normal palette's darkening (the
1473  A751 00           dv_dark_req: db 0                       ;   devil hurt), 1: to apply (vis_dark)
1474  A752 00           dv_hum:     db 0                        ; 1: the devil's charging whine plays
1475  A753                                                      ; (on the splats' voice: they wait)
1476  A753 00           bolt_up:    db 0                        ; 1: it went up into the sky (out of range)
1477  A754 00           bolt_hit:   db 0                        ; 1: it stopped at a building, at
1478  A755 00 00 00 00  bolt_end:   dw 0, 0, 0                  ;   (x, y, z): the VTOL behind it safe
1478  A759 00 00
1479  A75B 00           bolt_spd:   db 0                        ; its hit: the speed braked down to
1480  A75C 00           bolt_t:     db 0                        ; the devil's lightning: frames to draw
1481  A75D                                                      ; it (draw_bolt; devil.asm)
1482  A75D 00 00        spin_rate:  dw 0                        ; its hit: the VTOL's spin a frame (8.8,
1483  A75F 00           spin_t:     db 0                        ;   signed), frames of it left, and
1484  A760 00           bolt_brake: db 0                        ;   1: braked to bolt_spd (player.asm)
1485  A761 00           shared_pg:  db 0                        ; 1: the load-out's background copy has
1486  A762                                                      ; the figures' last pages (PAGE_L320_BG)
1487  A762
1488  A762              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1489  A762              ; Wait until the raster is outside the display area (line >= 192)
1490  A762              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1491  A762              wait_vblank:

1616  A809              ; Paused (main_loop: the pause control, K_PAUSE, BREAK or a Mega Drive pad's
1617  A809              ; START by default): PAUSED over the view, white on an opaque black ULA box,
1618  A809              ; and under it S: SAVE AND QUIT and X: QUIT, NO SAVE, until the pause control
1619  A809              ; is pressed again.  Nothing moves meanwhile and the screen keeps its last

1826  AA23              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1827  AA23              ; Save games: ZPDATA/SAVEGAME.ZPS (beside the level files), one game.  Written
1828  AA23              ; by save and quit (game_pause: save_game), read by CONTINUE on the main menu
1829  AA23              ; (load_save, continue_game).  "ZPSV", SG_VERSION, then the fields in
1830  AA23              ; sg_fields, in order: the level and wave, the salvage, the VTOL's integrity
1831  AA23              ; (vtol_hp), its weapon slots (type and ammo each) and the selected one, the
1832  AA23              ; store (wpn_stock, wpn_unlocked), the booster (fitted, fuel), and the
1833  AA23              ; vision modes (vision_owned), and the vertical and lateral thrusters
1834  AA23              ; (vthrust_fitted, lthrust_fitted).  Files of an older version (1: before
1835  AA23              ; the vision modes, 2: before the vertical thrusters, 3: before the lateral
1836  AA23              ; ones, 4: before the linked chain guns, a longer store) are refused, as any
1837  AA23              ; other version.
1838  AA23              ; Continued, the level starts afresh at the saved wave: its zombies, the
1839  AA23              ; humans (and this level's rescues so far) and the base are new.
1840  AA23              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1841  AA23              SG_VERSION      equ 5
1842  AA23              sg_fields:      ; address, bytes
1843  AA23 A9 AD                dw level
1844  AA25 01                   db 1
1845  AA26 B2 AD                dw wave_number
1846  AA28 01                   db 1
1847  AA29 B4 AD                dw salvage_points
1848  AA2B 02                   db 2
1849  AA2C AC AD                dw vtol_hp
1850  AA2E 01                   db 1
1851  AA2F 9C AD                dw wpn_slots
1852  AA31 0A                   db WPN_SLOTS*2
1853  AA32 A6 AD                dw wpn_sel
1854  AA34 01                   db 1
1855  AA35 24 AE                dw wpn_stock
1856  AA37 0B                   db WPN_LAST+1
1857  AA38 2F AE                dw wpn_unlocked

2241  AD4A
2242  AD4A              ; HL = -HL
2243  AD4A              neg_hl:
2244  AD4A AF                   xor a
2245  AD4B 95                   sub l
2246  AD4C 6F                   ld l,a
2247  AD4D 9F                   sbc a,a

2249  AD4F 67                   ld h,a
2250  AD50 C9                   ret
2251  AD51
2252  AD51              ; HL = |HL|
2253  AD51              abs_hl:
2254  AD51 CB 7C                bit 7,h
2255  AD53 C8                   ret z
2256  AD54 18 F4                jr neg_hl
2257  AD56
2258  AD56              ; fmul: HL = HL * DE >> 8
2259  AD56              ;   HL = signed 16-bit integer, DE = S7.8 factor in -1.0..+1.0
2260  AD56              ;   Sign/magnitude using two 8x8 MUL D,E.  Preserves IX, IY.
2261  AD56              fmul:
2262  AD56 7C                   ld a,h
2263  AD57 AA                   xor d
2264  AD58 F5                   push af                         ; result sign in bit 7
2265  AD59 CB 7C                bit 7,h
2266  AD5B 28 06                jr z,.ap
2267  AD5D AF                   xor a
2268  AD5E 95                   sub l
2269  AD5F 6F                   ld l,a
2270  AD60 9F                   sbc a,a
2271  AD61 94                   sub h
2272  AD62 67                   ld h,a
2273  AD63 CB 7A        .ap:    bit 7,d
2274  AD65 28 06                jr z,.bp
2275  AD67 AF                   xor a
2276  AD68 93                   sub e
2277  AD69 5F                   ld e,a
2278  AD6A 9F                   sbc a,a
2279  AD6B 92                   sub d
2280  AD6C 57                   ld d,a
2281  AD6D 7A           .bp:    ld a,d
2282  AD6E B7                   or a
2283  AD6F 20 10                jr nz,.one                      ; |factor| == 1.0
2284  AD71 7B                   ld a,e
2285  AD72 55                   ld d,l
2286  AD73 ED 30                mul d,e                         ; lo * f
2287  AD75 4A                   ld c,d
2288  AD76 54                   ld d,h
2289  AD77 5F                   ld e,a
2290  AD78 ED 30                mul d,e                         ; hi * f
2291  AD7A 7B                   ld a,e
2292  AD7B 81                   add a,c
2293  AD7C 6F                   ld l,a
2294  AD7D 7A                   ld a,d
2295  AD7E CE 00                adc a,0
2296  AD80 67                   ld h,a
2297  AD81 F1           .one:   pop af
2298  AD82 F0                   ret p
2299  AD83 AF                   xor a
2300  AD84 95                   sub l
2301  AD85 6F                   ld l,a
2302  AD86 9F                   sbc a,a
2303  AD87 94                   sub h
2304  AD88 67                   ld h,a
2305  AD89 C9                   ret
2306  AD8A
2307  AD8A              ; HL = 0.5 * HL (signed): the top/bottom frustum slope, VIEW_CY/128
2308  AD8A              zhalf:
2309  AD8A CB 2C                sra h
2310  AD8C CB 1D                rr l
2311  AD8E C9                   ret

 185+ E883 ~                    sbc hl,de
 186+ E883 ~                    or a                            ; bit 1
 187+ E883 ~                    q                               ; (all the jumps land here)

 204+ E90B              ; E = A / C, A = A mod C  (8-bit unsigned, C 1..127).  By reciprocal:
 205+ E90B              ; q = (A * R) >> 16, R = rcp8[C] = ceil(65536 / C), exact for every A
 206+ E90B              ; (gentables.py checks it); then the remainder A - q C.  Keeps C, D, H, L
 207+ E90B              ; (walk_edge's); B is lost.

 248+ E937              ;==============================================================================
 249+ E937              ; Perspective projection
 250+ E937              ;   in : HL -> X,Y,Z (camera space, inside the view frustum, Z > 0)
 251+ E937              ;   out: A = screen x (0..255), C = screen y (0..VIEW_H-1)
 252+ E937              ;   sx = 128 + 128*X/Z,  sy = 64 - 128*Y/Z   (90 x 53 degree field of view)
 253+ E937              ;   Z is normalised to 9 bits (256..511) with a barrel shift (count from a
 254+ E937              ;   log2 table) that is also applied to X and Y, which are then multiplied
 255+ E937              ;   by a 16-bit reciprocal from rtab.  |X| <= Z keeps Xn within 9 bits.
 256+ E937              ;==============================================================================

 615+ EB6F C9                   ret
