 617+ EB70              ; clip_isect for a 2D plane: the point where the edge S-E crosses it, out
 618+ EB70              ; at IY (IY and clip_on advanced).  Worked out from the edge's inside end,
 619+ EB70              ; so an edge two faces share is cut at the same point whichever way it
 620+ EB70              ; runs: t = d_in / (|dS| + |dE|), the other coordinate o_in + t (o_out -
 621+ EB70              ; o_in), this one exactly on the bound.
 622+ EB70              c2_isect:
 623+ EB70 2A CE E0             ld hl,(clip_s)
 624+ EB73 ED 5B D0 E0          ld de,(clip_e)
 625+ EB77 3A D3 E0             ld a,(clip_ds+1)
 626+ EB7A 17                   rla
 627+ EB7B 30 01                jr nc,.sin
 628+ EB7D EB                   ex de,hl                        ; S outside: E is the inside end
 629+ EB7E 3A DC E0     .sin:   ld a,(c2_off)
 630+ EB81 EE 02                xor 2                           ; the other coordinate
 631+ EB83 ED 31                add hl,a
 632+ EB85 4E                   ld c,(hl)
 633+ EB86 23                   inc hl
 634+ EB87 46                   ld b,(hl)                       ; o_in
 635+ EB88 EB                   ex de,hl
 636+ EB89 ED 31                add hl,a
 637+ EB8B 7E                   ld a,(hl)
 638+ EB8C 23                   inc hl
 639+ EB8D 66                   ld h,(hl)
 640+ EB8E 6F                   ld l,a                          ; o_out
 641+ EB8F B7                   or a
 642+ EB90 ED 42                sbc hl,bc                       ; o_out - o_in
 643+ EB92 28 26                jr z,.same                      ; (a vertical / horizontal edge: o_in)
 644+ EB94 C5                   push bc
 645+ EB95 E5                   push hl
 646+ EB96 2A D2 E0             ld hl,(clip_ds)
 647+ EB99 CD 51 AD             call abs_hl
 648+ EB9C EB                   ex de,hl
 649+ EB9D 2A D4 E0             ld hl,(clip_de)
 650+ EBA0 CD 51 AD             call abs_hl
 651+ EBA3 19                   add hl,de
 652+ EBA4 EB                   ex de,hl                        ; |dS| + |dE|
 653+ EBA5 2A D2 E0             ld hl,(clip_ds)
 654+ EBA8 CB 7C                bit 7,h
 655+ EBAA 28 03                jr z,.di
 656+ EBAC 2A D4 E0             ld hl,(clip_de)
 657+ EBAF CD 83 E8     .di:    call div_frac                   ; t = d_in / (|dS| + |dE|)
 658+ EBB2 E1                   pop hl                          ; o_out - o_in
 659+ EBB3 DD E5                push ix
 660+ EBB5 D1                   pop de
 661+ EBB6 CD 50 E8             call mul_frac
 662+ EBB9 C1                   pop bc
 663+ EBBA 09           .same:  add hl,bc                       ; o_in + t (o_out - o_in)
 664+ EBBB 3A DC E0             ld a,(c2_off)
 665+ EBBE B7                   or a
 666+ EBBF 20 12                jr nz,.y
 667+ EBC1 FD 75 02             ld (iy+2),l                     ; an x plane: y worked out
 668+ EBC4 FD 74 03             ld (iy+3),h
 669+ EBC7 3A DD E0             ld a,(c2_hi)
 670+ EBCA FD 77 00             ld (iy+0),a
 671+ EBCD FD 36 01 00          ld (iy+1),0
 672+ EBD1 18 10                jr .f
 673+ EBD3 FD 75 00     .y:     ld (iy+0),l                     ; a y plane: x worked out
 674+ EBD6 FD 74 01             ld (iy+1),h
 675+ EBD9 3A DD E0             ld a,(c2_hi)
 676+ EBDC FD 77 02             ld (iy+2),a
 677+ EBDF FD 36 03 00          ld (iy+3),0
 678+ EBE3 C3 50 EE     .f:     jp clip_isect.nz                ; its edge flag, IY and clip_on on
 679+ EBE6                  ENDIF
 680+ EBE6
 681+ EBE6              ; HL = signed component -> A = round(|HL| * 128 / Z)
 682+ EBE6              ; The shift and reciprocal for this Z are patched in by zpatch: the shift
 683+ EBE6              ; as a barrel shift whose count and direction (its opcode, BSRL or BSLA)
 684+ EBE6              ; are both patched, so it runs straight through (a right shift by 0 for a Z
 685+ EBE6              ; already 256..511 leaves it as it is).
 686+ EBE6              scale_comp:
 687+ EBE6 CB 7C                bit 7,h
 688+ EBE8 28 06                jr z,.ap
 689+ EBEA AF                   xor a
 690+ EBEB 95                   sub l
 691+ EBEC 6F                   ld l,a
 692+ EBED 9F                   sbc a,a
 693+ EBEE 94                   sub h
 694+ EBEF 67                   ld h,a
 695+ EBF0 EB           .ap:    ex de,hl
 696+ EBF1 06 00        .sh:    ld b,0                          ; (zpatch: the count)
 697+ EBF3 ED 2A        .op:    bsrl de,b                       ; (zpatch: bsrl, or bsla)
 698+ EBF5 EB                   ex de,hl
 699+ EBF6                      ASSERT {b scale_comp.op} == $ED && {b scale_comp.op+1} == OP_BSRL
 700+ EBF6 7C           .sd:    ld a,h
 701+ EBF7 FE 02                cp 2
 702+ EBF9 30 27                jr nc,.big
 703+ EBFB 44           .ok:    ld b,h                          ; bit 8 of Xn
 704+ EBFC 55                   ld d,l
 705+ EBFD 1E 00        .rl:    ld e,0
 706+ EBFF ED 30                mul d,e                         ; Xl*Rl
 707+ EC01 4A                   ld c,d
 708+ EC02 55                   ld d,l
 709+ EC03 1E 00        .rh:    ld e,0
 710+ EC05 ED 30                mul d,e                         ; Xl*Rh
 711+ EC07 79                   ld a,c
 712+ EC08 83                   add a,e
 713+ EC09 6F                   ld l,a
 714+ EC0A 7A                   ld a,d
 715+ EC0B CE 00                adc a,0
 716+ EC0D 67                   ld h,a                          ; HL = (Xl*R) >> 8
 717+ EC0E 0E 00                ld c,0
 718+ EC10 05                   dec b
 719+ EC11 20 06                jr nz,.nh
 720+ EC13 11 00 00     .r16:   ld de,0
 721+ EC16 19                   add hl,de                       ; + (256*R) >> 8
 722+ EC17 CB 11                rl c
 723+ EC19 24           .nh:    inc h                           ; + rounding (0.5 after >>9)
 724+ EC1A 20 01                jr nz,.nr
 725+ EC1C 0C                   inc c
 726+ EC1D 79           .nr:    ld a,c
 727+ EC1E 1F                   rra
 728+ EC1F 7C                   ld a,h
 729+ EC20 1F                   rra                             ; A = (C:H) >> 1  = P >> 9
 730+ EC21 C9                   ret
 731+ EC22 21 FF 01     .big:   ld hl,511                       ; clamp (rounding at frustum edge)
 732+ EC25 18 D4                jr .ok
 733+ EC27
 734+ EC27              ;==============================================================================
 735+ EC27              ; Outcode: HL -> vertex (X,Y,Z) -> A = bits
 736+ EC27              ;   1 near (Z<NEAR)  2 left (X<-Z)  4 right (X>Z)
 737+ EC27              ;   8 top (Y>0.5Z)   16 bottom (Y<-0.5Z)
 738+ EC27              ;==============================================================================
 739+ EC27              calc_oc:
 740+ EC27 5E                   ld e,(hl)
 741+ EC28 23                   inc hl
 742+ EC29 56                   ld d,(hl)                       ; DE = X
 743+ EC2A 23                   inc hl
 744+ EC2B 4E                   ld c,(hl)
 745+ EC2C 23                   inc hl
 746+ EC2D 46                   ld b,(hl)                       ; BC = Y
 747+ EC2E 23                   inc hl
 748+ EC2F 7E                   ld a,(hl)
 749+ EC30 23                   inc hl
 750+ EC31 66                   ld h,(hl)
 751+ EC32 6F                   ld l,a                          ; HL = Z
 752+ EC33 CB 7C                bit 7,h
 753+ EC35 20 0D                jr nz,.nr
 754+ EC37 7C                   ld a,h
 755+ EC38 B7                   or a
 756+ EC39 3E 00                ld a,0
 757+ EC3B 20 09                jr nz,.n1
 758+ EC3D 7D                   ld a,l
 759+ EC3E FE 10                cp NEAR
 760+ EC40 3E 00                ld a,0
 761+ EC42 30 02                jr nc,.n1
 762+ EC44 3E 01        .nr:    ld a,1
 763+ EC46 E5           .n1:    push hl
 764+ EC47 19                   add hl,de                       ; Z+X
 765+ EC48 CB 7C                bit 7,h
 766+ EC4A 28 02                jr z,.n2
 767+ EC4C F6 02                or 2
 768+ EC4E E1           .n2:    pop hl
 769+ EC4F E5                   push hl
 770+ EC50 B7                   or a
 771+ EC51 ED 52                sbc hl,de                       ; Z-X
 772+ EC53 CB 7C                bit 7,h
 773+ EC55 28 02                jr z,.n3
 774+ EC57 F6 04                or 4
 775+ EC59 E1           .n3:    pop hl
 776+ EC5A CB 2C                sra h
 777+ EC5C CB 1D                rr l                            ; 0.5Z
 778+ EC5E E5                   push hl
 779+ EC5F B7                   or a
 780+ EC60 ED 42                sbc hl,bc                       ; 0.5Z-Y
 781+ EC62 CB 7C                bit 7,h
 782+ EC64 28 02                jr z,.n4
 783+ EC66 F6 08                or 8
 784+ EC68 E1           .n4:    pop hl
 785+ EC69 09                   add hl,bc                       ; 0.5Z+Y
 786+ EC6A CB 7C                bit 7,h
 787+ EC6C C8                   ret z
 788+ EC6D F6 10                or 16
 789+ EC6F C9                   ret
 790+ EC70
 791+ EC70                  IFDEF CLIP_2D
 792+ EC70              ; plane_dist for a 2D plane (clip2d): IX -> 2D vertex -> HL = its distance
 793+ EC70              ; inside c2_off / c2_hi (>= 0: inside)
 794+ EC70              c2_dist:
 795+ EC70 3A DC E0             ld a,(c2_off)
 796+ EC73 DD E5                push ix
 797+ EC75 E1                   pop hl
 798+ EC76 ED 31                add hl,a
 799+ EC78 7E                   ld a,(hl)
 800+ EC79 23                   inc hl
 801+ EC7A 66                   ld h,(hl)
 802+ EC7B 6F                   ld l,a
 803+ EC7C 3A DD E0             ld a,(c2_hi)
 804+ EC7F B7                   or a
 805+ EC80 C8                   ret z                           ; v >= 0: v
 806+ EC81 EB                   ex de,hl
 807+ EC82 6F                   ld l,a
 808+ EC83 26 00                ld h,0
 809+ EC85 B7                   or a
 810+ EC86 ED 52                sbc hl,de                       ; v <= bound: bound - v
 811+ EC88 C9                   ret
 812+ EC89                  ENDIF
 813+ EC89
 814+ EC89              ; Signed distance of vertex IX to clip plane (clip_plane bit). >= 0 is inside.
 815+ EC89              plane_dist:
 816+ EC89                  IFDEF CLIP_2D
 817+ EC89 3A C9 E0             ld a,(clip_plane)
 818+ EC8C 17                   rla
 819+ EC8D 38 E1                jr c,c2_dist                    ; (bit 7: a 2D plane)
 820+ EC8F                  ENDIF
 821+ EC8F DD 6E 04             ld l,(ix+4)
 822+ EC92 DD 66 05             ld h,(ix+5)
 823+ EC95 3A C9 E0             ld a,(clip_plane)
 824+ EC98 FE 01                cp 1
 825+ EC9A 20 05                jr nz,.p2
 826+ EC9C 11 F0 FF             ld de,-NEAR
 827+ EC9F 19                   add hl,de
 828+ ECA0 C9                   ret
 829+ ECA1 DD 5E 00     .p2:    ld e,(ix+0)
 830+ ECA4 DD 56 01             ld d,(ix+1)
 831+ ECA7 FE 02                cp 2
 832+ ECA9 20 02                jr nz,.p3
 833+ ECAB 19                   add hl,de
 834+ ECAC C9                   ret
 835+ ECAD FE 04        .p3:    cp 4
 836+ ECAF 20 04                jr nz,.p4
 837+ ECB1 B7                   or a
 838+ ECB2 ED 52                sbc hl,de
 839+ ECB4 C9                   ret
 840+ ECB5 F5           .p4:    push af
 841+ ECB6 CD 8A AD             call zhalf
 842+ ECB9 F1                   pop af
 843+ ECBA DD 5E 02             ld e,(ix+2)
 844+ ECBD DD 56 03             ld d,(ix+3)
 845+ ECC0 FE 08                cp 8
 846+ ECC2 20 04                jr nz,.p5
 847+ ECC4 B7                   or a
 848+ ECC5 ED 52                sbc hl,de
 849+ ECC7 C9                   ret
 850+ ECC8 19           .p5:    add hl,de
 851+ ECC9 C9                   ret
 852+ ECCA
 853+ ECCA              ;==============================================================================
 854+ ECCA              ; Sutherland-Hodgman clip of clip_src (clip_n verts) against clip_plane into
 855+ ECCA              ; clip_dst.  Vertex = X,Y,Z,flag,corner (8 bytes).  flag=1 means the edge from
 856+ ECCA              ; this vertex to the next is a real building edge (gets outlined); edges
 857+ ECCA              ; created along a clip plane get flag=0 so the screen border isn't outlined.
 858+ ECCA              ; corner = vtx offset of an unclipped building corner that is on screen, so
 859+ ECCA              ; its cached projection can be reused; $80 + plane bit for a vertex the
 860+ ECCA              ; clipper put on that plane; $FF for any other vertex.
 861+ ECCA              ;==============================================================================
 862+ ECCA              clip_poly:
 863+ ECCA 3A C6 E0             ld a,(clip_n)
 864+ ECCD 3D                   dec a
 865+ ECCE 87                   add a,a
 866+ ECCF 87                   add a,a
 867+ ECD0 87                   add a,a
 868+ ECD1 2A CA E0             ld hl,(clip_src)
 869+ ECD4 ED 31                add hl,a
 870+ ECD6 22 CE E0             ld (clip_s),hl
 871+ ECD9 E5                   push hl
 872+ ECDA DD E1                pop ix
 873+ ECDC CD 89 EC             call plane_dist
 874+ ECDF 22 D2 E0             ld (clip_ds),hl
 875+ ECE2 2A CA E0             ld hl,(clip_src)
 876+ ECE5 22 D0 E0             ld (clip_e),hl
 877+ ECE8 FD 2A CC E0          ld iy,(clip_dst)
 878+ ECEC AF                   xor a
 879+ ECED 32 C7 E0             ld (clip_on),a
 880+ ECF0 3A C6 E0             ld a,(clip_n)
 881+ ECF3 32 C8 E0             ld (clip_cnt),a
 882+ ECF6 DD 2A D0 E0  .loop:  ld ix,(clip_e)
 883+ ECFA CD 89 EC             call plane_dist
 884+ ECFD 22 D4 E0             ld (clip_de),hl
 885+ ED00 CB 7C                bit 7,h
 886+ ED02 20 33                jr nz,.eout
 887+ ED04 3A D3 E0             ld a,(clip_ds+1)
 888+ ED07 CB 7F                bit 7,a
 889+ ED09 28 0D                jr z,.ein
 890+ ED0B                      ; S out, E in: intersection carries S's edge flag
 891+ ED0B DD 2A CE E0          ld ix,(clip_s)
 892+ ED0F DD 7E 06             ld a,(ix+6)
 893+ ED12 32 D6 E0             ld (clip_if),a
 894+ ED15 CD 73 ED             call clip_isect
 895+ ED18 2A D0 E0     .ein:   ld hl,(clip_e)                  ; whole vertex, with its corner byte
 896+ ED1B FD E5                push iy                         ; (LDI: 16 T a byte)
 897+ ED1D D1                   pop de
 898+ ED1E                      REPT 8
 899+ ED1E ED A0       >        ldi
 899+ ED20 ED A0       >        ldi
 899+ ED22 ED A0       >        ldi
 899+ ED24 ED A0       >        ldi
 899+ ED26 ED A0       >        ldi
 899+ ED28 ED A0       >        ldi
 899+ ED2A ED A0       >        ldi
 899+ ED2C ED A0       >        ldi
 900+ ED2E                      ENDR
 901+ ED2E D5                   push de
 902+ ED2F FD E1                pop iy
 903+ ED31 21 C7 E0             ld hl,clip_on
 904+ ED34 34                   inc (hl)
 905+ ED35 18 0E                jr .next
 906+ ED37 3A D3 E0     .eout:  ld a,(clip_ds+1)
 907+ ED3A CB 7F                bit 7,a
 908+ ED3C 20 07                jr nz,.next
 909+ ED3E                      ; S in, E out: intersection starts a clip-plane edge
 910+ ED3E AF                   xor a
 911+ ED3F 32 D6 E0             ld (clip_if),a
 912+ ED42 CD 73 ED             call clip_isect
 913+ ED45 2A D0 E0     .next:  ld hl,(clip_e)
 914+ ED48 22 CE E0             ld (clip_s),hl
 915+ ED4B 11 08 00             ld de,8
 916+ ED4E 19                   add hl,de
 917+ ED4F 22 D0 E0             ld (clip_e),hl
 918+ ED52 2A D4 E0             ld hl,(clip_de)
 919+ ED55 22 D2 E0             ld (clip_ds),hl
 920+ ED58 21 C8 E0             ld hl,clip_cnt
 921+ ED5B 35                   dec (hl)
 922+ ED5C 20 98                jr nz,.loop
 923+ ED5E 3A C7 E0             ld a,(clip_on)
 924+ ED61 32 C6 E0             ld (clip_n),a
 925+ ED64 2A CA E0             ld hl,(clip_src)                ; the output is the next pass's input
 926+ ED67 ED 5B CC E0          ld de,(clip_dst)
 927+ ED6B ED 53 CA E0          ld (clip_src),de
 928+ ED6F 22 CC E0             ld (clip_dst),hl
 929+ ED72 C9                   ret
 930+ ED73
 931+ ED73              ; Output S + t*(E-S) at IY, t = dS/(dS-dE)
 932+ ED73              clip_isect:
 933+ ED73                  IFDEF CLIP_2D
 934+ ED73 3A C9 E0             ld a,(clip_plane)
 935+ ED76 17                   rla
 936+ ED77 DA 70 EB             jp c,c2_isect                   ; (bit 7: a 2D plane)
 937+ ED7A                  ENDIF
 938+ ED7A                  IFDEF LEVEL_FAST_PATH
 939+ ED7A                      ; Level flight: a vertical building edge (S and E share X and Z)
 940+ ED7A                      ; meets the top or bottom plane at (X, +-0.5Z, Z) - no divide or
 941+ ED7A                      ; interpolation.  At pitch 0 vertical edges can't cross the near or
 942+ ED7A                      ; side planes, so this covers every plane they do cross.
 943+ ED7A 3A 9A AD             ld a,(pitch)
 944+ ED7D B7                   or a
 945+ ED7E 20 49                jr nz,.gen
 946+ ED80 3A C9 E0             ld a,(clip_plane)
 947+ ED83 FE 08                cp 8
 948+ ED85 38 42                jr c,.gen                       ; not top or bottom
 949+ ED87 2A CE E0             ld hl,(clip_s)
 950+ ED8A ED 5B D0 E0          ld de,(clip_e)
 951+ ED8E 1A                   ld a,(de)
 952+ ED8F BE                   cp (hl)
 953+ ED90 20 37                jr nz,.gen
 954+ ED92 23                   inc hl
 955+ ED93 13                   inc de
 956+ ED94 1A                   ld a,(de)
 957+ ED95 BE                   cp (hl)
 958+ ED96 20 31                jr nz,.gen                      ; X differs
 959+ ED98 23                   inc hl
 960+ ED99 23                   inc hl
 961+ ED9A 23                   inc hl
 962+ ED9B 13                   inc de
 963+ ED9C 13                   inc de
 964+ ED9D 13                   inc de
 965+ ED9E 1A                   ld a,(de)
 966+ ED9F BE                   cp (hl)
 967+ EDA0 20 27                jr nz,.gen
 968+ EDA2 23                   inc hl
 969+ EDA3 13                   inc de
 970+ EDA4 1A                   ld a,(de)
 971+ EDA5 BE                   cp (hl)
 972+ EDA6 20 21                jr nz,.gen                      ; Z differs
 973+ EDA8 DD 2A CE E0          ld ix,(clip_s)
 974+ EDAC DD 7E 00             ld a,(ix+0)                     ; X and Z from S (= E)
 975+ EDAF FD 77 00             ld (iy+0),a
 976+ EDB2 DD 7E 01             ld a,(ix+1)
 977+ EDB5 FD 77 01             ld (iy+1),a
 978+ EDB8 DD 6E 04             ld l,(ix+4)
 979+ EDBB DD 66 05             ld h,(ix+5)
 980+ EDBE FD 75 04             ld (iy+4),l
 981+ EDC1 FD 74 05             ld (iy+5),h
 982+ EDC4 3A C9 E0             ld a,(clip_plane)
 983+ EDC7 18 6D                jr .ty                          ; Y = +-0.5Z
 984+ EDC9              .gen:
 985+ EDC9                  ENDIF
 986+ EDC9 2A D2 E0             ld hl,(clip_ds)
 987+ EDCC CD 51 AD             call abs_hl
 988+ EDCF 22 D7 E0             ld (ci_a),hl
 989+ EDD2 2A D4 E0             ld hl,(clip_de)
 990+ EDD5 CD 51 AD             call abs_hl
 991+ EDD8 ED 5B D7 E0          ld de,(ci_a)
 992+ EDDC 19                   add hl,de
 993+ EDDD EB                   ex de,hl                        ; DE = |dS|+|dE|, HL = |dS|
 994+ EDDE E5                   push hl
 995+ EDDF B7                   or a
 996+ EDE0 ED 52                sbc hl,de
 997+ EDE2 E1                   pop hl
 998+ EDE3 38 06                jr c,.dv
 999+ EDE5 DD 21 FF FF          ld ix,$FFFF
1000+ EDE9 18 03                jr .t
1001+ EDEB CD 83 E8     .dv:    call div_frac
1002+ EDEE DD 22 D9 E0  .t:     ld (ci_t),ix
1003+ EDF2 AF                   xor a
1004+ EDF3 CD 68 EE             call lerp_c
1005+ EDF6 FD 75 00             ld (iy+0),l
1006+ EDF9 FD 74 01             ld (iy+1),h
1007+ EDFC 3E 02                ld a,2
1008+ EDFE CD 68 EE             call lerp_c
1009+ EE01 FD 75 02             ld (iy+2),l
1010+ EE04 FD 74 03             ld (iy+3),h
1011+ EE07 3E 04                ld a,4
1012+ EE09 CD 68 EE             call lerp_c
1013+ EE0C FD 75 04             ld (iy+4),l
1014+ EE0F FD 74 05             ld (iy+5),h
1015+ EE12                      ; snap the point exactly onto the plane so rounding can't leave a
1016+ EE12                      ; gap between the polygon and the screen edge
1017+ EE12 FD 6E 04             ld l,(iy+4)
1018+ EE15 FD 66 05             ld h,(iy+5)                     ; Z
1019+ EE18 3A C9 E0             ld a,(clip_plane)
1020+ EE1B FE 01                cp 1
1021+ EE1D 20 0A                jr nz,.s2
1022+ EE1F FD 36 04 10          ld (iy+4),NEAR                  ; near:   Z = NEAR
1023+ EE23 FD 36 05 00          ld (iy+5),0
1024+ EE27 18 27                jr .nz
1025+ EE29 FE 02        .s2:    cp 2
1026+ EE2B 20 05                jr nz,.s4
1027+ EE2D CD 4A AD             call neg_hl                     ; left:   X = -Z
1028+ EE30 18 18                jr .sx
1029+ EE32 FE 04        .s4:    cp 4
1030+ EE34 28 14                jr z,.sx                        ; right:  X = Z
1031+ EE36 F5           .ty:    push af
1032+ EE37 CD 8A AD             call zhalf
1033+ EE3A F1                   pop af
1034+ EE3B FE 08                cp 8
1035+ EE3D 28 03                jr z,.sy                        ; top:    Y = 0.5Z
1036+ EE3F CD 4A AD             call neg_hl                     ; bottom: Y = -0.5Z
1037+ EE42 FD 75 02     .sy:    ld (iy+2),l
1038+ EE45 FD 74 03             ld (iy+3),h
1039+ EE48 18 06                jr .nz
1040+ EE4A FD 75 00     .sx:    ld (iy+0),l
1041+ EE4D FD 74 01             ld (iy+1),h
1042+ EE50 3A D6 E0     .nz:    ld a,(clip_if)
1043+ EE53 FD 77 06             ld (iy+6),a
1044+ EE56 3A C9 E0             ld a,(clip_plane)               ; new vertex: no cached projection,
1045+ EE59 F6 80                or $80                          ; but remember the plane it is on
1046+ EE5B FD 77 07             ld (iy+7),a
1047+ EE5E 01 08 00             ld bc,8
1048+ EE61 FD 09                add iy,bc
1049+ EE63 21 C7 E0             ld hl,clip_on
1050+ EE66 34                   inc (hl)
1051+ EE67 C9                   ret
1052+ EE68
1053+ EE68              ; A = coordinate offset -> HL = S.c + (E.c - S.c) * t
1054+ EE68              lerp_c:
1055+ EE68 2A D0 E0             ld hl,(clip_e)
1056+ EE6B ED 31                add hl,a
1057+ EE6D 5E                   ld e,(hl)
1058+ EE6E 23                   inc hl
1059+ EE6F 56                   ld d,(hl)
1060+ EE70 2A CE E0             ld hl,(clip_s)
1061+ EE73 ED 31                add hl,a
1062+ EE75 7E                   ld a,(hl)
1063+ EE76 23                   inc hl
1064+ EE77 66                   ld h,(hl)
1065+ EE78 6F                   ld l,a

1277+ F049              ;==============================================================================
1278+ F049              ; Convex polygon fill from p2buf (8-bit screen coords).
1279+ F049              ;   Each edge is walked with an exact integer DDA into one of two x tables:
1280+ F049              ;   downward edges -> TA, upward edges -> TB.  For a convex polygon every row
1281+ F049              ;   then has one entry in each, and the span between them is filled.
1282+ F049              ;   Winding doesn't matter.

1371+ F0BC              ; byte (carry == wrap), so the end point is hit exactly.

1438+ F120 DD 85                add a,ixl
1439+ F122 30 02                jr nc,.nl1
1440+ F124 81                   add a,c
1441+ F125 15                   dec d
1442+ F126 5F           .nl1:   ld e,a
1443+ F127 10 F0                djnz .nl
1444+ F129 C9                   ret
1445+ F12A 7B           .n0s:   ld a,e
1446+ F12B DD 5D                ld e,ixl
1447+ F12D 72           .n0:    ld (hl),d
1448+ F12E 2C                   inc l
1449+ F12F 83                   add a,e
1450+ F130 30 02                jr nc,.n01
1451+ F132 81                   add a,c
1452+ F133 15                   dec d
1453+ F134 10 F7        .n01:   djnz .n0
1454+ F136 C9                   ret
1455+ F137
1456+ F137              ; A vertical edge: the same x on every row (as the steep walk gives it with
1457+ F137              ; no x step: exactly)
1458+ F137 41           .vert:  ld b,c
1459+ F138 04                   inc b                           ; dy+1 rows
1460+ F139 72           .vl:    ld (hl),d
1461+ F13A 2C                   inc l
1462+ F13B 10 FC                djnz .vl
1463+ F13D C9                   ret
1464+ F13E
1465+ F13E              ; B = dy+1 rows, E = biased accumulator (dy/2 - dy), C = -dy
1466+ F13E 41           .setup: ld b,c
1467+ F13F 04                   inc b
1468+ F140 79                   ld a,c
1469+ F141 CB 3F                srl a
1470+ F143 91                   sub c
1471+ F144 5F                   ld e,a
1472+ F145 79                   ld a,c
1473+ F146 ED 44                neg
1474+ F148 4F                   ld c,a
1475+ F149 C9                   ret
1476+ F14A
1477+ F14A              ;==============================================================================
1478+ F14A              ; Span filler.  Rows fy0..fy1, x from TA/TB.  DE = colour pair.
1479+ F14A              ; Short spans use the stack pointer as a 2-byte write pointer into the frame
1480+ F14A              ; buffer (see push_blk), jumping into an unrolled block of PUSH DE.  Spans of
1481+ F14A              ; DMA_SPAN_MIN pixels or more are written by the zxnDMA, which only needs its
1482+ F14A              ; length and destination reloaded (see clear_screen).
1483+ F14A              ; For speed: the stack pointer is kept in IY (ld sp,iy), the rows are
1484+ F14A              ; counted down in IXH, and the table that is the left edge at the polygon's
1485+ F14A              ; middle row is read first, so the left / right swap (still made whenever
1486+ F14A              ; it's needed: a sliver's edges can cross) is mostly skipped.
1487+ F14A              ;==============================================================================
1488+ F14A              fill_spans:
1489+ F14A 3A E9 E0             ld a,(fy0)
1490+ F14D CD 20 E8             call seg_map                    ; first row's section into slot 0
1491+ F150 FD 21 00 00          ld iy,0
1492+ F154 FD 39                add iy,sp                       ; the stack, for push_end
1493+ F156 3A E9 E0             ld a,(fy0)
1494+ F159 47                   ld b,a
1495+ F15A 3A EA E0             ld a,(fy1)
1496+ F15D 90                   sub b
1497+ F15E 3C                   inc a
1498+ F15F DD 67                ld ixh,a                        ; rows to fill
1499+ F161 3A EA E0             ld a,(fy1)                      ; the middle row: which table is left?
1500+ F164 80                   add a,b
1501+ F165 1F                   rra
1502+ F166 6F                   ld l,a
1503+ F167 26 E2                ld h,high TA
1504+ F169 7E                   ld a,(hl)
1505+ F16A 24                   inc h
1506+ F16B BE                   cp (hl)
1507+ F16C 3E E2                ld a,high TA                    ; TA left (or level): TA first
1508+ F16E 0E 24                ld c,$24                        ;   (inc h)
1509+ F170 38 04                jr c,.ta
1510+ F172 3E E3                ld a,high TB                    ; TB left: TB first
1511+ F174 0E 25                ld c,$25                        ;   (dec h)
1512+ F176 32 7E F1     .ta:    ld (fs_loop+1),a
1513+ F179 79                   ld a,c
1514+ F17A 32 81 F1             ld (fs_loop.tb),a
1515+ F17D
1516+ F17D              fs_loop:
1517+ F17D 26 E2                ld h,high TA                    ; (patched: the left table first)
1518+ F17F 68                   ld l,b
1519+ F180 7E                   ld a,(hl)
1520+ F181 24           .tb:    inc h                           ; (patched: inc h, or dec h, the other)
1521+ F182 4E                   ld c,(hl)
1522+ F183 B9                   cp c
1523+ F184 38 03                jr c,.ord
1524+ F186 69                   ld l,c
1525+ F187 4F                   ld c,a
1526+ F188 7D                   ld a,l
1527+ F189 6F           .ord:   ld l,a                          ; A = left x, C = right x
1528+ F18A 78                   ld a,b
1529+ F18B E6 1F                and 31
1530+ F18D 67                   ld h,a                          ; row within the paged section
1531+ F18E 79                   ld a,c
1532+ F18F 95                   sub l                           ; width-1
1533+ F190 FE 13                cp DMA_SPAN_MIN-1
1534+ F192 30 17                jr nc,.dma
1535+ F194 CB 3F        .push:  srl a
1536+ F196 38 07                jr c,.even
1537+ F198 73                   ld (hl),e                       ; odd width: single pixel first
1538+ F199 B7                   or a
1539+ F19A CA 84 E1             jp z,push_next                  ; (1 pixel: no PUSHes, so SP isn't
1540+ F19D 18 01                jr .go                          ; borrowed: see push_blk)
1541+ F19F 3C           .even:  inc a
1542+ F1A0 69           .go:    ld l,c
1543+ F1A1 23                   inc hl                          ; one past right edge (may be $C000)
1544+ F1A2 F9                   ld sp,hl
1545+ F1A3 6F                   ld l,a
1546+ F1A4 3E 80                ld a,low push_end - 1           ; (the DI before the last PUSH)
1547+ F1A6 95                   sub l
1548+ F1A7 6F                   ld l,a
1549+ F1A8 26 E1                ld h,high push_end
1550+ F1AA E9                   jp (hl)
1551+ F1AB                      ASSERT high push_blk == high push_end && low push_end - 1 - 128 == low push_blk
1552+ F1AB
1553+ F1AB                      ; Long span: zxnDMA from the fixed colour byte (port A) to HL.
1554+ F1AB                      ; Everything but length and destination was set up by clear_screen.
1555+ F1AB 3C           .dma:   inc a
1556+ F1AC 20 03                jr nz,.dmal
1557+ F1AE 3D                   dec a                           ; 256 wide: length needs the high
1558+ F1AF 18 E3                jr .push                        ; byte, so PUSH it (A = width-1)
1559+ F1B1              .dmal:
1560+ F1B1 4F                   ld c,a
1561+ F1B2 3E 25                ld a,DMA_WR0_LEN_LO
1562+ F1B4 D3 6B                out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a
1563+ F1B6 79                   ld a,c
1564+ F1B7 D3 6B                out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a    ; length = width
1565+ F1B9 3E AD                ld a,DMA_WR4_CONT_MODE
1566+ F1BB D3 6B                out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a
1567+ F1BD 7D                   ld a,l
1568+ F1BE D3 6B                out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a    ; port B = y*256 + x
1569+ F1C0 7C                   ld a,h
1570+ F1C1 D3 6B                out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a
1571+ F1C3 3E CF                ld a,DMA_LOAD
1572+ F1C5 D3 6B                out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a
1573+ F1C7 3E 87                ld a,DMA_ENABLE
1574+ F1C9 D3 6B                out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a    ; CPU waits until the span is written
1575+ F1CB 04                   inc b                           ; the next row (as push_next: SP was
1576+ F1CC DD 25                dec ixh                         ; never borrowed here)
1577+ F1CE C8                   ret z
1578+ F1CF 78                   ld a,b
1579+ F1D0 E6 1F                and 31
1580+ F1D2 C2 7D F1             jp nz,fs_loop
1581+ F1D5 C3 8E E1             jp push_next.sect
1582+ F1D8                      ASSERT high TB == high TA + 1
1583+ F1D8
1584+ F1D8              ;==============================================================================
1585+ F1D8              ; Outline the polygon in p2buf, skipping edges flagged 0 (clip edges)
1586+ F1D8              ;==============================================================================
1587+ F1D8              outline_poly:
1588+ F1D8 DD 21 80 E0          ld ix,p2buf
1589+ F1DC 3A E8 E0             ld a,(p2n)
1590+ F1DF 47                   ld b,a
1591+ F1E0 C5           .lp:    push bc
1592+ F1E1 DD 7E 02             ld a,(ix+2)
1593+ F1E4 B7                   or a
1594+ F1E5 28 0F                jr z,.sk
1595+ F1E7 DD 6E 00             ld l,(ix+0)
1596+ F1EA DD 66 01             ld h,(ix+1)
1597+ F1ED DD 5E 04             ld e,(ix+4)
1598+ F1F0 DD 56 05             ld d,(ix+5)
1599+ F1F3 CD FF F1             call draw_line
1600+ F1F6 01 04 00     .sk:    ld bc,4
1601+ F1F9 DD 09                add ix,bc
1602+ F1FB C1                   pop bc
1603+ F1FC 10 E2                djnz .lp
1604+ F1FE C9                   ret
1605+ F1FF
1606+ F1FF              ;==============================================================================
1607+ F1FF              ; Bresenham line, on-screen 8-bit coordinates.
1608+ F1FF              ;   L = x0, H = y0, E = x1, D = y1, colour in line_col.  Preserves IX, IY.
1609+ F1FF              ;   Pages Layer 2 sections into slot 0 as the line crosses them.
1610+ F1FF              ;==============================================================================
1611+ F1FF              draw_line:
1612+ F1FF 3A EC E0             ld a,(line_col)
1613+ F202 4F                   ld c,a
1614+ F203 7B                   ld a,e
1615+ F204 95                   sub l
1616+ F205 30 06                jr nc,.xp
1617+ F207 ED 44                neg
1618+ F209 06 2D                ld b,OP_DEC_L
1619+ F20B 18 02                jr .xd
1620+ F20D 06 2C        .xp:    ld b,OP_INC_L
1621+ F20F 5F           .xd:    ld e,a                          ; |dx|
1622+ F210 78                   ld a,b
1623+ F211 32 39 F2             ld (.smx1),a
1624+ F214 32 56 F2             ld (.smx2),a
1625+ F217 7A                   ld a,d
1626+ F218 94                   sub h
1627+ F219 30 06                jr nc,.yp
1628+ F21B ED 44                neg
1629+ F21D 06 25                ld b,OP_DEC_H
1630+ F21F 18 02                jr .yd
1631+ F221 06 24        .yp:    ld b,OP_INC_H
1632+ F223 57           .yd:    ld d,a                          ; |dy|
1633+ F224 78                   ld a,b
1634+ F225 32 3D F2             ld (.smy1),a
1635+ F228 32 4D F2             ld (.smy2),a
1636+ F22B 7C                   ld a,h
1637+ F22C CD 20 E8             call seg_map                    ; page in the start row's section
1638+ F22F 67                   ld h,a                          ; y within the section
1639+ F230 7B                   ld a,e
1640+ F231 BA                   cp d
1641+ F232 38 13                jr c,.ymaj
1642+ F234 43                   ld b,e
1643+ F235 04                   inc b
1644+ F236 CB 3F                srl a
1645+ F238 71           .xl:    ld (hl),c
1646+ F239 2C           .smx1:  inc l
1647+ F23A 92                   sub d
1648+ F23B 30 07                jr nc,.xs
1649+ F23D 24           .smy1:  inc h
1650+ F23E CB 6C                bit 5,h                         ; left the 32-row section?
1651+ F240 C4 37 E8             call nz,line_seg
1652+ F243 83                   add a,e
1653+ F244 10 F2        .xs:    djnz .xl
1654+ F246 C9                   ret
1655+ F247 42           .ymaj:  ld b,d
1656+ F248 04                   inc b
1657+ F249 7A                   ld a,d
1658+ F24A CB 3F                srl a
1659+ F24C 71           .yl:    ld (hl),c
1660+ F24D 24           .smy2:  inc h
1661+ F24E CB 6C                bit 5,h
1662+ F250 C4 37 E8             call nz,line_seg
1663+ F253 93                   sub e
1664+ F254 30 02                jr nc,.ys
1665+ F256 2C           .smx2:  inc l
1666+ F257 82                   add a,d
1667+ F258 10 F2        .ys:    djnz .yl
1668+ F25A C9                   ret
1669+ F25B
1670+ F25B              ;==============================================================================
1671+ F25B              ; Clear the viewport (rows 0..VIEW_H-1) of the back buffer with the zxnDMA,
1672+ F25B              ; one 8K section (32 rows) at a time through slot 0: sky above the horizon
1673+ F25B              ; row, ground below.  The fills are dma_fill's (layer2_cls.asm, resident),
1674+ F25B              ; the l2_fill command block with its destination (port B) and length; the source
1675+ F25B              ; (port A) is the fixed byte l2_cls_byte.  Zero-length fills are skipped.
1676+ F25B              ;==============================================================================
1677+ F25B              clear_screen:
1678+ F25B                  IFDEF REAL_HARDWARE
1679+ F25B ~                    ; DMA+: the sky and the ground as two filled rectangles in the
1680+ F25B ~                    ; buffer at seg_base (dd_rect): no paging, one set-up each
1681+ F25B ~                    call span_arm                   ; (the DMA as the spans want it after)
1682+ F25B ~                    ld a,(horizon)                  ; sky rows = clamp(hz, 0, VIEW_H)
1683+ F25B ~                  IFDEF SKY_IS_WALL
1684+ F25B ~                    inc a                           ; (and the horizon row: see below)
1685+ F25B ~                  ENDIF
1686+ F25B ~                    cp VIEW_H+1
1687+ F25B ~                    jr c,.hs
1688+ F25B ~                    ld a,VIEW_H
1689+ F25B ~            .hs:    ld (cs_sky),a
1690+ F25B ~                    or a
1691+ F25B ~                    jr z,.hg
1692+ F25B ~                    ld b,a                          ; sky: (0, 0), 256 x sky rows
1693+ F25B ~                    ld d,0
1694+ F25B ~                  IFDEF SKY_IS_WALL
1695+ F25B ~                    ld a,WALL_FAMILY*4+SHADE_FACE
1696+ F25B ~                  ELSE
1697+ F25B ~                    ld a,SKY_COL
1698+ F25B ~                  ENDIF
1699+ F25B ~                    call dd_band
1700+ F25B ~            .hg:    ld a,(cs_sky)                   ; ground: under it, to VIEW_H
1701+ F25B ~                    cp VIEW_H
1702+ F25B ~                    jr z,.hd
1703+ F25B ~                    ld d,a
1704+ F25B ~                    neg
1705+ F25B ~                    add a,VIEW_H
1706+ F25B ~                    ld b,a
1707+ F25B ~                    ld a,GROUND_COL
1708+ F25B ~                    call dd_band
1709+ F25B ~            .hd:    jp dd_spans                     ; (the rectangles' flags off again)
1710+ F25B                  ENDIF
1711+ F25B 0E 00                ld c,0                          ; C = first row of the section
1712+ F25D 79           .sec:   ld a,c
1713+ F25E CD 20 E8             call seg_map
1714+ F261 3A 9B B4             ld a,(horizon)                  ; sky rows here = clamp(hz - C, 0, 32)
1715+ F264                  IFDEF SKY_IS_WALL
1716+ F264 3C                   inc a                           ; the horizon row too: at the horizon
1717+ F265                                                      ; it is all distant wall, and it hides
1718+ F265                                                      ; a 1-row rounding gap under the
1719+ F265                                                      ; wall's top edge when pitched
1720+ F265                  ENDIF
1721+ F265 91                   sub c
1722+ F266 30 01                jr nc,.s1
1723+ F268 AF                   xor a
1724+ F269 FE 21        .s1:    cp 33
1725+ F26B 38 02                jr c,.s2
1726+ F26D 3E 20                ld a,32
1727+ F26F 32 EE E0     .s2:    ld (cs_sky),a
1728+ F272 B7                   or a
1729+ F273 28 0D                jr z,.gnd
1730+ F275 C5                   push bc
1731+ F276 47                   ld b,a                          ; sky: section start, rows*256 bytes
1732+ F277 0E 00                ld c,0
1733+ F279 21 00 00             ld hl,0
1734+ F27C                  IFDEF SKY_IS_WALL
1735+ F27C 3E 01                ld a,WALL_FAMILY*4+SHADE_FACE   ; "sky" is the perimeter wall
1736+ F27E                  ELSE
1737+ F27E ~                    ld a,SKY_COL
1738+ F27E                  ENDIF
1739+ F27E CD 85 A3             call dma_fill
1740+ F281 C1                   pop bc
1741+ F282 3A EE E0     .gnd:   ld a,(cs_sky)
1742+ F285 FE 20                cp 32
1743+ F287 28 11                jr z,.nx
1744+ F289 C5                   push bc
1745+ F28A 67                   ld h,a                          ; ground: after the sky rows
1746+ F28B 2E 00                ld l,0
1747+ F28D ED 44                neg
1748+ F28F C6 20                add a,32
1749+ F291 47                   ld b,a
1750+ F292 0E 00                ld c,0
1751+ F294 3E 07                ld a,GROUND_COL
1752+ F296 CD 85 A3             call dma_fill
1753+ F299 C1                   pop bc
1754+ F29A 79           .nx:    ld a,c
1755+ F29B C6 20                add a,32
1756+ F29D 4F                   ld c,a
1757+ F29E FE 80                cp VIEW_H
1758+ F2A0 20 BB                jr nz,.sec
1759+ F2A2                      ; Leave the DMA ready for fill_spans: length high byte 0, so each span
1760+ F2A2                      ; only reloads length low, destination, LOAD and ENABLE.  fill_poly
1761+ F2A2                      ; puts each building's colour in the source byte l2_cls_byte.
1762+ F2A2              .spans:
1763+ F2A2                  IFDEF REAL_HARDWARE
1764+ F2A2 ~                    jp span_arm
1765+ F2A2                  ELSE
1766+ F2A2 3E 45                ld a,DMA_WR0_LEN_HI
1767+ F2A4 D3 6B                out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a
1768+ F2A6 AF                   xor a
1769+ F2A7 D3 6B                out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a
1770+ F2A9 C9                   ret
1771+ F2AA                  ENDIF
1772+ F2AA
1773+ F2AA                  IFDEF REAL_HARDWARE
1774+ F2AA ~            ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1775+ F2AA ~            ; DMA+ (real hardware: docs/ZXNDDMA.md)
1776+ F2AA ~            ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1777+ F2AA ~            ; The DMA set up for the spans: reset, port A the fixed byte l2_cls_byte (not
1778+ F2AA ~            ; read: fill mode), length 0 (each span reloads its low byte), port B
1779+ F2AA ~            ; counting up, continuous, stop at the end; fill mode on (fill_poly sends
1780+ F2AA ~            ; each face's colour as the fill value).  Then fill_spans' short reload
1781+ F2AA ~            ; (length low, destination, load, enable) is all a span needs.
1782+ F2AA ~            span_arm:
1783+ F2AA ~                    ld hl,sa_cmds
1784+ F2AA ~                    ld bc,SA_N<<8 | IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT
1785+ F2AA ~                    otir
1786+ F2AA ~                    ret
1787+ F2AA ~            sa_cmds:    db DMA_DISABLE, DMA_RESET
1788+ F2AA ~                        db DMA_WRO_BLOCK_PORTA_A2B_XFR
1789+ F2AA ~                        dw l2_cls_byte, 0
1790+ F2AA ~                        db DMA_WR1_P1FIXED_MEMORY, DMA_WR2_P2INC_MEMORY
1791+ F2AA ~                        db DMA_WR4_CONT_MODE
1792+ F2AA ~                        dw 0
1793+ F2AA ~                        db DMA_STOP_AT_END
1794+ F2AA ~                        db DDMA_MODE, DDMA_FLAG_FILL
1795+ F2AA ~            SA_N        equ $ - sa_cmds
1796+ F2AA ~
1797+ F2AA ~            ; A filled rectangle in the Layer 2 buffer being drawn (seg_base: its first
1798+ F2AA ~            ; 8K page; 256x192, a row 256 bytes on), by its physical address, so with no
1799+ F2AA ~            ; paging: E = x, D = y, C = width (0 = 256), B = height (1 or more), A =
1800+ F2AA ~            ; colour.  Port B: $40000 + seg_base * $2000 + y * 256 + x, stride 256, 2D,
1801+ F2AA ~            ; fill.  (Not the X,Y form on the hidden screen: the level's start clears
1802+ F2AA ~            ; both buffers before NextReg $13 is set.)  Over the spans' set-up
1803+ F2AA ~            ; (span_arm); leaves the rectangle's flags on: dd_spans puts the spans'
1804+ F2AA ~            ; back.
1805+ F2AA ~            dd_rect:
1806+ F2AA ~                    push af
1807+ F2AA ~                    ld a,DDMA_ROW_LEN               ; row length: the width
1808+ F2AA ~                    out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a
1809+ F2AA ~                    ld a,c
1810+ F2AA ~                    out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a
1811+ F2AA ~                    or a
1812+ F2AA ~                    ld a,0
1813+ F2AA ~                    jr nz,.w
1814+ F2AA ~                    inc a                           ; (0: 256)
1815+ F2AA ~            .w:     out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a
1816+ F2AA ~                    ld a,DDMA_ROWS                  ; rows: the height
1817+ F2AA ~                    out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a
1818+ F2AA ~                    ld a,b
1819+ F2AA ~                    out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a
1820+ F2AA ~                    xor a
1821+ F2AA ~                    out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a
1822+ F2AA ~                    ld a,DDMA_FILL_VALUE            ; the colour
1823+ F2AA ~                    out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a
1824+ F2AA ~                    pop af
1825+ F2AA ~                    out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a
1826+ F2AA ~                    ld a,(seg_base)                 ; the address: bits 23:16 = 4 +
1827+ F2AA ~                    ld l,a                          ; seg_base / 8,
1828+ F2AA ~                    rrca
1829+ F2AA ~                    rrca
1830+ F2AA ~                    rrca
1831+ F2AA ~                    and 31
1832+ F2AA ~                    add a,4
1833+ F2AA ~                    ld h,a
1834+ F2AA ~                    ld a,l                          ; 15:8 = (seg_base & 7) * 32 + y
1835+ F2AA ~                    and 7
1836+ F2AA ~                    rrca
1837+ F2AA ~                    rrca
1838+ F2AA ~                    rrca
1839+ F2AA ~                    add a,d
1840+ F2AA ~                    jr nc,.nc
1841+ F2AA ~                    inc h
1842+ F2AA ~            .nc:    ld l,a
1843+ F2AA ~                    ld a,DDMA_B_EXT
1844+ F2AA ~                    out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a
1845+ F2AA ~                    ld a,h
1846+ F2AA ~                    out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a
1847+ F2AA ~                    ld a,DMA_WR4_CONT_MODE          ; 7:0 = x
1848+ F2AA ~                    out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a
1849+ F2AA ~                    ld a,e
1850+ F2AA ~                    out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a
1851+ F2AA ~                    ld a,l
1852+ F2AA ~                    out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a
1853+ F2AA ~                    ld a,DDMA_B_STRIDE              ; a row on: 256
1854+ F2AA ~                    out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a
1855+ F2AA ~                    xor a
1856+ F2AA ~                    out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a
1857+ F2AA ~                    inc a
1858+ F2AA ~                    out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a
1859+ F2AA ~                    ld a,DDMA_MODE                  ; physical, 2D, fill
1860+ F2AA ~                    out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a
1861+ F2AA ~                    ld a,DDMA_RECT
1862+ F2AA ~                    out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a
1863+ F2AA ~                    ld a,DMA_LOAD
1864+ F2AA ~                    out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a
1865+ F2AA ~                    ld a,DMA_ENABLE
1866+ F2AA ~                    out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a    ; (the CPU waits while it fills)
1867+ F2AA ~                    ret
1868+ F2AA ~
1869+ F2AA ~            ; Full-width rows D .. D+B-1 (B 1 or more) filled with A, as rectangles of at
1870+ F2AA ~            ; most DD_MAX_ROWS rows: each DMA burst holds the bus (and the 50 Hz
1871+ F2AA ~            ; interrupt, the sound) no longer than the old clear's 8K sections did
1872+ F2AA ~            DD_MAX_ROWS     equ 32
1873+ F2AA ~            dd_band:
1874+ F2AA ~                    ld (db_col),a
1875+ F2AA ~            .lp:    ld a,b
1876+ F2AA ~                    cp DD_MAX_ROWS+1
1877+ F2AA ~                    jr c,.n

1884+ F2AA ~                    push de

1886+ F2AA ~                    ld c,0                          ; (256 wide)
1887+ F2AA ~                    ld a,(db_col)

1890+ F2AA ~                    pop af
1891+ F2AA ~                    ret z
1892+ F2AA ~                    ld b,a
1893+ F2AA ~                    ld a,d
1894+ F2AA ~                    add a,DD_MAX_ROWS
1895+ F2AA ~                    ld d,a
1896+ F2AA ~                    jr .lp
1897+ F2AA ~            db_col:     db 0                        ; dd_band: the colour

1899+ F2AA ~            ; The spans' flags back after rectangles: fill mode, MMU addresses, no 2D

1901+ F2AA ~                    ld a,DDMA_MODE
1902+ F2AA ~                    out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a
1903+ F2AA ~                    ld a,DDMA_FLAG_FILL
1904+ F2AA ~                    out (IO_DATAGEAR_DMA_PORT),a

1906+ F2AA ~
1907+ F2AA ~            ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1908+ F2AA ~            ; Block fill (in place of fill_spans): the face's rows fy0..fy1 (its edges in
1909+ F2AA ~            ; TA / TB, after the edge walk), DE = its colour pair, the DMA's fill value
1910+ F2AA ~            ; its colour (fill_poly).  Rows are taken in runs: a run goes on while each
1911+ F2AA ~            ; row's left and right x are the last row's.  A run of BLOCK_ROWS rows or
1912+ F2AA ~            ; more, BLOCK_W pixels wide or more, is one DMA+ rectangle (dd_rect: no
1913+ F2AA ~            ; paging, one set-up); the rows between such runs go to fill_spans as they
1914+ F2AA ~            ; are.  The same pixels as fill_spans alone: the render tests hold.
1915+ F2AA ~            ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1916+ F2AA ~                IFDEF BLOCK_ROWS_SET            ; (-DBLOCK_ROWS_SET=n, -DBLOCK_W_SET=n:
1917+ F2AA ~            BLOCK_ROWS      equ BLOCK_ROWS_SET  ;   to try others)
1918+ F2AA ~                ELSE
1919+ F2AA ~            BLOCK_ROWS      equ 4               ; a rectangle: at least this many rows,
1920+ F2AA ~                ENDIF
1921+ F2AA ~                IFDEF BLOCK_W_SET
1922+ F2AA ~            BLOCK_W         equ BLOCK_W_SET
1923+ F2AA ~                ELSE
1924+ F2AA ~            BLOCK_W         equ 8               ;   this many pixels wide
1925+ F2AA ~                ENDIF

1928+ F2AA ~                    ld a,(fy1)
1929+ F2AA ~                    ld (fb_end),a
1930+ F2AA ~                    ld a,(fy0)
1931+ F2AA ~                    ld (fb_s),a                     ; the first row not drawn yet
1932+ F2AA ~                    ld c,a                          ; C = the run's first row
1933+ F2AA ~                    xor a
1934+ F2AA ~                    ld (fb_rect),a                  ; (no rectangle yet: no flags to undo)
1935+ F2AA ~            .run:   ld l,c                          ; its edges: D = TA, E = TB
1936+ F2AA ~                    ld h,high TA
1937+ F2AA ~                    ld d,(hl)
1938+ F2AA ~                    inc h
1939+ F2AA ~                    ld e,(hl)
1940+ F2AA ~                    dec h
1941+ F2AA ~                    ld a,(fb_end)                   ; B = the rows after it to look at
1942+ F2AA ~                    sub c
1943+ F2AA ~                    jr z,.last
1944+ F2AA ~                    cp DD_MAX_ROWS                  ; (a run of DD_MAX_ROWS at most: a
1945+ F2AA ~                    jr c,.b                         ; DMA burst no longer than 8K)
1946+ F2AA ~                    ld a,DD_MAX_ROWS-1
1947+ F2AA ~            .b:     ld b,a
1948+ F2AA ~            .ext:   inc l                           ; on while both edges are the same
1949+ F2AA ~                    ld a,(hl)
1950+ F2AA ~                    cp d
1951+ F2AA ~                    jr nz,.brk
1952+ F2AA ~                    inc h
1953+ F2AA ~                    ld a,(hl)

1955+ F2AA ~                    cp e
1956+ F2AA ~                    jr nz,.brk
1957+ F2AA ~                    djnz .ext
1958+ F2AA ~            .last:  inc l                           ; (to the last row: L one past it)
1959+ F2AA ~            .brk:   ld a,l                          ; the run: rows C .. L-1
1960+ F2AA ~                    ld (fb_next),a
1961+ F2AA ~                    sub c
1962+ F2AA ~                    cp BLOCK_ROWS

1964+ F2AA ~                    ld b,a                          ; B = rows
1965+ F2AA ~                    ld a,d                          ; width - 1 = |TA - TB|: left = min

1973+ F2AA ~                    ld (fb_w),a

1982+ F2AA ~                    ld a,(fb_x)                     ; the run: one rectangle
1983+ F2AA ~                    ld e,a
1984+ F2AA ~                    ld a,(fb_y0)
1985+ F2AA ~                    ld d,a
1986+ F2AA ~                    ld a,(fb_w)
1987+ F2AA ~                    ld c,a
1988+ F2AA ~                    ld a,(fb_rows)
1989+ F2AA ~                    ld b,a
1990+ F2AA ~                    ld a,(fb_de)
1991+ F2AA ~                    call dd_rect

1993+ F2AA ~                    ld (fb_rect),a

1995+ F2AA ~                    ld (fb_s),a

2048+ F2AA              ; City traversal - back to front without sorting.
2049+ F2AA              ;   For grid-aligned boxes in separate cells, a box can only hide boxes whose
2050+ F2AA              ;   cell offsets from the camera cell are larger (or equal) on both axes in
2051+ F2AA              ;   the same quadrant.  So: rows from the far edges inwards, and within each
2052+ F2AA              ;   row columns from the far edges inwards, the camera row/column last.
2053+ F2AA              ;==============================================================================

2097+ F304              ; The cell walks (draw_row here, occ_row in city2.asm) keep the cell's
2098+ F304              ; yaw-space centre (X, Z1) in the alternate registers HL', DE' (nothing else

2161+ F3D9
2162+ F3D9              ; The rows the cell walks can skip this frame: row_skip[j - cz + view_r] not
2163+ F3D9              ; 0 if every cell in row j would be skipped by WALK_TRY.  Its tests are
2164+ F3D9              ; linear along a row (X and Z1 are), so a row is out if both its end cells
2165+ F3D9              ; (cx -/+ view_r, the walk's starts) are past the same edge: right, X - Z1 >=
2166+ F3D9              ; WALK_R; left, -X - Z1 >= WALK_R; behind, -Z1 >= WALK_R (pitched: only
2167+ F3D9              ; behind, as WALK_TRY).  So the camera column's cell, which the walks try
2168+ F3D9              ; without WALK_TRY, is out too.  X = dx cosY - dz sinY, Z1 = dx sinY + dz
2169+ F3D9              ; cosY, by fmul as row_start's rot_yaw, the dz terms stepped by sinY and
2170+ F3D9              ; cosY a row (fmul(256, f) is f exactly); ROW_M covers the rounding (each
2171+ F3D9              ; of these and the walk's own within 2).
2172+ F3D9              ROW_M           equ 8

   2+ 8000              ; Z-POLICE - the second city page (8K page PAGE_CITY2, runs at $8000 in slot
   3+ 8000              ; 4: CITY2_MMU)
   4+ 8000              ;
   5+ 8000              ; More of the Layer 2 drawing, paged in beside the city page (slot 7) for the
   6+ 8000              ; city part of each frame: main_loop maps it over the ULA screen after
   7+ 8000              ; clear_screen and puts the ULA screen back before draw_hud.  Nothing in that
   8+ 8000              ; part of the frame uses the ULA screen (the video hardware shows it from
   9+ 8000              ; bank 5 whatever the CPU has mapped), and the interrupt routine uses only
  10+ 8000              ; slots 1 and 5, so interrupts stay on.  Both pages are mapped together, so
  11+ 8000              ; code and data in either call or use the other directly (labels are global).
  12+ 8000              ;
  13+ 8000              ; Here: the street dots, the bullets, rockets and particles, the gunsight and
  14+ 8000              ; the occlusion culling.  Their variables stay in the city page.  Anything
  15+ 8000              ; that calls into this page from outside main_loop's city part must map it
  16+ 8000              ; first (nextreg CITY2_MMU,PAGE_CITY2) and put the ULA screen back after.
  17+ 8000              ;==============================================================================

  19+ 8000              ;==============================================================================
  20+ 8000              ; Street intersection markers - one dot per grid corner near the camera
  21+ 8000              ; whose 4 cells are all open: no building, terrace or pad cell touches it
  22+ 8000              ; (out of bounds counts as open: it is never drawn).  A corner a building
  23+ 8000              ; touches is always drawn over by it (its faces cover their own corners, and
  24+ 8000              ; the box hides those behind it), so it isn't worked out at all.
  25+ 8000              ;   A row's corners have cells j-1 above and j below; each corner shares its
  26+ 8000              ; left pair of cells with the corner before, so one pair is read a corner.
  27+ 8000              ; An open corner's (X, Z1) is its row's first corner's (worked out once, by
  28+ 8000              ; full rotation, only if the row has an open corner) + k (cosY, sinY), k its
  29+ 8000              ; column in the row: exactly what stepping +256 world units k times gives.
  30+ 8000              ;==============================================================================

 857+ 85EB
 858+ 85EB                  IFDEF OCCLUSION_CULL
 859+ 85EB              ;==============================================================================
 860+ 85EB              ; Occlusion culling (OCCLUSION_CULL; pitched too with OCC_PITCHED, up to
 861+ 85EB              ; OCC_PMAX: then the columns are tilted, see occ_test and occ_pretest.pit)
 862+ 85EB              ;
 863+ 85EB              ; In level flight every screen column is a vertical slice of the world through
 864+ 85EB              ; the camera.  The cells are walked in exactly the reverse of the painter's
 865+ 85EB              ; order, i.e. front to back.  Each building is transformed as usual, then
 866+ 85EB              ; tested against OCC_YBUF, which holds per column the row from which the
 867+ 85EB              ; screen is known to be covered down to the ground:
 868+ 85EB              ;   * hidden - in every column it spans, its highest point is no higher than
 869+ 85EB              ;     that row - it is dropped;
 870+ 85EB              ;   * otherwise it lowers the row across its columns to its lowest top
 871+ 85EB              ;     corner, and its corners and face settings are kept in a record.
 872+ 85EB              ; The kept buildings and the zombie cells are then drawn back to front.
 873+ 85EB              ; This is safe because buildings that share a column meet the walk front to
 874+ 85EB              ; back (the grid order guarantees it), the camera is above the ground (what
 875+ 85EB              ; is behind sits higher on screen), the cover row is the lowest top corner
 876+ 85EB              ; (an underestimate) and bounds are clamped inwards to the screen.  A
 877+ 85EB              ; building with a corner behind the camera is never dropped and never covers.
 878+ 85EB              ;==============================================================================
 879+ 85EB              OCC_YBUF        equ $4000       ; per column: covered from this row down
 880+ 85EB              OCC_YBUF8       equ $4200       ; per 8 columns: at least the most of
 881+ 85EB                                              ; OCC_YBUF's 8 (its own page, before the
 882+ 85EB                                              ; records), so a hidden test can pass 8
 883+ 85EB                                              ; columns at once
 884+ 85EB              OCC_LIST        equ $4100       ; kept buildings and zombie cells, 2 bytes each
 885+ 85EB              OCC_REC0        equ $43         ; the records' first page; two records a
 886+ 85EB              OCC_RECN        equ $60         ; page (128 bytes each, at +0 and +128), up
 887+ 85EB                                              ; to $5F: 58 records ($6000 on: city_col).
 888+ 85EB                                              ; The busiest street view at the full draw
 889+ 85EB                                              ; distance (8 tiles) keeps 35.
 890+ 85EB              ; Record: copy of vtx's 8 corners, bytes 0-8 of each 16 (X, Y, Z, outcode,
 891+ 85EB              ; sx, sy), at the same offsets from the record's start, and in the first
 892+ 85EB              ; corner's spare bytes
 893+ 85EB              OR_VIS          equ 9           ; bld_vis, bld_mx, bld_mz, col_x, col_z, col_top,
 894+ 85EB              OR_N            equ 7           ;   bld_cut
 895+ 85EB                      ASSERT OR_VIS + OR_N <= 16
 896+ 85EB                      ASSERT bld_cut == bld_vis + OR_N - 1
 897+ 85EB                      ASSERT low OCC_YBUF8 == 0       ; (occ_cut: the low byte is the group)
 898+ 85EB              ; A record in a page's upper half is drawn with the +128 corner lists
 899+ 85EB              ; (face_set = FACE_SET2, city.asm).
 900+ 85EB              ; A list entry is a record's address ($4300-$5FFF), a cell with humans as
 901+ 85EB              ; its city_col address ($6000-$6FFF) or a cell with zombies as its city_map
 902+ 85EB              ; address ($7000-$7FFF).
 903+ 85EB
 904+ 85EB              ; Start of the city: occlusion on in level flight (and with OCC_PITCHED
 905+ 85EB              ; up to OCC_PMAX)
 906+ 85EB              occ_begin:
 907+ 85EB AF                   xor a
 908+ 85EC 32 CF FB             ld (occ_on),a
 909+ 85EF 32 D0 FB             ld (occ_full),a
 910+ 85F2                  IFNDEF OCC_PITCHED
 911+ 85F2 ~                    ld a,(pitch)
 912+ 85F2 ~                    or a
 913+ 85F2 ~                    ret nz
 914+ 85F2                  ELSE
 915+ 85F2 3A 9A AD             ld a,(pitch)                    ; pitched past OCC_PMAX: the plain way
 916+ 85F5 CB 7F                bit 7,a                         ; (the sides lean too far, the bounds
 917+ 85F7 28 02                jr z,.pp                        ; are loose: it costs more than it
 918+ 85F9 ED 44                neg                             ; saves)
 919+ 85FB FE 13        .pp:    cp OCC_PMAX+1
 920+ 85FD D0                   ret nc
 921+ 85FE 21 78 01             ld hl,2*OCC_R                   ; occ_pretest's pitched bounds
 922+ 8601 ED 5B A2 B4          ld de,(cos_p)
 923+ 8605 CD 56 AD             call fmul
 924+ 8608 22 E4 FB             ld (o_kc),hl                    ; 2R cosP
 925+ 860B 21 78 01             ld hl,2*OCC_R
 926+ 860E ED 5B A0 B4          ld de,(sin_p)

 929+ 8617 20 03                jr nz,.ks
 930+ 8619 21 00 00             ld hl,0
 931+ 861C 22 E6 FB     .ks:    ld (o_ks),hl                    ; min(0, 2R sinP)
 932+ 861F AF                   xor a
 933+ 8620                  ENDIF

 936+ 8624 21 00 41             ld hl,OCC_LIST
 937+ 8627 22 D1 FB             ld (occ_lp),hl
 938+ 862A 21 00 43             ld hl,OCC_REC0*256
 939+ 862D 22 D3 FB             ld (occ_rp),hl

 946+ 8641 36 80                ld (hl),VIEW_H
 947+ 8643 11 01 42             ld de,OCC_YBUF8+1

 949+ 8649 ED B0                ldir

 979+ 867A              ; One row front to back.  (X, Z1) is the walk's, in HL', DE' (as draw_row's,

   1+ 4000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ 4000              ; Z-POLICE - Layer 2 320x256 graphics (8K page PAGE_L320, runs at $4000 in
   3+ 4000              ; slot 2)
   4+ 4000              ;
   5+ 4000              ; For the screens outside the game: the menus, the load-out, level complete
   6+ 4000              ; and game over.  They're mostly text, so they use Layer 2's 320x256 mode
   7+ 4000              ; (40 x 32 characters of 8x8, the whole screen, border included) in place of
   8+ 4000              ; the ULA.  This page has everything they draw with:
   9+ 4000              ;   l320_mode320 / l320_mode256   switch the display to 320x256 / back to the
  10+ 4000              ;                                 game's 256x192
  11+ 4000              ;   l320_screen                   a screen's start: cleared, framed, shown
  12+ 4000              ;                                 (screen320, text.asm, calls it)
  13+ 4000              ;   l320_cls                      clear the screen to a colour (by DMA)
  14+ 4000              ;   l320_at, l320_pos             set the text position (character / pixel)
  15+ 4000              ;   l320_char, l320_print,        text: one character, a string (with colour
  16+ 4000              ;   l320_print_at,                  and position codes), a string at a row
  17+ 4000              ;   l320_print_list                 and column (menu_print's registers), a
  18+ 4000              ;                                   table of strings
  19+ 4000              ;   l320_recolour, l320_swap      change colours already drawn: a run of
  20+ 4000              ;                                 text cells (highlighting), or one colour in
  21+ 4000              ;                                 a box
  22+ 4000              ;   l320_plot, l320_line,         pixels, lines, filled boxes, outlines
  23+ 4000              ;   l320_fill, l320_hline,
  24+ 4000              ;   l320_vline, l320_box
  25+ 4000              ;
  26+ 4000              ; Use: page it in, switch, clear, draw:
  27+ 4000              ;       nextreg L320_MMU,PAGE_L320      ; this page at $4000 (slot 2)
  28+ 4000              ;       ld a,L320_BLACK
  29+ 4000              ;       call l320_cls
  30+ 4000              ;       call l320_mode320
  31+ 4000              ; and on leaving for the game, switch back and put the occlusion page back
  32+ 4000              ; in slot 2 (l2_game_mode, zpolice.asm, does both).
  33+ 4000              ;
  34+ 4000              ; Slot 2 is the occlusion data's, used only while the city is drawn, so it
  35+ 4000              ; is free on these screens: they run in slot 6, with the keys (and the
  36+ 4000              ; sprites, sound, file handler) in slot 7, the resident page in slot 5, the
  37+ 4000              ; zombie page (and the IM 2 table) in slot 1 and the city bank in slot 3.
  38+ 4000              ;
  39+ 4000              ; The screen: 5 16K banks from L2_BANK_A (banks 9-13, pages 18-27: the first
  40+ 4000              ; game buffer and part of the second, unused while these screens are up;
  41+ 4000              ; the game clears both before it draws).  320x256 is column-major: pixel
  42+ 4000              ; (x, y) is byte x*256 + y, so each 8K page is 32 columns of 256 pixels and
  43+ 4000              ; a column's pixels are in one page.  Writes go through slot 0, as the game's
  44+ 4000              ; do: (x, y) is page 18 + x/32, at $0000 + (x & 31)*256 + y.
  45+ 4000              ;
  46+ 4000              ; Colours: Layer 2's second palette, set to RRRGGGBB (the colour is the
  47+ 4000              ; byte; the level's palette is the first one and is left alone).  $E3 is
  48+ 4000              ; the transparency colour: it is never drawn, and as a paper it means "leave
  49+ 4000              ; the background" (L320_NOPAPER).
  50+ 4000              ;
  51+ 4000              ; Registers: every routine may change AF, BC, DE, HL unless it says so; IX,
  52+ 4000              ; IY and the alternate set are kept.  The text uses the resident 8x8 font
  53+ 4000              ; (font8, text.asm: ASCII 32-95; lower case is drawn as upper case).
  54+ 4000              ;==============================================================================
  55+ 4000

 322+ E200              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 323+ E200              ; Weapon slots: a column for each, at columns WPN_COL0, +2, ... in the order
 324+ E200              ; wpn_order (as numbered on keys 1-5: 2 4 1 5 3).  From the top:
 325+ E200              ;   * row WPN_NUM_ROW: its slot number, yellow if selected; none if unused;
 326+ E200              ;   * rows WPN_ROW..: a bar 1 character wide and WPN_BAR high, its ammo one
 327+ E200              ;     digit a row in black, hundreds at the top (infinite ammo: INF).  Green;
 328+ E200              ;     red with no ammo left; black if unused.  An unused slot that was asked
 329+ E200              ;     for flashes amber / black (WFLASH frames each, 3 times);
 330+ E200              ;   * row WPN_LTR_ROW: the letter of its weapon (wpn_glyph), yellow if
 331+ E200              ;     selected.
 332+ E200              ; The selected slot also has a yellow line above and below the bar, in the
 333+ E200              ; number's and the letter's cells (a cell has one ink: in the bar's they
 334+ E200              ; would be black).  Checked every frame, redrawn only when it changes
 335+ E200              ; (wd_shown).
 336+ E200              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 337+ E200              WPN_ATTR_ON     equ C_OK<<3             ; paper green, ink black
 338+ E200              WPN_ATTR_OUT    equ C_WARN<<3           ; paper red
 339+ E200              WPN_ATTR_OFF    equ P_EMPTY<<3          ; paper black
 340+ E200              WPN_ATTR_FLASH  equ C_AMBER<<3          ; paper amber
 341+ E200              WPN_NUM_ATTR    equ P_PANEL<<3 | 7
 342+ E200              WPN_SEL_ATTR    equ P_PANEL<<3 | C_YEL
 343+ E200              WPN_BMP         equ ULA_BMP + (WPN_ROW/8)*$800 + (WPN_ROW&7)*32 + WPN_COL0
 344+ E200                      ASSERT WPN_NUM_ROW/8 == WPN_LTR_ROW/8   ; the rows in one third
 345+ E200                      ASSERT WPN_COL0 + 2*(WPN_SLOTS-1) < MAP_COL

 687+ E44A              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 688+ E44A              ; Layer 2 double buffering with the hardware shadow register.
 689+ E44A              ;   NextReg $12 = active bank (on screen), NextReg $13 = shadow bank.

 691+ E44A              ; vertical blank, so the registers themselves record which buffer is which.

 694+ E44A              ;==============================================================================
 695+ E44A              ; HUD: the weapon slots, and the speed, altitude and ground height gauges
 696+ E44A              ; (the humans and the compass are hardware sprites: hud_sprites.asm).  The
 697+ E44A              ; gauges are vertical bars on Layer 2 (in the back buffer, every frame)
 698+ E44A              ; behind transparent ULA cells: the
 699+ E44A              ; altitude and ground bars share one 8-pixel cell column, which ULA
 700+ E44A              ; attributes couldn't colour (green, amber and black in one cell).
 701+ E44A              ;==============================================================================
 702+ E44A              draw_hud:

 716+ E45D              ;   S  speed, 8 wide: (speed * 55) / 32 pixels, so SPEED_MAX 28 fills it;
 717+ E45D              ;      green, red when reversing, amber while boosting (full: BOOST_SPEED is
 718+ E45D              ;      past the top)
 719+ E45D              ;   A  left 4 pixels: altitude, green; right 4: the height of the city tile
 720+ E45D              ;      under the craft (0 on a road), amber.  Both 1 pixel per 4 units, so
 721+ E45D              ;      the ceiling (MAX_Y, 179) nearly fills the bar, 44 of 48; with the
 722+ E45D              ;      vertical thrusters 1 per 8, so their ceiling (MAX_Y_THRUST, 384) does.
 723+ E45D              ;      A tile taller than the bar's top fills it.  The ground under the
 724+ E45D              ;      craft is always lower, so the gap between them is the clearance.
 725+ E45D              ;   B  the booster's fuel, 8 wide: fuel * 62 / 256 pixels, so BOOST_FUEL_MAX
 726+ E45D              ;      (200) fills it; green.  Drawn always, but its cells are opaque panel

# file opened: input.asm
   1+ E000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ E000              ; Z-POLICE - input: keyboard and joysticks (8K page PAGE_INPUT, runs at
   3+ E000              ; $E000 in slot 7: main_loop and the menu page it in, and the game logic
   4+ E000              ; pages in slot 6 call it)
   5+ E000              ;
   6+ E000              ; Redefinable controls.  An input (a key, or a joystick direction or button)
   7+ E000              ; is a 16-bit code: high byte = input bank, low byte = bit mask within it.
   8+ E000              ;   banks 0-7: the ZX Spectrum keyboard half-rows (port $xxFE, address line
   9+ E000              ;              A8+bank low): read 0 = pressed
  10+ E000              ;   bank 8:    NextReg $B0, Extended Keys 0: read 1 = pressed
  11+ E000              ;   bank 9:    NextReg $B1, Extended Keys 1: read 1 = pressed
  12+ E000              ;   bank 10:   port $1F, Kempston 1 / Mega Drive 1 (J1_*): read 1 = pressed
  13+ E000              ;   bank 11:   port $37, Kempston 2 / Mega Drive 2 (J2_*): read 1 = pressed
  14+ E000              ;   bank 12:   NextReg $B2, the 6-button Mega Drive pads' X, Y, Z and MODE
  15+ E000              ;              (left connector J1_*, right J2_*): read 1 = pressed
  16+ E000              ; A joystick bank is read only while a joystick is set (NextReg $05, the
  17+ E000              ; Next's joystick modes) to the port it reads, else it is 0: so an unused
  18+ E000              ; port can't read as everything pressed.  Joysticks in Sinclair or Cursor
  19+ E000              ; mode enter keys (6-0, 1-5, 5-8) and are read as keys.
  20+ E000              ; kbd_scan, once per frame at the top of the main loop, reads all the banks
  21+ E000              ; into key_now, inverting the ZX rows so that every bank holds 1 = pressed,
  22+ E000              ; and keeps the previous scan in key_prev.  The game asks about actions
  23+ E000              ; (K_FIRE, K_LEFT, ...), not inputs: each action has a key (key_defs) and a
  24+ E000              ; joystick input (joy_defs; 0 = none), either of which works, so both can
  25+ E000              ; be redefined (key_define) at any time.
  26+ E000              ;   key_held    A = action -> NZ if its key or joystick input is down
  27+ E000              ;   key_pressed A = action -> NZ if its key or joystick input went down
  28+ E000              ;               since the last scan
  29+ E000              ;   key_find    -> NZ and HL = code of an input that is down (for a
  30+ E000              ;               redefine screen); Z if none
  31+ E000              ;   key_code_pressed  HL = key code -> NZ if that key went down
  32+ E000              ; The Next normally also enters the extended keys into the 8x5 matrix (e.g.
  33+ E000              ; cursor LEFT as CAPS SHIFT + 5).  NextReg $68 bit 4 stops that: set it with
  34+ E000              ; kbd_double_on (KBD_STOP_DOUBLING = TRUE), clear it with kbd_double_off
  35+ E000              ; (FALSE, the default).
  36+ E000              ;==============================================================================
  37+ E000

 252+ E095              ; A = a Kempston / Mega Drive port read -> A, or 0 if it reads left and

 263+ E09E              ; Stop the extended keys also appearing in the 8x5 matrix:
 264+ E09E              ; KBD_STOP_DOUBLING = TRUE, NextReg $68 bit 4 = 1

 324+ E0E4              ; HL -> key_now[bank], A = mask -> NZ if down now but not at the last scan

 326+ E0E4              def_new:

 366+ E10C              ; HL = key_defs or joy_defs, A = action -> HL -> key_now[the bank], A = mask
