   1+ E000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ E000              ; Z-POLICE - hardware sprites, Layer 3 (8K page PAGE_SPRITES, runs at $E000
   3+ E000              ; in slot 7: page it in with nextreg CODE_MMU,PAGE_SPRITES before calling)
   4+ E000              ;
   5+ E000              ; The Next has 128 hardware sprites, each 16x16 pixels from a pattern in the
   6+ E000              ; sprite pattern memory (16K, separate from the Z80's: 64 8-bit patterns of
   7+ E000              ; 256 bytes, one byte per pixel, row by row).  A pattern byte is an index
   8+ E000              ; into the sprite palette; SPR_TRANS ($E3, NextReg $4B) is transparent.  The
   9+ E000              ; sprite palette starts as the identity, so until spr_palette changes it a
  10+ E000              ; pattern byte is simply its RRRGGGBB colour.
  11+ E000              ;
  12+ E000              ; Sprites are drawn above Layer 2 and the ULA (priority S U L) and, with
  13+ E000              ; NextReg $15 bit 1 set, over the border as well, so the sprite screen is
  14+ E000              ; 320 x 256 pixels:
  15+ E000              ;
  16+ E000              ;     x 0..319, y 0..255;  (SPR_SCREEN_X, SPR_SCREEN_Y) = (32, 32) is the top
  17+ E000              ;     left of the 256x192 Layer 2 / ULA screen, (288, 224) its bottom right
  18+ E000              ;
  19+ E000              ; A sprite's position is its top left pixel.  Coordinates are 9 bits and
  20+ E000              ; wrap round at 512, so they may be negative (two's complement): a sprite at
  21+ E000              ; x = -8 shows its right half at the left edge.  With overlapping sprites,
  22+ E000              ; the higher numbered one is drawn on top.
  23+ E000              ;
  24+ E000              ; Use: sprites_init once (start-up), load patterns with spr_patterns or
  25+ E000              ; from a sprite bank (sprite_data.asm: page the bank into slot 7 and call
  26+ E000              ; its spr_load_bank, from outside slot 7), and a palette with spr_palette
  27+ E000              ; if wanted, then set up sprites in the shadow
  28+ E000              ; table with spr_set / spr_pos / spr_pattern / spr_flags / spr_scale /
  29+ E000              ; spr_hide / spr_show / spr_hide_all, and copy the table to the hardware
  30+ E000              ; once a frame with spr_update.  The table holds the first SPR_COUNT sprites;
  31+ E000              ; the rest stay hidden.
  32+ E000              ;
  33+ E000              ; Attributes, SPR_ATTR (5) bytes a sprite, kept in the table as they are
  34+ E000              ; sent (the 5-byte form):
  35+ E000              ;   +0  x bits 0-7
  36+ E000              ;   +1  y bits 0-7
  37+ E000              ;   +2  bits 7-4 palette offset (added to the pattern byte's top nibble),
  38+ E000              ;       bit 3 x mirror, 2 y mirror, 1 rotate 90 degrees clockwise, 0 x bit 8
  39+ E000              ;   +3  bit 7 visible, bit 6 = 1 (byte +4 follows), bits 5-0 pattern
  40+ E000              ;   +4  bits 4-3 x scale, bits 2-1 y scale (0..3 = x1, x2, x4, x8), 0 y bit 8
  41+ E000              ;==============================================================================
  42+ E000
  43+ E000              SPR_COUNT       equ 42          ; sprites in the shadow table (max 128)
  44+ E000              SPR_HW          equ 128         ; hardware sprites
  45+ E000              SPR_ATTR        equ 5           ; attribute bytes per sprite
  46+ E000              SPR_PATTERNS    equ 64          ; 8-bit 16x16 patterns in pattern memory
  47+ E000              SPR_SIZE        equ 16          ; pixels, each way (at scale x1)
  48+ E000              SPR_SCREEN_X    equ 32          ; sprite coordinates of the 256x192
  49+ E000              SPR_SCREEN_Y    equ 32          ; screen's top left pixel
  50+ E000              SPR_TRANS       equ $E3         ; transparent pattern byte (NextReg $4B)
  51+ E000
  52+ E000              SPRF_PAL        equ $10         ; flags (attribute +2): palette offset x 16,
  53+ E000              SPRF_XMIRROR    equ $08         ; mirror left-right,
  54+ E000              SPRF_YMIRROR    equ $04         ; mirror top-bottom,
  55+ E000              SPRF_ROT        equ $02         ; rotate 90 degrees clockwise
  56+ E000
  57+ E000              SPR_SLOT_PORT   equ $303B       ; write: select sprite / pattern slot
  58+ E000              SPR_ATTR_PORT   equ $57         ; write: attributes, from the selected sprite
  59+ E000              SPR_PAT_PORT    equ $5B         ; write: pattern bytes, from the selected slot
  60+ E000
  61+ E000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  62+ E000              ; Start-up: sprites on, shown over the border too (the full 320 x 256),
  63+ E000              ; priority S U L; the transparent index; every hardware sprite hidden and the shadow table cleared (all hidden,
  64+ E000              ; pattern 0, at 0,0).
  65+ E000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  66+ E000              sprites_init:
  67+ E000 ED 91 15 0B          nextreg $15,%00001011           ; priority S U L, sprites over the
  68+ E004                                                      ; border (bit 1), visible (bit 0)
  69+ E004 ED 91 4B E3          nextreg $4B,SPR_TRANS
  70+ E008 01 3B 30             ld bc,SPR_SLOT_PORT             ; from sprite 0, the 4-byte form
  71+ E00B AF                   xor a                           ; (+3 bit 6 clear): all hidden
  72+ E00C ED 79                out (c),a
  73+ E00E 0E 57                ld c,SPR_ATTR_PORT
  74+ E010 11 00 02             ld de,SPR_HW*4
  75+ E013 ED 79        .hw:    out (c),a
  76+ E015 1B                   dec de
  77+ E016 7A                   ld a,d
  78+ E017 B3                   or e
  79+ E018 3E 00                ld a,0
  80+ E01A 20 F7                jr nz,.hw
  81+ E01C 21 00 E2             ld hl,spr_shadow
  82+ E01F 06 2A                ld b,SPR_COUNT
  83+ E021 77           .sh:    ld (hl),a                       ; x, y, flags 0
  84+ E022 23                   inc hl
  85+ E023 77                   ld (hl),a
  86+ E024 23                   inc hl
  87+ E025 77                   ld (hl),a
  88+ E026 23                   inc hl

  90+ E029 23                   inc hl

  92+ E02B 23                   inc hl
  93+ E02C 10 F3                djnz .sh
  94+ E02E                      ; fall through: send it
  95+ E02E
  96+ E02E              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  97+ E02E              ; Copy the shadow table to sprites 0..SPR_COUNT-1.  Once a frame, after the
  98+ E02E              ; changes (best just after the frame flip, so a move doesn't show half done).
  99+ E02E              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 100+ E02E              spr_update:

 102+ E031 AF                   xor a

 223+ E0BF CD FE E0             call spr_addr

 225+ E0C3 7D                   ld a,l
 226+ E0C4 C6 04                add a,4

 228+ E0C7 7B                   ld a,e
 229+ E0C8 E6 03                and 3
 230+ E0CA 07                   rlca
 231+ E0CB 07                   rlca

 235+ E0D0 B3                   or e

 251+ E0E2 CB FE                set 7,(hl)
 252+ E0E4 C9                   ret

 264+ E0F6 C9                   ret

 266+ E0F7              ; A = sprite -> HL -> its attributes in the table, +3 for spr_addr3.

 271+ E0FB 23                   inc hl
 272+ E0FC 23                   inc hl

 279+ E106 19                   add hl,de
 280+ E107 C9                   ret

 283+ E108              ; Sprite data
 284+ E108              ;==============================================================================
 285+ E108              ; The patterns themselves are in the sprite banks (sprite_data.asm).
 286+ E108              ; Bank 0 has the human status sprites, loaded as patterns 0-3 by
 287+ E108              ; sprites_init, after the HUD's passenger markers:
 288+ E108              ;   HSPR_FIELD   0  waiting in the field, not yet rescued: an empty square
 289+ E108              ;   HSPR_ABOARD  1  aboard the VTOL: a person sitting in a chair
 290+ E108              ;   HSPR_SAVED   2  rescued: a green person standing

   1+ E2D2              ;==============================================================================
   2+ E2D2              ; Z-POLICE - HUD sprites (in the sprites page, PAGE_SPRITES, at $E000 in slot
   3+ E2D2              ; 7): the human status column and the compass bar, as hardware sprites on
   4+ E2D2              ; the 320 x 256 sprite screen.  hud_sprites sets both and sends the sprite
   5+ E2D2              ; table to the hardware; main_loop calls it once a frame, after the flip.
   6+ E2D2              ;
   7+ E2D2              ; Sprites used: 0..HUMAN_MAX-1 the humans, CSPR_SPR0.. the compass bar's
   8+ E2D2              ; marks, CSPR_PTR_SPR its pointer, FRM_SPR0.. the viewport's frame.
   9+ E2D2              ;==============================================================================
  10+ E2D2
  11+ E2D2              hud_sprites:
  12+ E2D2 3A 2C E4             ld a,(frm_on)                   ; the frame, once (they stay set)
  13+ E2D5 B7                   or a

  19+ E2E2              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  20+ E2E2              ; The viewport's frame: curved corners and edges in hardware sprites, over
  21+ E2E2              ; Layer 2 and the border, so nothing is drawn into the view.  Set once after
  22+ E2E2              ; the sprites are hidden (frm_on; spr_hide_all clears it).  frame_tab: x, y,
  23+ E2E2              ; pattern and flags, then scale across and down: the edges are 1-row patterns
  24+ E2E2              ; stretched, FRM_H across (two at x8 overlapping, 224 pixels) and FRM_V down
  25+ E2E2              ; (two at x4 overlapping, 96).  (The panel's bottom corners aren't rounded:
  26+ E2E2              ; sprites there covered the city map's bottom left.)
  27+ E2E2              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  30+ E2E2              FRM_R           equ SPR_SCREEN_X+256-SPR_SIZE
  31+ E2E2              FRM_T           equ SPR_SCREEN_Y
  32+ E2E2              FRM_B           equ SPR_SCREEN_Y+VIEW_H-SPR_SIZE

  34+ E2E2              FRM_X4          equ 2

  48+ E30A 90 00 20 00          dw FRM_R-16*8, FRM_T

  88+ E36A              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  89+ E36A              ; The compass bar, across the top of the screen in the top border (sprite
  90+ E36A              ; row COMP_SPR_Y): a tape of marks every 16 yaw units (22.5 degrees), at 2
  91+ E36A              ; pixels a yaw unit, centred on the heading at sprite x COMP_SPR_CX, across
  92+ E36A              ; the full 320-pixel width of the sprite screen: 225 degrees (+-COMP_HALF,
  93+ E36A              ; 80 yaw units).  Marks at the very edges are half off the screen (their x
  94+ E36A              ; wraps, as sprite x does).  The letters N,
  95+ E36A              ; E, S, W (red) at 0, 64, 128, 192; a yellow dot at the 45 degree points;
  96+ E36A              ; a small white dot between.  A white pointer under the bar's middle marks
  97+ E36A              ; the heading.  Turning right (yaw up) moves the marks left.
  98+ E36A              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------

 103+ E36A              COMP_SPR_Y      equ 8               ; the bar's sprite row

 105+ E36A              COMP_SPR_CX     equ 160             ; the heading's x: the screen's middle
 106+ E36A              COMP_SPR_X0     equ COMP_SPR_CX-2*COMP_HALF-SPR_SIZE/2  ; x of a mark =
 107+ E36A                                                  ; this + 2 * (COMP_HALF + mark - yaw)

 109+ E36A                      ASSERT CSPR_E == CSPR_N+1 && CSPR_S == CSPR_N+2 && CSPR_W == CSPR_N+3

 172+ E3D5              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 173+ E3D5              ; The human status HUD: a column of hardware sprites, sprite k for human k,
 174+ E3D5              ; HUD_SPR_X pixels in from the left edge of the 320 x 256 sprite screen,
 175+ E3D5              ; human 0 at the bottom and each next one HUD_SPR_STEP higher, the column

 178+ E3D5              ; (sprite_data.asm): waiting in the city (HSPR_FIELD), aboard the VTOL

 199+ E3E3 87                   add a,a

   1+ E000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ E000              ; Z-POLICE - start-up initialisation (8K page PAGE_INIT, runs at $E000 in
   3+ E000              ; slot 7)
   4+ E000              ;
   5+ E000              ; Code needed only once, at start-up, kept out of the resident page: start
   6+ E000              ; (zpolice.asm) pages this in with nextreg CODE_MMU,PAGE_INIT and calls
   7+ E000              ; initgame, then slot 7 is free for the other core pages.
   8+ E000              ;==============================================================================
   9+ E000
  10+ E000              ; Hardware set-up: 28MHz, Layer 2 mode, transparency, layer priority, Layer
  11+ E000              ; 2 scroll and clip window, the memory map of the always-mapped slots, the
  12+ E000              ; peripheral settings (AY sound, turbo sound, internal speaker, no
  13+ E000              ; contention), and a black border.
  14+ E000              initgame:
  15+ E000 ED 91 07 03          nextreg $07,3                   ; 28MHz
  16+ E004 ED 91 70 00          nextreg $70,0                   ; Layer 2 256x192 mode
  17+ E008 ED 91 14 E3          nextreg $14,$E3                 ; global transparency colour
  18+ E00C ED 91 15 08          nextreg $15,%00001000           ; priority S U L (ULA over L2); sprites
  19+ E010                                                      ; off until sprites_init
  20+ E010 ED 91 16 00          nextreg $16,0                   ; Layer 2 scroll X
  21+ E014 ED 91 17 00          nextreg $17,0                   ; Layer 2 scroll Y
  22+ E018 ED 91 1C 01          nextreg $1C,%00000001           ; reset L2 clip index
  23+ E01C ED 91 18 00          nextreg $18,0                   ; Layer 2 clip: x 0..255,
  24+ E020 ED 91 18 FF          nextreg $18,255
  25+ E024 ED 91 18 00          nextreg $18,0                   ; y 0..191: the viewport, and the
  26+ E028 ED 91 18 BF          nextreg $18,191                 ; city map through the ULA panel
  27+ E02C ED 91 54 0A          nextreg ULA_MMU,PAGE_ULA0       ; ULA screen (bank 5) at $8000
  28+ E030 ED 91 51 05          nextreg ZOMBIE_MMU,PAGE_ZOMBIE  ; zombie code/data stays at $2000
  29+ E034 ED 91 52 06          nextreg OCC_MMU,PAGE_OCC0       ; occlusion data at $4000-$5FFF,
  30+ E038 ED 91 53 07          nextreg TABLES_MMU,PAGE_OCC1    ; city_col at $6000-$6FFF
  31+ E03C                      ; Peripheral settings.  $06 and $08 are read, changed and written
  32+ E03C                      ; back, so the bits not named here keep their values (in $06, bit 4
  33+ E03C                      ; is the divMMC automap, which the file handler's RST $08 needs).
  34+ E03C 3E 06                ld a,$06                        ; Peripheral 2: audio chip mode
  35+ E03E CD AA A6             call read_nextreg               ; (bits 1-0) = %01, AY
  36+ E041 E6 FC                and %11111100
  37+ E043 F6 01                or %00000001
  38+ E045 ED 92 06             nextreg $06,a
  39+ E048 3E 08                ld a,$08                        ; Peripheral 3:
  40+ E04A CD AA A6             call read_nextreg
  41+ E04D F6 52                or %01010010                    ; bit 6: no RAM / I/O contention,
  42+ E04F ED 92 08             nextreg $08,a                   ; bit 4: internal speaker on,
  43+ E052                                                      ; bit 1: turbo sound on
  44+ E052 ED 91 09 20          nextreg $09,AY_MONO_ENGINES     ; Peripheral 4: the engines' AY mono
  45+ E056                                                      ; (centred), the others stereo; no
  46+ E056                                                      ; sprite id lockstep, HDMI audio on,
  47+ E056                                                      ; no scanlines
  48+ E056 ED 91 CC 00          nextreg $CC,0                   ; DMA Interrupt Enable 0: no NMI, line
  49+ E05A                                                      ; or ULA interrupt stops a DMA transfer
  50+ E05A ED 91 CD 00          nextreg $CD,0                   ; DMA Interrupt Enable 1: nor a CTC
  51+ E05E ED 91 CE 00          nextreg $CE,0                   ; DMA Interrupt Enable 2: nor a UART
  52+ E062 AF                   xor a
  53+ E063 D3 FE                out ($FE),a                     ; black border
  54+ E065 C9                   ret

   1+ E000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ E000              ; Z-POLICE - file handling: loading and saving on the SD card (8K page
   3+ E000              ; PAGE_FILE, runs at $E000 in slot 7: page it in with nextreg
   4+ E000              ; CODE_MMU,PAGE_FILE before calling)
   5+ E000              ;
   6+ E000              ; General-purpose routines over the esxDOS / NextZXOS file API (RST $08 with
   7+ E000              ; a function code after it).  Game-specific loading and saving (save games,
   8+ E000              ; high scores, settings) go on top of these.
   9+ E000              ;
  10+ E000              ; The ROM: the divMMC only traps RST $08 while the ROM is paged in at
  11+ E000              ; $0000-$3FFF, but the game keeps other pages there (slot 0: a Layer 2
  12+ E000              ; section or the sine table; slot 1: the zombie page).  So every call pages
  13+ E000              ; the ROM into slots 0 and 1 (fh_rom_in), makes the RST $08, then puts the
  14+ E000              ; game's pages back (fh_rom_out).  Interrupts are off over the call (the
  15+ E000              ; game's IM 2 routine is in slot 1, covered by the ROM, and IY is in use and
  16+ E000              ; slot 2 holds game data, so the ROM's routine must not run either), and
  17+ E000              ; fh_rom_out turns them back on if they were on.
  18+ E000              ;
  19+ E000              ; Rules for callers:
  20+ E000              ;   * page this in at $E000 (slot 7) first, and call from outside slot 7:
  21+ E000              ;     resident code or a game logic page in slot 6;
  22+ E000              ;   * file names and data buffers must be in $4000-$DFFF: not in slots 0-1
  23+ E000              ;     (the ROM and esxDOS are there during a call) nor slot 7 (this page);
  24+ E000              ;   * file names end with a 0 byte.
  25+ E000              ;
  26+ E000              ; Every routine returns carry clear on success; carry set on failure with
  27+ E000              ; A = the esxDOS error code.  A file that was opened is closed again on
  28+ E000              ; any error in fh_load / fh_save.
  29+ E000              ;
  30+ E000              ; Routines:
  31+ E000              ;   fh_init      get the default drive (call once, before the others)
  32+ E000              ;   fh_open      HL = name, B = mode (FA_*)      -> A = handle
  33+ E000              ;   fh_close     A = handle
  34+ E000              ;   fh_read      A = handle, HL = address, BC = length -> BC = bytes read
  35+ E000              ;   fh_write     A = handle, HL = address, BC = length -> BC = bytes written
  36+ E000              ;   fh_seek      A = handle, BCDE = offset, L = SEEK_* -> BCDE = position
  37+ E000              ;   fh_size      A = handle                      -> BCDE = file size
  38+ E000              ;   fh_load      HL = name, DE = address, BC = most bytes -> BC = bytes read
  39+ E000              ;   fh_save      HL = name, DE = address, BC = length (created / replaced)
  40+ E000              ;   fh_exists    HL = name -> carry clear if the file exists
  41+ E000              ;   fh_delete    HL = name
  42+ E000              ;   fh_mkdir     HL = name: make the folder (its parent must exist; carry,
  43+ E000              ;                A = the error, if it can't: it's there already, say)
  44+ E000              ;==============================================================================
  45+ E000
  46+ E000              ; esxDOS function codes (the byte after RST $08)
  47+ E000              M_GETSETDRV     equ $89             ; A = 0: get the default drive
  48+ E000              F_OPEN          equ $9A
  49+ E000              F_CLOSE         equ $9B
  50+ E000              F_READ          equ $9D
  51+ E000              F_WRITE         equ $9E
  52+ E000              F_SEEK          equ $9F
  53+ E000              F_FSTAT         equ $A1
  54+ E000              F_UNLINK        equ $AD
  55+ E000              F_MKDIR         equ $AA
  56+ E000
  57+ E000              ; F_OPEN modes (B)
  58+ E000              FA_READ         equ $01             ; read
  59+ E000              FA_WRITE        equ $02             ; write
  60+ E000              FA_OPEN_EX      equ $00             ; open an existing file only
  61+ E000              FA_OPEN_AL      equ $08             ; open, or create if it doesn't exist
  62+ E000              FA_CREATE_NEW   equ $04             ; create, fail if it exists
  63+ E000              FA_CREATE_AL    equ $0C             ; create, replacing any existing file
  64+ E000              FA_OVERWRITE    equ FA_WRITE|FA_CREATE_AL   ; for saving a whole file
  65+ E000
  66+ E000              ; F_SEEK modes (L)
  67+ E000              SEEK_START      equ 0               ; from the start of the file
  68+ E000              SEEK_FWD        equ 1               ; forwards from the current position
  69+ E000              SEEK_BACK       equ 2               ; backwards from the current position
  70+ E000
  71+ E000              FSTAT_SIZE      equ 7               ; F_FSTAT buffer: file size, 4 bytes
  72+ E000              FSTAT_LEN       equ 11              ; F_FSTAT buffer length
  73+ E000
  74+ E000              ESX_DEFAULT     equ '*'             ; drive: the default drive
  75+ E000
  76+ E000              ; An esxDOS call: the ROM in at $0000-$3FFF for the RST $08, the game's
  77+ E000              ; pages back after.  Registers in and out are the function's own; flags
  78+ E000              ; and A come back from esxDOS (carry set = error, A = code).
  79+ E000                      MACRO ESXDOS fn
  80+ E000 ~                    call fh_rom_in
  81+ E000 ~                    rst $08
  82+ E000 ~                    db fn
  83+ E000 ~                    call fh_rom_out
  84+ E000                      ENDM
  85+ E000
  86+ E000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  87+ E000              ; Get the default drive into fh_drive (else the '*' default is used)
  88+ E000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  89+ E000              fh_init:
  90+ E000 AF                   xor a                           ; A = 0: get
  91+ E001                      ESXDOS M_GETSETDRV
  91+ E001 CD DF E0    >        call fh_rom_in
  91+ E004 CF          >        rst $08
  91+ E005 89          >        db M_GETSETDRV
  91+ E006 CD 10 E1    >        call fh_rom_out
  92+ E009 D8                   ret c
  93+ E00A 32 29 E1             ld (fh_drive),a
  94+ E00D C9                   ret
  95+ E00E
  96+ E00E              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  97+ E00E              ; HL -> file name, B = mode (FA_*) -> A = handle (also in fh_handle)
  98+ E00E              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  99+ E00E              fh_open:
 100+ E00E DD E5                push ix
 101+ E010 E5                   push hl
 102+ E011 DD E1                pop ix                          ; IX = HL = the name (both
 103+ E013 3A 29 E1             ld a,(fh_drive)                 ; conventions: programs, dot
 104+ E016                      ESXDOS F_OPEN                   ; commands)
 104+ E016 CD DF E0    >        call fh_rom_in
 104+ E019 CF          >        rst $08
 104+ E01A 9A          >        db F_OPEN
 104+ E01B CD 10 E1    >        call fh_rom_out
 105+ E01E DD E1                pop ix
 106+ E020 D8                   ret c
 107+ E021 32 2A E1             ld (fh_handle),a
 108+ E024 C9                   ret
 109+ E025
 110+ E025              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 111+ E025              ; A = handle: close it
 112+ E025              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 113+ E025              fh_close:
 114+ E025                      ESXDOS F_CLOSE
 114+ E025 CD DF E0    >        call fh_rom_in
 114+ E028 CF          >        rst $08
 114+ E029 9B          >        db F_CLOSE
 114+ E02A CD 10 E1    >        call fh_rom_out
 115+ E02D C9                   ret
 116+ E02E
 117+ E02E              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 118+ E02E              ; A = handle, HL = address, BC = length -> BC = bytes read (fewer at the end
 119+ E02E              ; of the file)
 120+ E02E              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 121+ E02E              fh_read:
 122+ E02E DD E5                push ix
 123+ E030 E5                   push hl
 124+ E031 DD E1                pop ix
 125+ E033                      ESXDOS F_READ
 125+ E033 CD DF E0    >        call fh_rom_in
 125+ E036 CF          >        rst $08
 125+ E037 9D          >        db F_READ
 125+ E038 CD 10 E1    >        call fh_rom_out
 126+ E03B DD E1                pop ix
 127+ E03D C9                   ret
 128+ E03E
 129+ E03E              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 130+ E03E              ; A = handle, HL = address, BC = length -> BC = bytes written
 131+ E03E              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 132+ E03E              fh_write:
 133+ E03E DD E5                push ix
 134+ E040 E5                   push hl
 135+ E041 DD E1                pop ix
 136+ E043                      ESXDOS F_WRITE
 136+ E043 CD DF E0    >        call fh_rom_in
 136+ E046 CF          >        rst $08
 136+ E047 9E          >        db F_WRITE
 136+ E048 CD 10 E1    >        call fh_rom_out
 137+ E04B DD E1                pop ix
 138+ E04D C9                   ret
 139+ E04E
 140+ E04E              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 141+ E04E              ; A = handle, BCDE = offset (32-bit), L = mode (SEEK_*) -> BCDE = position
 142+ E04E              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 143+ E04E              fh_seek:
 144+ E04E DD E5                push ix
 145+ E050 E5                   push hl
 146+ E051 E5                   push hl
 147+ E052 DD E1                pop ix                          ; mode in IXL (programs) and L
 148+ E054                      ESXDOS F_SEEK
 148+ E054 CD DF E0    >        call fh_rom_in
 148+ E057 CF          >        rst $08
 148+ E058 9F          >        db F_SEEK
 148+ E059 CD 10 E1    >        call fh_rom_out
 149+ E05C E1                   pop hl
 150+ E05D DD E1                pop ix
 151+ E05F C9                   ret
 152+ E060
 153+ E060              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 154+ E060              ; A = handle -> BCDE = file size (32-bit)
 155+ E060              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 156+ E060              fh_size:
 157+ E060 DD E5                push ix
 158+ E062 E5                   push hl
 159+ E063 21 2E E1             ld hl,fh_stat
 160+ E066 E5                   push hl
 161+ E067 DD E1                pop ix
 162+ E069                      ESXDOS F_FSTAT
 162+ E069 CD DF E0    >        call fh_rom_in
 162+ E06C CF          >        rst $08
 162+ E06D A1          >        db F_FSTAT
 162+ E06E CD 10 E1    >        call fh_rom_out
 163+ E071 38 0A                jr c,.x
 164+ E073 2A 35 E1             ld hl,(fh_stat+FSTAT_SIZE)
 165+ E076 EB                   ex de,hl                        ; DE = low word
 166+ E077 2A 37 E1             ld hl,(fh_stat+FSTAT_SIZE+2)
 167+ E07A 44                   ld b,h                          ; BC = high word
 168+ E07B 4D                   ld c,l
 169+ E07C B7                   or a
 170+ E07D E1           .x:     pop hl
 171+ E07E DD E1                pop ix
 172+ E080 C9                   ret
 173+ E081
 174+ E081              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 175+ E081              ; Load a file: HL -> name, DE = address, BC = most bytes to read
 176+ E081              ; -> BC = bytes read.  The file is opened, read and closed.
 177+ E081              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 178+ E081              fh_load:
 179+ E081 D5                   push de
 180+ E082 C5                   push bc
 181+ E083 06 01                ld b,FA_READ|FA_OPEN_EX
 182+ E085 CD 0E E0             call fh_open
 183+ E088 C1                   pop bc
 184+ E089 E1                   pop hl                          ; HL = address
 185+ E08A D8                   ret c                           ; couldn't open (A = error)
 186+ E08B CD 2E E0             call fh_read
 187+ E08E 18 0D                jr fh_done                      ; close it, keeping any error
 188+ E090
 189+ E090              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 190+ E090              ; Save a file: HL -> name, DE = address, BC = length.  The file is created,
 191+ E090              ; replacing any file of that name.
 192+ E090              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 193+ E090              fh_save:
 194+ E090 D5                   push de
 195+ E091 C5                   push bc
 196+ E092 06 0E                ld b,FA_OVERWRITE
 197+ E094 CD 0E E0             call fh_open
 198+ E097 C1                   pop bc
 199+ E098 E1                   pop hl
 200+ E099 D8                   ret c
 201+ E09A CD 3E E0             call fh_write
 202+ E09D                      ; fall through
 203+ E09D
 204+ E09D              ; After a read / write on fh_handle: close the file.  Carry and A as from
 205+ E09D              ; that read / write if it failed, else as from the close.
 206+ E09D              fh_done:
 207+ E09D F5                   push af
 208+ E09E 3A 2A E1             ld a,(fh_handle)
 209+ E0A1 CD 25 E0             call fh_close
 210+ E0A4 38 02                jr c,.cerr
 211+ E0A6 F1                   pop af                          ; the read / write's result
 212+ E0A7 C9                   ret
 213+ E0A8 E1           .cerr:  pop hl                          ; the close failed: if the read /
 214+ E0A9 CB 45                bit 0,l                         ; write had already failed, report
 215+ E0AB 28 01                jr z,.ce                        ; that, else the close's error
 216+ E0AD 7C                   ld a,h
 217+ E0AE 37           .ce:    scf
 218+ E0AF C9                   ret
 219+ E0B0
 220+ E0B0              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 221+ E0B0              ; HL -> name: carry clear if the file exists (it can be opened to read)
 222+ E0B0              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 223+ E0B0              fh_exists:
 224+ E0B0 06 01                ld b,FA_READ|FA_OPEN_EX
 225+ E0B2 CD 0E E0             call fh_open
 226+ E0B5 D8                   ret c
 227+ E0B6 C3 25 E0             jp fh_close
 228+ E0B9
 229+ E0B9              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 230+ E0B9              ; HL -> name: delete the file
 231+ E0B9              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 232+ E0B9              fh_delete:
 233+ E0B9 DD E5                push ix
 234+ E0BB E5                   push hl
 235+ E0BC DD E1                pop ix
 236+ E0BE 3A 29 E1             ld a,(fh_drive)
 237+ E0C1                      ESXDOS F_UNLINK
 237+ E0C1 CD DF E0    >        call fh_rom_in
 237+ E0C4 CF          >        rst $08
 237+ E0C5 AD          >        db F_UNLINK
 237+ E0C6 CD 10 E1    >        call fh_rom_out
 238+ E0C9 DD E1                pop ix
 239+ E0CB C9                   ret
 240+ E0CC
 241+ E0CC              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 242+ E0CC              ; HL -> name: make the folder
 243+ E0CC              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 244+ E0CC              fh_mkdir:
 245+ E0CC DD E5                push ix
 246+ E0CE E5                   push hl
 247+ E0CF DD E1                pop ix
 248+ E0D1 3A 29 E1             ld a,(fh_drive)
 249+ E0D4                      ESXDOS F_MKDIR
 249+ E0D4 CD DF E0    >        call fh_rom_in
 249+ E0D7 CF          >        rst $08
 249+ E0D8 AA          >        db F_MKDIR
 249+ E0D9 CD 10 E1    >        call fh_rom_out
 250+ E0DC DD E1                pop ix
 251+ E0DE C9                   ret
 252+ E0DF
 253+ E0DF              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 254+ E0DF              ; Page the ROM into slots 0 and 1 for RST $08, remembering the game's pages
 255+ E0DF              ; (fh_rom_in), and put them back (fh_rom_out).  Interrupts are off in
 256+ E0DF              ; between (the ROM covers the interrupt routine, slot 1), and back on after
 257+ E0DF              ; if they were on before.  Both keep every register and flag.
 258+ E0DF              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 259+ E0DF              fh_rom_in:
 260+ E0DF F5                   push af
 261+ E0E0 ED 57                ld a,i                          ; P/V: interrupts on (IFF2)
 262+ E0E2 F3                   di
 263+ E0E3 3E 00                ld a,0
 264+ E0E5 E2 E9 E0             jp po,.off
 265+ E0E8 3C                   inc a
 266+ E0E9 32 2D E1     .off:   ld (fh_ints),a
 267+ E0EC C5                   push bc
 268+ E0ED 01 3B 24             ld bc,$243B
 269+ E0F0 3E 50                ld a,MMU_SLOT_0_REGISTER        ; slot 0's page now
 270+ E0F2 ED 79                out (c),a
 271+ E0F4 04                   inc b
 272+ E0F5 ED 78                in a,(c)
 273+ E0F7 32 2B E1             ld (fh_mmu0),a
 274+ E0FA 05                   dec b
 275+ E0FB 3E 51                ld a,MMU_SLOT_1_REGISTER        ; slot 1's
 276+ E0FD ED 79                out (c),a
 277+ E0FF 04                   inc b
 278+ E100 ED 78                in a,(c)
 279+ E102 32 2C E1             ld (fh_mmu1),a
 280+ E105 ED 91 50 FF          nextreg MMU_SLOT_0_REGISTER,PAGE_ROM
 281+ E109 ED 91 51 FF          nextreg MMU_SLOT_1_REGISTER,PAGE_ROM
 282+ E10D C1                   pop bc
 283+ E10E F1                   pop af
 284+ E10F C9                   ret
 285+ E110
 286+ E110              fh_rom_out:
 287+ E110 F3                   di                              ; (in case esxDOS enabled them)
 288+ E111 F5                   push af
 289+ E112 3A 2B E1             ld a,(fh_mmu0)
 290+ E115 ED 92 50             nextreg MMU_SLOT_0_REGISTER,a
 291+ E118 3A 2C E1             ld a,(fh_mmu1)
 292+ E11B ED 92 51             nextreg MMU_SLOT_1_REGISTER,a
 293+ E11E 3A 2D E1             ld a,(fh_ints)
 294+ E121 B7                   or a
 295+ E122 28 03                jr z,.off
 296+ E124 F1                   pop af
 297+ E125 FB                   ei                              ; on again, as they were
 298+ E126 C9                   ret
 299+ E127 F1           .off:   pop af
 300+ E128 C9                   ret
 301+ E129
 302+ E129              ;==============================================================================
 303+ E129              ; File handler data
 304+ E129              ;==============================================================================
 305+ E129 2A           fh_drive:   db ESX_DEFAULT              ; drive for F_OPEN (fh_init)
 306+ E12A 00           fh_handle:  db 0                        ; the last file opened
 307+ E12B 00           fh_mmu0:    db 0                        ; the game's slot 0 / 1 pages during
 308+ E12C 00           fh_mmu1:    db 0                        ; an esxDOS call
 309+ E12D 00           fh_ints:    db 0                        ; 1: interrupts were on before it
 310+ E12E 00 00 00...  fh_stat:    ds FSTAT_LEN                ; F_FSTAT buffer (fh_size)

   1+ E000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ E000              ; Z-POLICE - audio (8K page PAGE_AUDIO, runs at $E000 in slot 7: page it in
   3+ E000              ; with nextreg CODE_MMU,PAGE_AUDIO before calling)
   4+ E000              ;
   5+ E000              ; Sound devices: the Next's TurboSound, three AY-3-8912 chips.  initgame
   6+ E000              ; (initialise.asm) has already set the chip mode to AY (NextReg $06),
   7+ E000              ; turned TurboSound and the internal speaker on (NextReg $08), and the
   8+ E000              ; engines' chip, AY 1, to mono (NextReg $09: its three channels in the
   9+ E000              ; centre, AY_MONO_ENGINES), the effects' chips stereo.  init_audio then sets every chip to a
  10+ E000              ; known, silent state (at start-up, and on every menu screen: menu_quiet).
  11+ E000              ; AY 1 is the VTOL's engines: engine_start here, then the interrupt routine
  12+ E000              ; plays them (engine_tick, interrupts.asm).  AY 2 is the weapons' sound
  13+ E000              ; effects, AY 3 explosions: the game asks for one with ld a,SFX_n / ld
  14+ E000              ; (sfx_req),a (AY 2), ld (sfx2_req),a (AY 3's A and B) or ld (sfx3_req),a
  15+ E000              ; (AY 3's C), and the interrupt plays it (sfx_tick).  (Music would need AY 3
  16+ E000              ; back.)  The interrupt writes the AY ports while eng_on is 1,
  17+ E000              ; so code here writes them only with eng_on 0 (or interrupts off).
  18+ E000              ;
  19+ E000              ; TurboSound ports:
  20+ E000              ;   $FFFD write %1LR111cc: select AY chip cc (AY_CHIP_1..3) with its left
  21+ E000              ;         (L) and right (R) outputs on;
  22+ E000              ;         any value 0..15: select that register of the selected chip
  23+ E000              ;   $BFFD write: the value of the selected register
  24+ E000              ;==============================================================================
  25+ E000
  26+ E000              AY_CTRL_PORT    equ $FFFD           ; chip / register select
  27+ E000              AY_DATA_PORT    equ $BFFD           ; register value
  28+ E000
  29+ E000              ; Chip select ($FFFD): AY_SELECT | AY_LEFT | AY_RIGHT | AY_CHIP_n
  30+ E000              AY_SELECT       equ %10011100       ; bit 7 and bits 4-2 must be set
  31+ E000              AY_LEFT         equ %01000000       ; left output on
  32+ E000              AY_RIGHT        equ %00100000       ; right output on
  33+ E000              AY_CHIP_1       equ %11
  34+ E000              AY_CHIP_2       equ %10
  35+ E000              AY_CHIP_3       equ %01
  36+ E000              ; NextReg $09 (Peripheral 4) bits 5-7 put the hardware's AY 0, 1, 2 in mono:
  37+ E000              ; select %11 is its AY 0, the game's AY 1 (the engines), so bit 5
  38+ E000              AY_MONO_ENGINES equ %00100000
  39+ E000                      ASSERT AY_CHIP_1 == %11
  40+ E000
  41+ E000              ; AY registers
  42+ E000              AY_TONE_A       equ 0               ; channel A tone period: fine, coarse (4)
  43+ E000              AY_TONE_B       equ 2
  44+ E000              AY_TONE_C       equ 4
  45+ E000              AY_NOISE        equ 6               ; noise period (5 bits)
  46+ E000              AY_MIXER        equ 7               ; tone / noise enable, 0 = on:
  47+ E000              AY_NO_TONE_A    equ %00000001       ;   bits 0-2 tone A-C off,
  48+ E000              AY_NO_TONE_B    equ %00000010
  49+ E000              AY_NO_TONE_C    equ %00000100
  50+ E000              AY_NO_NOISE_A   equ %00001000       ;   bits 3-5 noise A-C off
  51+ E000              AY_NO_NOISE_B   equ %00010000
  52+ E000              AY_NO_NOISE_C   equ %00100000
  53+ E000              AY_VOL_A        equ 8               ; amplitude 0-15 (bit 4: use envelope)
  54+ E000              AY_VOL_B        equ 9
  55+ E000              AY_VOL_C        equ 10
  56+ E000              AY_ENV_FINE     equ 11              ; envelope period
  57+ E000              AY_ENV_COARSE   equ 12
  58+ E000              AY_ENV_SHAPE    equ 13              ; envelope shape
  59+ E000              AY_REGS         equ 14
  60+ E000
  61+ E000              AY_ENV_ATTACK_HOLD equ %1101        ; envelope: rise once, then hold
  62+ E000              AY_MIXER_INIT   equ AY_NO_NOISE_A|AY_NO_NOISE_B|AY_NO_NOISE_C
  63+ E000                                                  ; tones on, noise off
  64+ E000
  65+ E000              ; The engines (AY 1): jet turbines, from n = |speed| (at least 1: the idle,
  66+ E000              ; at zero throttle, sounds as speed 1), 1..SPEED_MAX

  92+ E000              SFX_CHARGE      equ 14              ; the devil charging its lightning: a
  93+ E000                                                  ; rising whine (AY 3 channel C, sfx3_req)
  94+ E000              SFX_BOLT        equ 15              ; its lightning: a crackling zap, then
  95+ E000                                                  ; thunder (AY 3, sfx2_req)
  96+ E000              SFX_LAST        equ 15              ; (sfx_table, sfx_data.asm)
  97+ E000              SFX_STEP        equ $FE             ; end of a step: the next, next interrupt
  98+ E000              SFX_END         equ $FF             ; end of the sound
  99+ E000              SFX_MIX_NOISE_A_TONE_B equ AY_NO_TONE_A|AY_NO_TONE_C|AY_NO_NOISE_B|AY_NO_NOISE_C
 100+ E000                                                  ; mixer: A noise only, B tone only
 101+ E000              SFX_MIX_TONE_AB equ AY_NO_TONE_C|AY_NO_NOISE_A|AY_NO_NOISE_B|AY_NO_NOISE_C
 102+ E000                                                  ; mixer: A and B tones only
 103+ E000              SFX_MIX_NOISE_A equ AY_NO_TONE_A|AY_NO_TONE_B|AY_NO_TONE_C|AY_NO_NOISE_B|AY_NO_NOISE_C
 104+ E000                                                  ; mixer: A noise only
 105+ E000              SFX_MIX_TONE_A  equ AY_NO_TONE_B|AY_NO_TONE_C|AY_NO_NOISE_A|AY_NO_NOISE_B|AY_NO_NOISE_C
 106+ E000                                                  ; mixer: A tone only
 107+ E000              SFX_MIX_BOOM    equ AY_NO_TONE_A|AY_NO_NOISE_B|AY_NO_NOISE_C
 108+ E000                                                  ; AY 3's mixer: A noise, B tone (the
 109+ E000                                                  ; explosions), C tone (the splats)
 110+ E000                      ASSERT AY_REGS < SFX_STEP
 111+ E000
 112+ E000              ENG_FRAC        equ 16              ; the engines' speed (eng_cur) in 1/16 steps:
 113+ E000              ENG_SPIN_UP     equ 4               ;   up by at most 4/16 an interrupt (12.5 steps
 114+ E000              ENG_SPIN_DOWN   equ 2               ;   a second), down by 2/16 (6.25 a second)
 115+ E000                      ASSERT ENG_SPIN_UP > 0 && ENG_SPIN_DOWN > 0
 116+ E000                      ASSERT -SPEED_MIN <= SPEED_MAX
 117+ E000                      ASSERT ENG_WHINE0 - SPEED_MAX*ENG_WHINE_STEP > 0 && ENG_WHINE0 + ENG_DETUNE < 256
 118+ E000                      ASSERT ENG_NOISE0 < 32 && ENG_NOISE0 - (SPEED_MAX*ENG_NOISE_MUL)/16 >= 1
 119+ E000                      ASSERT ENG_ROAR_VOL0 + SPEED_MAX*ENG_VOL_MUL/32 <= 15 && ENG_WHINE_VOL0 + SPEED_MAX*ENG_VOL_MUL/32 <= 15
 120+ E000                      ASSERT SPEED_MAX*ENG_VOL_MUL < 256
 121+ E000                      ASSERT ENG_WHINE_VOL0 >= ENG_SHIMMER_VOL
 122+ E000
 123+ E000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 124+ E000              ; Set up the sound devices: each AY chip selected with both outputs, every
 125+ E000              ; register 0 (silent: all volumes 0), then the mixer to tones only and the
 126+ E000              ; envelope to attack-and-hold.  AY 1 is left selected.
 127+ E000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 128+ E000              init_audio:
 129+ E000 AF                   xor a                           ; the engines off first: the interrupt
 130+ E001 32 89 3C             ld (eng_on),a                   ; leaves the AYs alone (interrupts.asm)
 131+ E004 32 8A 3C             ld (sfx_req),a                  ; and no sound effect asked for or
 132+ E007 32 8D 3C             ld (sfx2_req),a                 ; playing, on any voice
 133+ E00A 32 90 3C             ld (sfx3_req),a
 134+ E00D 67                   ld h,a
 135+ E00E 6F                   ld l,a
 136+ E00F 22 8B 3C             ld (sfx_ptr),hl
 137+ E012 22 8E 3C             ld (sfx2_ptr),hl
 138+ E015 22 91 3C             ld (sfx3_ptr),hl
 139+ E018 3E 01                ld a,AY_CHIP_3
 140+ E01A CD 24 E0             call ay_init_chip
 141+ E01D 3E 02                ld a,AY_CHIP_2
 142+ E01F CD 24 E0             call ay_init_chip
 143+ E022 3E 03                ld a,AY_CHIP_1
 144+ E024                      ; fall through
 145+ E024
 146+ E024              ; A = chip (AY_CHIP_n): select it in stereo, clear it, mixer and envelope
 147+ E024              ay_init_chip:
 148+ E024 CD 5D E0             call ay_select
 149+ E027 16 0D                ld d,AY_REGS-1                  ; registers 13..0 = 0
 150+ E029 7A           .clr:   ld a,d
 151+ E02A 1E 00                ld e,0
 152+ E02C CD 65 E0             call ay_write
 153+ E02F 15                   dec d
 154+ E030 F2 29 E0             jp p,.clr
 155+ E033 3E 07                ld a,AY_MIXER
 156+ E035 1E 38                ld e,AY_MIXER_INIT
 157+ E037 CD 65 E0             call ay_write
 158+ E03A 3E 0D                ld a,AY_ENV_SHAPE
 159+ E03C 1E 0D                ld e,AY_ENV_ATTACK_HOLD
 160+ E03E C3 65 E0             jp ay_write
 161+ E041
 162+ E041              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 163+ E041              ; The VTOL's engines: jet turbines, not rotors, so a steady roar and whine
 164+ E041              ; rather than a chop.  AY 1, all three channels, kept for them.  They never
 165+ E041              ; stop in play: at zero throttle they idle, as at speed 1.  The interrupt
 166+ E041              ; routine plays them, 50 times a second (engine_tick, interrupts.asm): the
 167+ E041              ; sound's speed spools towards the VTOL's, so pitch and volume rise and fall
 168+ E041              ; smoothly.  (The Next's AYs run at 1.75 MHz: a tone of period P is
 169+ E041              ; 109375/P Hz.)
 170+ E041              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 171+ E041              ; Start of each level (next_level): AY 1's mixer for the engines, the sound's
 172+ E041              ; speed 0 (they spool up to the idle), and the interrupt playing them
 173+ E041              engine_start:
 174+ E041 AF                   xor a
 175+ E042 32 89 3C             ld (eng_on),a                   ; (the interrupt off AY 1 meanwhile)
 176+ E045 21 00 00             ld hl,0
 177+ E048 22 94 3C             ld (eng_cur),hl
 178+ E04B 3E 03                ld a,AY_CHIP_1
 179+ E04D CD 5D E0             call ay_select
 180+ E050 3E 07                ld a,AY_MIXER
 181+ E052 1E 31                ld e,ENG_MIXER
 182+ E054 CD 65 E0             call ay_write
 183+ E057 3E 01                ld a,1
 184+ E059 32 89 3C             ld (eng_on),a                   ; the interrupt plays them now
 185+ E05C C9                   ret
 186+ E05D
 187+ E05D              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 188+ E05D              ; A = chip (AY_CHIP_n): select it, with both outputs on
 189+ E05D              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 190+ E05D              ay_select:
 191+ E05D F6 FC                or AY_SELECT|AY_LEFT|AY_RIGHT
 192+ E05F 01 FD FF             ld bc,AY_CTRL_PORT
 193+ E062 ED 79                out (c),a
 194+ E064 C9                   ret
 195+ E065
 196+ E065              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 197+ E065              ; A = register, E = value: write it to the selected chip.  Keeps D, E, HL.
 198+ E065              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 199+ E065              ay_write:
 200+ E065 01 FD FF             ld bc,AY_CTRL_PORT
 201+ E068 ED 79                out (c),a
 202+ E06A 06 BF                ld b,high AY_DATA_PORT
 203+ E06C ED 59                out (c),e
 204+ E06E C9                   ret

2520  E06F                      INCLUDE "sound.asm"             ; the players (the interrupt calls them)
# file opened: sound.asm
   1+ E06F              ;==============================================================================
   2+ E06F              ; Z-POLICE - the sound players (in the audio page, PAGE_AUDIO, with
   3+ E06F              ; audio.asm and the sounds, sfx_data.asm): called by the interrupt routine
   4+ E06F              ; (im2_routine, interrupts.asm) 50 times a second with this page mapped
   5+ E06F              ; into slot 7 for them (the page there put back after).  The game asks for
   6+ E06F              ; a sound through the resident request bytes (sfx_req, sfx2_req, sfx3_req:
   7+ E06F              ; interrupts.asm), so any page can.
   8+ E06F              ;==============================================================================
   9+ E06F
  10+ E06F              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  11+ E06F              ; The VTOL's engines (audio.asm has the sound's constants and engine_start):
  12+ E06F              ; jet turbines, on AY 1.  eng_cur is the speed the engines sound at, in
  13+ E06F              ; 1/ENG_FRAC steps; each interrupt it follows the VTOL's, n = |speed| (at
  14+ E06F              ; least 1: zero throttle idles as speed 1), by at most ENG_SPIN_UP going up
  15+ E06F              ; and ENG_SPIN_DOWN going down: the turbines spool up, and down more slowly,
  16+ E06F              ; instead of jumping.  From it:
  17+ E06F              ;   A  noise, the roar: period ENG_NOISE0 - m*13/16, volume ENG_ROAR_VOL0 +
  18+ E06F              ;      m*ENG_VOL_MUL/32
  19+ E06F              ;      (m = eng_cur/ENG_FRAC, whole steps)
  20+ E06F              ;   B  tone, the turbine whine: period ENG_WHINE0 - eng_cur*ENG_WHINE_STEP/
  21+ E06F              ;      ENG_FRAC (sliding smoothly), volume ENG_WHINE_VOL0 + m*ENG_VOL_MUL/32
  22+ E06F              ;   C  the same whine ENG_DETUNE periods lower and ENG_SHIMMER_VOL quieter:
  23+ E06F              ;      the two beat, the turbines' shimmer
  24+ E06F              ; Written only when eng_cur moves.  Nothing while eng_on is 0 (menus).
  25+ E06F              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  26+ E06F              engine_tick:
  27+ E06F 3A 89 3C             ld a,(eng_on)
  28+ E072 B7                   or a
  29+ E073 C8                   ret z
  30+ E074 3A 9B AD             ld a,(speed)
  31+ E077 B7                   or a
  32+ E078 F2 7D E0             jp p,.pos
  33+ E07B ED 44                neg                             ; reversing: its size
  34+ E07D B7           .pos:   or a
  35+ E07E 20 01                jr nz,.n
  36+ E080 3C                   inc a                           ; zero throttle: idle, as speed 1
  37+ E081 FE 1D        .n:     cp SPEED_MAX+1
  38+ E083 38 02                jr c,.nm
  39+ E085 3E 1C                ld a,SPEED_MAX                  ; (boosting: as flat out)
  40+ E087 5F           .nm:    ld e,a
  41+ E088 16 10                ld d,ENG_FRAC
  42+ E08A ED 30                mul d,e                         ; DE = the target, in 1/ENG_FRAC steps
  43+ E08C 2A 94 3C             ld hl,(eng_cur)
  44+ E08F B7                   or a
  45+ E090 ED 52                sbc hl,de                       ; HL = eng_cur - target
  46+ E092 C8                   ret z                           ; there: nothing changes
  47+ E093 38 09                jr c,.up
  48+ E095 01 FE FF             ld bc,-ENG_SPIN_DOWN            ; above: down a step
  49+ E098 09                   add hl,bc
  50+ E099 30 0C                jr nc,.tgt                      ; (less than a step away: there)
  51+ E09B 19                   add hl,de
  52+ E09C 18 0A                jr .set
  53+ E09E 01 04 00     .up:    ld bc,ENG_SPIN_UP               ; below: up a step
  54+ E0A1 09                   add hl,bc
  55+ E0A2 38 03                jr c,.tgt                       ; (reached it)
  56+ E0A4 19                   add hl,de
  57+ E0A5 18 01                jr .set
  58+ E0A7 EB           .tgt:   ex de,hl
  59+ E0A8 22 94 3C     .set:   ld (eng_cur),hl
  60+ E0AB 3E FF                ld a,AY_SELECT|AY_LEFT|AY_RIGHT|AY_CHIP_1
  61+ E0AD 01 FD FF             ld bc,AY_CTRL_PORT
  62+ E0B0 ED 79                out (c),a
  63+ E0B2 E5                   push hl
  64+ E0B3 54                   ld d,h                          ; B: the whine's period
  65+ E0B4 5D                   ld e,l
  66+ E0B5 29                   add hl,hl
  67+ E0B6 19                   add hl,de                       ; eng_cur * ENG_WHINE_STEP
  68+ E0B7 EB                   ex de,hl
  69+ E0B8 06 04                ld b,4
  70+ E0BA ED 2A                bsrl de,b                       ; / ENG_FRAC
  71+ E0BC                      ASSERT ENG_WHINE_STEP == 3 && ENG_FRAC == 16
  72+ E0BC 3E DE                ld a,ENG_WHINE0
  73+ E0BE 93                   sub e
  74+ E0BF 6F                   ld l,a                          ; L = the whine's period
  75+ E0C0 5F                   ld e,a
  76+ E0C1 3E 02                ld a,AY_TONE_B
  77+ E0C3 CD 17 E1             call isr_ay
  78+ E0C6 3E 03                ld a,AY_TONE_B+1
  79+ E0C8 1E 00                ld e,0
  80+ E0CA CD 17 E1             call isr_ay
  81+ E0CD 7D                   ld a,l                          ; C: a little lower, to beat with B
  82+ E0CE C6 02                add a,ENG_DETUNE
  83+ E0D0 5F                   ld e,a
  84+ E0D1 3E 04                ld a,AY_TONE_C
  85+ E0D3 CD 17 E1             call isr_ay
  86+ E0D6 3E 05                ld a,AY_TONE_C+1
  87+ E0D8 1E 00                ld e,0
  88+ E0DA CD 17 E1             call isr_ay
  89+ E0DD D1                   pop de                          ; m = eng_cur / ENG_FRAC
  90+ E0DE 06 04                ld b,4
  91+ E0E0 ED 2A                bsrl de,b
  92+ E0E2 63                   ld h,e                          ; H = m
  93+ E0E3 54                   ld d,h                          ; A: the roar's noise period
  94+ E0E4 1E 0D                ld e,ENG_NOISE_MUL
  95+ E0E6 ED 30                mul d,e
  96+ E0E8 06 04                ld b,4
  97+ E0EA ED 2A                bsrl de,b                       ; m*13/16
  98+ E0EC 3E 1D                ld a,ENG_NOISE0
  99+ E0EE 93                   sub e
 100+ E0EF 5F                   ld e,a
 101+ E0F0 3E 06                ld a,AY_NOISE
 102+ E0F2 CD 17 E1             call isr_ay
 103+ E0F5 54                   ld d,h                          ; the volumes: louder with speed
 104+ E0F6 1E 07                ld e,ENG_VOL_MUL
 105+ E0F8 ED 30                mul d,e
 106+ E0FA 06 05                ld b,5
 107+ E0FC ED 2A                bsrl de,b
 108+ E0FE 7B                   ld a,e
 109+ E0FF 6F                   ld l,a                          ; L = m*ENG_VOL_MUL/32
 110+ E100 C6 04                add a,ENG_ROAR_VOL0
 111+ E102 5F                   ld e,a
 112+ E103 3E 08                ld a,AY_VOL_A
 113+ E105 CD 17 E1             call isr_ay
 114+ E108 7D                   ld a,l
 115+ E109 C6 02                add a,ENG_WHINE_VOL0
 116+ E10B 5F                   ld e,a
 117+ E10C 3E 09                ld a,AY_VOL_B
 118+ E10E CD 17 E1             call isr_ay
 119+ E111 7B                   ld a,e
 120+ E112 D6 02                sub ENG_SHIMMER_VOL
 121+ E114 5F                   ld e,a
 122+ E115 3E 0A                ld a,AY_VOL_C
 123+ E117                      ; fall through
 124+ E117
 125+ E117              ; A = register, E = value: write it to the selected AY chip (here: the
 126+ E117              ; interrupt's own, as ay_write is in a page that may not be in).  Keeps D,
 127+ E117              ; E, HL.
 128+ E117              isr_ay:
 129+ E117 01 FD FF             ld bc,AY_CTRL_PORT
 130+ E11A ED 79                out (c),a
 131+ E11C 06 BF                ld b,high AY_DATA_PORT
 132+ E11E ED 59                out (c),e
 133+ E120 C9                   ret
 134+ E121
 135+ E121              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 136+ E121              ; Sound effects, three voices: the weapons on AY 2 (sfx_req), explosions on
 137+ E121              ; AY 3's channels A and B (sfx2_req), and splats on AY 3's channel C
 138+ E121              ; (sfx3_req: a tone only, as the chip's noise is the explosions'), so none
 139+ E121              ; cuts another.  (The splats write only channel C's tone and volume, and
 140+ E121              ; the explosions leave channel C alone, its tone kept on in the mixer.)  The
 141+ E121              ; engines have AY 1.  The game asks for a sound by putting its number in a
 142+ E121              ; voice's request byte (SFX_*, audio.asm): one byte, so safe from any page
 143+ E121              ; at any time; only the interrupt writes the AY chips.  Each voice plays one
 144+ E121              ; sound at a time: a new one cuts the last.  A sound is a list of steps, one
 145+ E121              ; an interrupt (20 ms): each step is AY register / value pairs, ended by
 146+ E121              ; SFX_STEP (the next step next interrupt) or SFX_END (the sound is over).
 147+ E121              ; Nothing while eng_on is 0 (menus).
 148+ E121              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 149+ E121              sfx_tick:
 150+ E121 3A 89 3C             ld a,(eng_on)
 151+ E124 B7                   or a
 152+ E125 C8                   ret z
 153+ E126 21 8A 3C             ld hl,sfx_req                   ; the weapons, AY 2
 154+ E129 3E FE                ld a,AY_SELECT|AY_LEFT|AY_RIGHT|AY_CHIP_2
 155+ E12B CD 3B E1             call sfx_voice
 156+ E12E 21 8D 3C             ld hl,sfx2_req                  ; explosions, AY 3 (A, B)
 157+ E131 3E FD                ld a,AY_SELECT|AY_LEFT|AY_RIGHT|AY_CHIP_3
 158+ E133 CD 3B E1             call sfx_voice
 159+ E136 21 90 3C             ld hl,sfx3_req                  ; splats, AY 3 (C)
 160+ E139 3E FD                ld a,AY_SELECT|AY_LEFT|AY_RIGHT|AY_CHIP_3
 161+ E13B                      ; fall through
 162+ E13B
 163+ E13B              ; HL -> a voice (its request byte, then its sound's next step, a word: 0
 164+ E13B              ; none), A = its AY chip's select value: start a sound asked for, and play
 165+ E13B              ; the next step
 166+ E13B              sfx_voice:
 167+ E13B 32 93 3C             ld (sv_sel),a
 168+ E13E 7E                   ld a,(hl)                       ; a new sound asked for?
 169+ E13F B7                   or a
 170+ E140 28 13                jr z,.play
 171+ E142 36 00                ld (hl),0                       ; (taken)
 172+ E144 E5                   push hl
 173+ E145 21 7E E1             ld hl,sfx_table-2
 174+ E148 87                   add a,a
 175+ E149 ED 31                add hl,a
 176+ E14B 5E                   ld e,(hl)
 177+ E14C 23                   inc hl
 178+ E14D 56                   ld d,(hl)                       ; DE -> it
 179+ E14E E1                   pop hl
 180+ E14F 23                   inc hl
 181+ E150 73                   ld (hl),e                       ; it starts now (cutting any other)
 182+ E151 23                   inc hl
 183+ E152 72                   ld (hl),d
 184+ E153 2B                   dec hl
 185+ E154 2B                   dec hl
 186+ E155 23           .play:  inc hl
 187+ E156 5E                   ld e,(hl)
 188+ E157 23                   inc hl
 189+ E158 56                   ld d,(hl)                       ; DE -> the next step; HL -> its high byte
 190+ E159 7A                   ld a,d
 191+ E15A B3                   or e
 192+ E15B C8                   ret z                           ; nothing playing
 193+ E15C E5                   push hl
 194+ E15D 3A 93 3C             ld a,(sv_sel)
 195+ E160 01 FD FF             ld bc,AY_CTRL_PORT
 196+ E163 ED 79                out (c),a
 197+ E165 EB                   ex de,hl
 198+ E166 7E           .lp:    ld a,(hl)                       ; this step's register / value pairs
 199+ E167 23                   inc hl
 200+ E168 FE FE                cp SFX_STEP
 201+ E16A 28 0E                jr z,.step
 202+ E16C FE FF                cp SFX_END
 203+ E16E 28 07                jr z,.end
 204+ E170 5E                   ld e,(hl)
 205+ E171 23                   inc hl
 206+ E172 CD 17 E1             call isr_ay
 207+ E175 18 EF                jr .lp
 208+ E177 21 00 00     .end:   ld hl,0                         ; over
 209+ E17A EB           .step:  ex de,hl                        ; (the next step, next interrupt)
 210+ E17B E1                   pop hl
 211+ E17C 72                   ld (hl),d
 212+ E17D 2B                   dec hl
 213+ E17E 73                   ld (hl),e
 214+ E17F C9                   ret

2521  E180                      INCLUDE "sfx_data.asm"          ; the sound effects (sfx_tick plays them)
# file opened: sfx_data.asm
   1+ E180              ;==============================================================================
   2+ E180              ; Z-POLICE - sound effect data (in the audio page, with the players,
   3+ E180              ; sound.asm: mapped into slot 7 by the interrupt routine while it plays)
   4+ E180              ;
   5+ E180              ; Played on AY 2 by sfx_tick (interrupts.asm); the game asks for one with
   6+ E180              ; ld a,SFX_n / ld (sfx_req),a (the numbers are in audio.asm).  A sound is a
   7+ E180              ; list of steps, one an interrupt (20 ms): each step is AY register / value
   8+ E180              ; pairs, ended by SFX_STEP (the next step next interrupt) or SFX_END (over).
   9+ E180              ; The Next's AYs run at 1.75 MHz: a tone of period P is 109375/P Hz; a
  10+ E180              ; lower noise period is a brighter hiss.
  11+ E180              ;==============================================================================
  12+ E180
  13+ E180              ; One step of a zap: channel A at tone period p, channel B 2 periods flat
  14+ E180              ; (the two beat: a buzz), volumes v and v-2
  15+ E180                  MACRO SFX_ZAP p, v
  16+ E180 ~                    db AY_TONE_A, low (p), AY_TONE_A+1, high (p)
  17+ E180 ~                    db AY_TONE_B, low ((p)+2), AY_TONE_B+1, high ((p)+2)
  18+ E180 ~                    db AY_VOL_A, v, AY_VOL_B, (v)-2, SFX_STEP
  19+ E180                  ENDM
  20+ E180
  21+ E180              ; One step of a woosh: channel A's noise at period n, volume v
  22+ E180                  MACRO SFX_WOOSH n, v
  23+ E180 ~                    db AY_NOISE, n, AY_VOL_A, v, SFX_STEP
  24+ E180                  ENDM
  25+ E180
  26+ E180              ; An explosion: a deep noise (channel A, darkening: period 16 up to 30) over
  27+ E180              ; a low rumble (channel B, BOOM_RUMBLE), both from volume peak (B 2 less)
  28+ E180              ; fading to nothing over len steps.  (A falling level is an exponential fade:
  29+ E180              ; the AY's levels are logarithmic.)
  30+ E180              BOOM_RUMBLE     equ 2735            ; 109375 / 2735 = 40 Hz
  31+ E180                  MACRO SFX_BOOM peak, len
  32+ E180 ~                    db AY_MIXER, SFX_MIX_BOOM       ; (channel C: the splats', left alone)
  33+ E180 ~                    db AY_TONE_B, low BOOM_RUMBLE, AY_TONE_B+1, high BOOM_RUMBLE
  34+ E180 ~            BOOM_I  DEFL 0
  35+ E180 ~                    DUP len
  36+ E180 ~                    db AY_NOISE, 16 + (BOOM_I*15)/(len)
  37+ E180 ~                    db AY_VOL_A, ((peak)*((len)-BOOM_I)+(len)-1)/(len)
  38+ E180 ~                    db AY_VOL_B, (((peak)-2)*((len)-BOOM_I)+(len)-1)/(len)
  39+ E180 ~                    db SFX_STEP
  40+ E180 ~            BOOM_I  DEFL BOOM_I+1
  41+ E180 ~                    EDUP
  42+ E180 ~                    db AY_VOL_A, 0, AY_VOL_B, 0, SFX_END
  43+ E180                  ENDM
  44+ E180
  45+ E180              ; One step of a splat: channel C (only: see sfx_tick) at tone period p,
  46+ E180              ; volume v
  47+ E180                  MACRO SFX_SPLAT_STEP p, v
  48+ E180 ~                    db AY_TONE_C, low (p), AY_TONE_C+1, high (p), AY_VOL_C, v, SFX_STEP
  49+ E180                  ENDM
  50+ E180
  51+ E180              ; The sounds, by number (SFX_*, from 1)
  52+ E180              sfx_table:
  53+ E180 9E E1                dw sfx_mg                       ; SFX_MG
  54+ E182 2B E9                dw sfx_laser                    ; SFX_LASER
  55+ E184 C5 E1                dw sfx_chain                    ; SFX_CHAIN
  56+ E186 13 E2                dw sfx_rocket                   ; SFX_ROCKET
  57+ E188 4E E2                dw sfx_missile                  ; SFX_MISSILE
  58+ E18A EC E1                dw sfx_autocannon               ; SFX_AUTOCANNON
  59+ E18C 84 E3                dw sfx_boom_rocket              ; SFX_BOOM_ROCKET
  60+ E18E A7 E2                dw sfx_boom_missile             ; SFX_BOOM_MISSILE
  61+ E190 37 E4                dw sfx_boom_autocannon          ; SFX_BOOM_AUTOCANNON
  62+ E192 96 E4                dw sfx_boom_prox                ; SFX_BOOM_PROX

 177+ E4D9                      ASSERT MISSILE_DMG*MISSILE_R == 3840 && BLAST_DMG*BLAST_R == 1280
 178+ E4D9                      ASSERT AUTOCANNON_DMG*AUTOCANNON_R == 152 && PROX_DMG*PROX_R == 75
 179+ E4D9
 180+ E4D9              ; The VTOL hitting a building (player.asm; on AY 3, as the explosions): a
 181+ E4D9              ; low crunch, like a missile's blast but deeper and shorter.  A cracking
 182+ E4D9              ; hit (brighter noise, full volume) drops at once into the deepest noise
 183+ E4D9              ; (period 31) over a lower rumble than the blasts' (about 27 Hz, channel B),
 184+ E4D9              ; fading over 260 ms.
 185+ E4D9              CRASH_RUMBLE    equ 4000            ; 109375 / 4000 = 27 Hz
 186+ E4D9                      ASSERT CRASH_RUMBLE < 4096
 187+ E4D9              CRASH_LEN       equ 10              ; the fade, steps
 188+ E4D9              ; The devil charging its lightning (devil.asm), its last DV_HUM_T
 189+ E4D9              ; interrupts (3 s; AY 3 channel C, as the splats, which wait meanwhile:
 190+ E4D9              ; dv_hum): an electric whine rising from CHG_F0 to CHG_F1 Hz (in steps of
 191+ E4D9              ; even frequency) and swelling from volume 4 to 15, warbling (every other
 192+ E4D9              ; step 1/12 flat), a step every 2 interrupts
 193+ E4D9              CHG_STEPS       equ 75              ; (x 2 interrupts: 3 s)
 194+ E4D9              CHG_F0          equ 80
 195+ E4D9              CHG_F1          equ 1600
 196+ E4D9              sfx_charge:
 197+ E4D9              CHG_I   DEFL 0
 198+ E4D9                      DUP CHG_STEPS

   1+ C000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ C000              ; Z-POLICE - player page (8K page PAGE_PLAYER, runs at $C000 in slot 6)
   3+ C000              ;
   4+ C000              ; Keyboard input, movement along the heading, world-edge clamping and
   5+ C000              ; building collision.  Paged in by main_loop with nextreg LOGIC_MMU,
   6+ C000              ; PAGE_PLAYER, with the keys page (key_held) in slot 7.
   7+ C000              ; Uses the resident helpers get_sin, fmul and bld_height; camera state (cam_x/z/y, yaw, pitch, speed) is shared and
   8+ C000              ; stays in zpolice.asm.
   9+ C000              ;==============================================================================
  10+ C000
  11+ C000              ;==============================================================================
  12+ C000              ; Player input and movement
  13+ C000              ;==============================================================================
  14+ C000              update_player:
  15+ C000 AF                   xor a
  16+ C001 D3 FE                out ($FE),a                     ; border back to black
  17+ C003                      ; remember position in case we fly into something
  18+ C003 21 8F AD             ld hl,cam_x                     ; (and the heading: turning swings
  19+ C006 11 D4 C3             ld de,old_pos                   ; the VTOL's nose and tail)
  20+ C009 01 0A 00             ld bc,10                        ; cam_x(3) cam_z(3) cam_y(2) yaw(2)
  21+ C00C ED B0                ldir
  22+ C00E 3A AD AD             ld a,(vtol_dead)
  23+ C011 B7                   or a
  24+ C012 28 07                jr z,.alive
  25+ C014 AF                   xor a
  26+ C015 32 41 AE             ld (boost_on),a                 ; (no boost in a wreck)
  27+ C018 C3 59 C3             jp vtol_wreck                   ; destroyed: out of control
  28+ C01B              .alive:
  29+ C01B                      ; (keys: kbd_scan has read them; actions from input.asm)
  30+ C01B                      ; --- boost (zpolice.asm: BOOST_*): while on, the speed keys and the
  31+ C01B                      ; air brake don't change the speed, and each frame burns a fuel
  32+ C01B 3A 41 AE             ld a,(boost_on)
  33+ C01E B7                   or a
  34+ C01F 28 2A                jr z,.nb
  35+ C021 3A 9B AD             ld a,(speed)
  36+ C024 FE 38                cp BOOST_SPEED
  37+ C026 20 18                jr nz,.bend                     ; stopped meanwhile (a collision)
  38+ C028 CD 40 AB             call vtol_on_floor
  39+ C02B 28 13                jr z,.bend                      ; set down: off (the brake stops it)
  40+ C02D 3E 13                ld a,K_BOOST
  41+ C02F CD CF E0             call key_pressed
  42+ C032 20 06                jr nz,.boff                     ; pressed again: off
  43+ C034 21 40 AE             ld hl,boost_fuel
  44+ C037 35                   dec (hl)
  45+ C038 20 0A                jr nz,.bkeep                    ; still burning
  46+ C03A 3A 42 AE     .boff:  ld a,(boost_spd)                ; off (or out of fuel): the speed it
  47+ C03D 32 9B AD             ld (speed),a                    ; had before
  48+ C040 AF           .bend:  xor a
  49+ C041 32 41 AE             ld (boost_on),a
  50+ C044 AF           .bkeep: xor a                           ; (no air brake this frame)
  51+ C045 32 E0 C3             ld (ab_on),a
  52+ C048 C3 52 C1             jp .nw
  53+ C04B 3E 13        .nb:    ld a,K_BOOST                    ; off: pressed to start it?
  54+ C04D CD CF E0             call key_pressed
  55+ C050 28 2B                jr z,.nbs
  56+ C052 3A 3F AE             ld a,(boost_fitted)
  57+ C055 B7                   or a
  58+ C056 28 25                jr z,.nbs                       ; no booster
  59+ C058 3A 40 AE             ld a,(boost_fuel)
  60+ C05B B7                   or a
  61+ C05C 28 1F                jr z,.nbs                       ; no fuel
  62+ C05E CD 40 AB             call vtol_on_floor
  63+ C061 28 1A                jr z,.nbs                       ; landed: not on the ground
  64+ C063 3A 9B AD             ld a,(speed)
  65+ C066 CB 7F                bit 7,a
  66+ C068 20 13                jr nz,.nbs                      ; reversing
  67+ C06A FE 0E                cp BOOST_MIN
  68+ C06C 38 0F                jr c,.nbs                       ; under half speed
  69+ C06E 32 42 AE             ld (boost_spd),a
  70+ C071 3E 38                ld a,BOOST_SPEED                ; on: twice the top speed at once
  71+ C073 32 9B AD             ld (speed),a
  72+ C076 3E 01                ld a,1
  73+ C078 32 41 AE             ld (boost_on),a
  74+ C07B 18 C7                jr .bkeep
  75+ C07D              .nbs:
  76+ C07D                      ; --- landed (resting on the road, a roof or the pad): the speed keys
  77+ C07D                      ; only bring it back to 0 (speeding up only from reverse, slowing
  78+ C07D                      ; only from forwards), and any speed is braked away as the air brake
  79+ C07D                      ; does (as if Z were held), with a shake
  80+ C07D CD 40 AB             call vtol_on_floor
  81+ C080 20 3C                jr nz,.fly

  83+ C084 CD BE E0             call key_held

 343+ C2A1              ; The lateral thrusters (lthrust_fitted): while a strafe control
 344+ C2A1              ; (K_STRAFE_L, K_STRAFE_R) is held, the VTOL moves STRAFE_D sideways,
 345+ C2A1              ; square to its heading, each frame; not when landed (resting on the
 346+ C2A1              ; floor).  Collisions as for any move (check_collision, after this).
 347+ C2A1              STRAFE_D_HALVES equ 5               ; 2.5 world units a frame (0.195 m)
 348+ C2A1              strafe:

 350+ C2A4 B7                   or a

 352+ C2A6 CD 40 AB             call vtol_on_floor
 353+ C2A9 C8                   ret z                           ; landed
 354+ C2AA 0E 40                ld c,64                         ; right: the heading + 90 degrees

 369+ C2CF 3A DE C3             ld a,(st_a)
 370+ C2D2 C6 40                add a,64

 372+ C2D7 CD E1 C2             call .d
 373+ C2DA DD 21 92 AD          ld ix,cam_z
 374+ C2DE C3 EA C2             jp add_pos
 375+ C2E1              ; HL = S7.8 component -> HL = 2.5 * it: the move in 1/256 units
 376+ C2E1 54           .d:     ld d,h
 377+ C2E2 5D                   ld e,l

 379+ C2E5 CB 1B                rr e                            ; half
 380+ C2E7 29                   add hl,hl                       ; twice

 383+ C2EA                      ASSERT STRAFE_D_HALVES == 5     ; (.d: 2 + 1/2)
 384+ C2EA
 385+ C2EA              ; IX -> 24-bit position (frac, lo, hi). HL = signed delta in 1/256 units.
 386+ C2EA              ; Clamps the integer part to WORLD_MIN..WORLD_MAX.
 387+ C2EA              add_pos:
 388+ C2EA 7C                   ld a,h
 389+ C2EB 17                   rla
 390+ C2EC 9F                   sbc a,a
 391+ C2ED 4F                   ld c,a                          ; sign extension
 392+ C2EE DD 7E 00             ld a,(ix+0)
 393+ C2F1 85                   add a,l
 394+ C2F2 DD 77 00             ld (ix+0),a
 395+ C2F5 DD 7E 01             ld a,(ix+1)
 396+ C2F8 8C                   adc a,h
 397+ C2F9 DD 77 01             ld (ix+1),a
 398+ C2FC DD 7E 02             ld a,(ix+2)
 399+ C2FF 89                   adc a,c
 400+ C300 DD 77 02             ld (ix+2),a
 401+ C303 DD 6E 01             ld l,(ix+1)
 402+ C306 DD 66 02             ld h,(ix+2)
 403+ C309 CB 7C                bit 7,h
 404+ C30B 20 1B                jr nz,.lo
 405+ C30D 11 40 00             ld de,WORLD_MIN
 406+ C310 B7                   or a
 407+ C311 ED 52                sbc hl,de
 408+ C313 38 13                jr c,.lo
 409+ C315 DD 6E 01             ld l,(ix+1)
 410+ C318 DD 66 02             ld h,(ix+2)
 411+ C31B 11 C0 3F             ld de,WORLD_MAX
 412+ C31E CD 31 C3             call min_hl_de
 413+ C321 DD 75 01             ld (ix+1),l
 414+ C324 DD 74 02             ld (ix+2),h
 415+ C327 C9                   ret
 416+ C328 DD 36 01 40  .lo:    ld (ix+1),WORLD_MIN & $FF
 417+ C32C DD 36 02 00          ld (ix+2),WORLD_MIN >> 8
 418+ C330 C9                   ret
 419+ C331
 420+ C331              ; Unsigned 16-bit clamps
 421+ C331              min_hl_de:
 422+ C331 E5                   push hl
 423+ C332 B7                   or a
 424+ C333 ED 52                sbc hl,de
 425+ C335 E1                   pop hl
 426+ C336 D8                   ret c
 427+ C337 EB                   ex de,hl
 428+ C338 C9                   ret

 430+ C339              max_hl_de:
 431+ C339 E5                   push hl
 432+ C33A B7                   or a
 433+ C33B ED 52                sbc hl,de
 434+ C33D E1                   pop hl
 435+ C33E D0                   ret nc
 436+ C33F EB                   ex de,hl
 437+ C340 C9                   ret

 439+ C341              ; Returns NZ if the VTOL hits a building: its footprint (10 m x 3 m, turned
 440+ C341              ; to the heading; vtol_ground) is over a roof less than COLL_H below it.
 441+ C341              check_collision:
 442+ C341 CD 4B AB             call vtol_ground                ; HL = highest ground under it
 443+ C344 C8                   ret z                           ; all road
