 445+ C348 19                   add hl,de
 446+ C349 ED 5B 95 AD          ld de,(cam_y)
 447+ C34D B7                   or a
 448+ C34E ED 52                sbc hl,de                       ; height+M - camY
 449+ C350 38 05                jr c,.no
 450+ C352 28 03                jr z,.no
 451+ C354 F6 01                or 1                            ; NZ: collision
 452+ C356 C9                   ret
 453+ C357 AF           .no:    xor a
 454+ C358 C9                   ret
 455+ C359
 456+ C359              ; The VTOL has been destroyed (vtol_dead): the controls do nothing.  It
 457+ C359              ; spins DEAD_SPIN a frame and falls, a unit a frame faster each frame (up
 458+ C359              ; to DEAD_FALL_MAX), until it hits the ground under it (floor_y: the road,
 459+ C359              ; or the highest roof under its footprint).  Once down it lies still for
 460+ C359              ; DEAD_PAUSE frames, then sets game_over (main_loop: the GAME OVER screen,
 461+ C359              ; then the main menu).
 462+ C359              vtol_wreck:
 463+ C359 AF                   xor a
 464+ C35A 32 9B AD             ld (speed),a
 465+ C35D 3A AE AD             ld a,(dead_down)
 466+ C360 B7                   or a
 467+ C361 20 39                jr nz,.down
 468+ C363 2A 97 AD             ld hl,(yaw_frac)                ; spin
 469+ C366 11 00 08             ld de,DEAD_SPIN
 470+ C369 19                   add hl,de
 471+ C36A 22 97 AD             ld (yaw_frac),hl
 472+ C36D 3A AF AD             ld a,(dead_vy)                  ; fall, faster each frame
 473+ C370 FE 08                cp DEAD_FALL_MAX
 474+ C372 30 04                jr nc,.vy
 475+ C374 3C                   inc a
 476+ C375 32 AF AD             ld (dead_vy),a
 477+ C378 5F           .vy:    ld e,a
 478+ C379 16 00                ld d,0
 479+ C37B 2A 95 AD             ld hl,(cam_y)
 480+ C37E B7                   or a
 481+ C37F ED 52                sbc hl,de
 482+ C381 30 03                jr nc,.y
 483+ C383 21 00 00             ld hl,0
 484+ C386 E5           .y:     push hl
 485+ C387 CD A6 A7             call floor_y                    ; HL = the ground under it
 486+ C38A EB                   ex de,hl
 487+ C38B E1                   pop hl
 488+ C38C B7                   or a
 489+ C38D ED 52                sbc hl,de
 490+ C38F 19                   add hl,de
 491+ C390 30 06                jr nc,.set                      ; still above it
 492+ C392 EB                   ex de,hl                        ; hit the ground: on it
 493+ C393 3E 01                ld a,1
 494+ C395 32 AE AD             ld (dead_down),a
 495+ C398 22 95 AD     .set:   ld (cam_y),hl
 496+ C39B C9                   ret
 497+ C39C 21 B0 AD     .down:  ld hl,dead_wait                 ; on the ground: the pause, then
 498+ C39F 35                   dec (hl)                        ; GAME OVER
 499+ C3A0 C0                   ret nz
 500+ C3A1 3E 01                ld a,1
 501+ C3A3 32 B3 AD             ld (game_over),a
 502+ C3A6 C9                   ret
 503+ C3A7
 504+ C3A7              ; One damping step: move the signed 8.8 pitch (pitch_frac/pitch) towards 0
 505+ C3A7              ; by max(PDAMP_MIN, |whole pitch| * PDAMP_K), stopping exactly at 0.
 506+ C3A7              ; Calculated rather than looked up: the Z80N MUL makes it as quick as a
 507+ C3A7              ; table, and the curve stays editable through the two equates.
 508+ C3A7              pitch_damp:
 509+ C3A7 2A 99 AD             ld hl,(pitch_frac)
 510+ C3AA 7C                   ld a,h
 511+ C3AB B5                   or l
 512+ C3AC C8                   ret z                           ; already level
 513+ C3AD 7C                   ld a,h
 514+ C3AE F5                   push af                         ; sign
 515+ C3AF CD 51 AD             call abs_hl
 516+ C3B2 54                   ld d,h                          ; whole part of |pitch|
 517+ C3B3 1E 00                ld e,PDAMP_K
 518+ C3B5 ED 30                mul d,e                         ; DE = step
 519+ C3B7 7A                   ld a,d
 520+ C3B8 B7                   or a
 521+ C3B9 20 08                jr nz,.sub
 522+ C3BB 7B                   ld a,e
 523+ C3BC FE 80                cp PDAMP_MIN
 524+ C3BE 30 03                jr nc,.sub
 525+ C3C0 11 80 00             ld de,PDAMP_MIN
 526+ C3C3 B7           .sub:   or a
 527+ C3C4 ED 52                sbc hl,de
 528+ C3C6 30 03                jr nc,.sgn
 529+ C3C8 21 00 00             ld hl,0                         ; would pass level: stop at 0
 530+ C3CB F1           .sgn:   pop af
 531+ C3CC 17                   rla                             ; carry = was nose down
 532+ C3CD DC 4A AD             call c,neg_hl
 533+ C3D0 22 99 AD             ld (pitch_frac),hl
 534+ C3D3 C9                   ret

 538+ C3D4              ;==============================================================================
 539+ C3D4 00 00 00...  old_pos:    ds 10                       ; cam_x, cam_z, cam_y, yaw before the move
 540+ C3DE 00           st_a:       db 0                        ; strafe: the pulse's direction
 541+ C3DF 01           pd_count:   db PDAMP_FRAMES             ; frames to the next damping step

   1+ C000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ C000              ; Z-POLICE - weapons page (8K page PAGE_WEAPONS, runs at $C000 in slot 6)
   3+ C000              ;
   4+ C000              ; Player weapons.  Paged in by main_loop with nextreg LOGIC_MMU,PAGE_WEAPONS
   5+ C000              ; (the keys page in slot 7) after
   6+ C000              ; the frame is set up (it uses sin_y/cos_y/sin_p/cos_p) and the zombies have
   7+ C000              ; moved.  Bullet state lives in the resident `bullets` table so that the city
   8+ C000              ; page can draw the tracers (draw_bullets).
   9+ C000              ;
  10+ C000              ; Keys 1-5 select the weapon slot that SPACE fires (wpn_sel: 1 = the centre
  11+ C000              ; slot, 2-5 = the wing pylons).  An empty slot isn't selected: the HUD
  12+ C000              ; flashes it instead (wflash_slot / wflash_t).  What is fitted where is set
  13+ C000              ; on the load-out screen between levels (loadout.asm).
  14+ C000              ;
  15+ C000              ; Machine gun (WPN_GUN, the centre slot): hold SPACE to fire one round every
  16+ C000              ; GUN_INTERVAL frames.  Rounds leave the ship's centre line 0.5 m below the
  17+ C000              ; camera and fly straight along the view direction at 500 m/s until they hit
  18+ C000              ; something.
  19+ C000              ;
  20+ C000              ; Collision, every frame for every round in flight: the path from its last
  21+ C000              ; position to its new one (BULLET_STEP long) is walked cell by cell through
  22+ C000              ; the city grid, in order (a 2D DDA on the horizontal distance s along the
  23+ C000              ; path).  The first thing met ends the path:
  24+ C000              ;   * a building cell: hit where the path enters the cell if it is below the
  25+ C000              ;     roof there (a wall), otherwise where it drops below the roof (the roof);
  26+ C000              ;   * a street cell marked as holding zombies (CELL_ZOMBIE): those in it, each a box
  27+ C000              ;     0.5 m wide and 2 m tall, nearest along the path first;
  28+ C000              ;   * the ground, where the path reaches height 0;
  29+ C000              ;   * leaving the GRID x GRID map: the round is gone.
  30+ C000              ; A round that hits is drawn once at the impact point, then freed.  A zombie
  31+ C000              ; that is hit loses B_DMG hit points; at 0 it is killed (its map blip
  32+ C000              ; removed, its record made inactive).  A rocket also bursts (rocket_blast).
  33+ C000              ;
  34+ C000              ; Rocket pod (WPN_ROCKETS, a wing pylon, ROCKET_SHOTS rockets): rockets are
  35+ C000              ; rounds too (B_KIND = BK_ROCKET), at 150 m/s and drawn as a short white
  36+ C000              ; streak with a yellow trail.  Wherever one stops (a building, the ground,
  37+ C000              ; a zombie) rocket_blast does BLAST_DMG to every zombie, human and base tile
  38+ C000              ; within BLAST_R on each axis, and sprays BLAST_PARTS orange particles.
  39+ C000              ;
  40+ C000              ; Autocannon (WPN_AUTOCANNON, a wing pylon, AUTOCANNON_SHOTS shells): the
  41+ C000              ; machine gun's rounds (B_KIND = BK_AUTOCANNON, drawn as tracers) one every
  42+ C000              ; AUTOCANNON_INTERVAL frames; each bursts where it stops: AUTOCANNON_DMG
  43+ C000              ; within AUTOCANNON_R (3 m) on each axis, AUTOCANNON_PARTS particles.
  44+ C000              ;
  45+ C000              ; Proximity cannon (WPN_PROX, a wing pylon, PROX_SHOTS shells): the
  46+ C000              ; autocannon (B_KIND = BK_PROX), its shells also bursting when they pass within
  47+ C000              ; PROX_R (2 m) of a monster (b_pr widens the monster hit boxes,
  48+ C000              ; cell_zombies); the burst does PROX_DMG within PROX_R on each axis.
  49+ C000              ;
  50+ C000              ; Missile pod (WPN_MISSILE, a wing pylon, MISSILE_SHOTS missiles): as the
  51+ C000              ; rockets (B_KIND = BK_MISSILE, drawn the same) at half the speed; the burst
  52+ C000              ; does MISSILE_DMG within MISSILE_R (1.0 tile) on each axis, and sprays
  53+ C000              ; MISSILE_PARTS particles.  Guided: one fires only with a target locked
  54+ C000              ; (lock_update: the reticule), and turns towards it (msl_steer) at
  55+ C000              ; MISSILE_TURN a frame until it is more than LOCK_RANGE away.
  56+ C000              ;
  57+ C000              ; Damage: each round carries its damage (B_DMG): machine gun GUN_DMG, chain
  58+ C000              ; gun CHAIN_DMG, the laser LASER_DMG a beam frame, a rocket none directly
  59+ C000              ; (only its blast).  A zombie dies when its hit points (+18) run out.
  60+ C000              ;
  61+ C000              ; Positions are world units (1 tile = 20 m = 256 units, 1 m = 12.8).  Along the path,
  62+ C000              ; x = x0 + s*sinY, z = z0 + s*cosY and y = y0 + s*slope, with sinY/cosY the
  63+ C000              ; S7.8 heading at firing and slope = tan(pitch) in S7.8.
  64+ C000              ;==============================================================================
  65+ C000
  66+ C000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  67+ C000              ; Per frame: fire, then move every round in flight
  68+ C000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  69+ C000              update_weapons:
  70+ C000 CD 31 D1             call part_update                ; age and move the burst particles
  71+ C003 3A AD AD             ld a,(vtol_dead)
  72+ C006 B7                   or a
  73+ C007 28 0B                jr z,.alive

  75+ C00C CD CA C5             call lock_off                   ;   no lock

  81+ C017 CD F8 CD             call debug_gun_cycle            ; (debug: key 7)
  82+ C01A                  ENDIF
  83+ C01A CD C6 CD             call wpn_select                 ; (slots can be chosen when landed)
  84+ C01D CD 78 CA             call gun_aim                    ; and the centre gun tilted
  85+ C020 CD 36 AB             call vtol_landed
  86+ C023 20 0B                jr nz,.fire
  87+ C025 CD D3 CE             call las_reset                  ; landed: no firing, no beam, until
  88+ C028 CD CA C5             call lock_off                   ; it takes off (nor a lock); on the
  89+ C02B CD E8 CE             call pad_service                ; pad: repairs and reloads

 340+ C243              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 341+ C243              ; Aim assist, for a centre slot round IX just spawned, pointing where the gun
 342+ C243              ; does (or a linked chain gun's, from its own muzzle: each on its own): the

 345+ C243              ; AIM_DEV steps of the path, or its box on the path already.  The round turns to its middle, at most
 346+ C243              ; AIM_DEV steps sideways and AIM_DEV up or down: aa_d and aa_ds, kept for the
 347+ C243              ; frame's shots (aim_apply) and the sight.  Only the round: the view doesn't
 348+ C243              ; move.  A chain gun's spread goes on top.
 349+ C243              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------

 709+ C52D              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 710+ C52D              ; The missile lock, each frame in flight.  With the missile pod selected the
 711+ C52D              ; reticule is shown (ret_on).  Searching (lock_state 0), it wanders the view.
 712+ C52D              ; A monster drawn last frame (fig_seen: +31) within LOCK_RANGE of the VTOL
 713+ C52D              ; along x and z, the nearest, becomes the target (lock_tgt): locking (1),
 714+ C52D              ; the reticule moves to where it was drawn (+32, +33) at RET_STEP pixels a
 715+ C52D              ; frame, and after LOCK_TIME frames on it (within LOCK_NEAR) the target is
 716+ C52D              ; locked (2): the lock tone, and the reticule stays on it.  The target lost
 717+ C52D              ; (killed, out of view, out of range) it searches again.  With a target,
 718+ C52D              ; K_TARGET (M) moves to the next one (lk_next).  Then the drawn marks are
 719+ C52D              ; cleared for this frame's drawing.
 720+ C52D              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------

1154+ C837
1155+ C837              ; Bomb IX, before its step: every BOMB_STEEPEN frames (B_PIT's low byte

1157+ C837              ; to -MSL_PITCH_MAX, and its direction afresh

1576+ CB54              ; A lich's fireballs, every frame (not with the VTOL a wreck).  A lich with

   1+ C000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ C000              ; Z-POLICE - main menu (8K page PAGE_MAINMENU, runs at $C000 in slot 6)
   3+ C000              ;
   4+ C000              ; Shown after start-up, after game over, a load error, and quitting from the
   5+ C000              ; pause (menu_go, zpolice.asm, pages it in).  Drawn on Layer 2 at 320x256
   6+ C000              ; (screen320, text.asm; layer2-320x256.asm in slot 2) in the large font
   7+ C000              ; (26 x 25 characters), over a picture: ZPDATA/MAINMENU.ZPI, read from the
   8+ C000              ; SD card as the menu opens (l320_image; tools/screen_editor.py edits it),
   9+ C000              ; drawn first as the background, the text printed over it with no paper.  Every frame it
  10+ C000              ; advances the random number generator (zrand), so the game doesn't start
  11+ C000              ; from the same seed each time (the wait for a key press varies), then reads
  12+ C000              ; the keys:
  13+ C000              ;   1  New game   -> newGame (zpolice.asm): level 1
  14+ C000              ;   2  Continue   -> the save game (made by save and quit, from the pause:
  15+ C000              ;                 game_pause), its level at its wave (load_save,
  16+ C000              ;                 continue_game, zpolice.asm); NO SAVED GAME if there's none
  17+ C000              ;   9  Redefine keys -> keydef_screen (keydef.asm)
  18+ C000              ; The game start puts the game's Layer 2 back (l2_game_mode).
  19+ C000              ;==============================================================================
  20+ C000
  21+ C000              MM_COL          equ 2               ; the options' column
  22+ C000              MM_NOSAVE_ROW   equ 18
  23+ C000
  24+ C000              main_menu:
  25+ C000 CD D6 A0             call screen320                  ; (text.asm) the input page in slot 7
  26+ C003 21 A6 C0             ld hl,mm_img                    ; the background picture (none
  27+ C006 CD 86 45             call l320_image                 ; without the file: the plain screen)
  28+ C009 3E E3                ld a,L320_NOPAPER               ; the text over it
  29+ C00B 32 AE 58             ld (l320_paper),a
  30+ C00E 21 4E C0             ld hl,mm_text                   ; title and options
  31+ C011 CD DC 41             call l320_print_list
  32+ C014 CD 43 A1     .loop:  call menu_frame                 ; one video frame
  33+ C017 CD 01 27             call zrand                      ; stir the random number generator
  34+ C01A CD 00 E0             call kbd_scan
  35+ C01D 21 01 03             ld hl,KB_1
  36+ C020 CD F1 E0             call key_code_pressed
  37+ C023 C2 F6 A3             jp nz,newGame
  38+ C026 21 02 04             ld hl,KB_9                      ; redefine keys
  39+ C029 CD F1 E0             call key_code_pressed
  40+ C02C C2 FB A7             jp nz,keydef_go                 ; (zpolice.asm)
  41+ C02F 21 02 03             ld hl,KB_2                      ; continue the save game
  42+ C032 CD F1 E0             call key_code_pressed
  43+ C035 28 DD                jr z,.loop
  44+ C037 CD 98 AA             call load_save                  ; (zpolice.asm; pages the file
  45+ C03A D2 D4 AA             jp nc,continue_game             ; handler in)
  46+ C03D ED 91 57 0C          nextreg CODE_MMU,PAGE_INPUT     ; none (or not usable): say so
  47+ C041 11 06 12             ld de,MM_NOSAVE_ROW<<8 | (F12_COLS-13)/2
  48+ C044 0E E0                ld c,SCR_BAD
  49+ C046 21 98 C0             ld hl,txt_no_save
  50+ C049 CD D0 41             call l320_print_at
  51+ C04C 18 C6                jr .loop
  52+ C04E
  53+ C04E              ; row, column, colour, text, 0 ... $FF
  54+ C04E              mm_text:

  56+ C051 5A 2D 50 4F          db "Z-POLICE", 0
  56+ C055 4C 49 43 45
  56+ C059 00

   1+ C000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ C000              ; Z-POLICE - level complete screen (8K page PAGE_LEVELEND, runs at $C000 in
   3+ C000              ; slot 6)
   4+ C000              ;
   5+ C000              ; The level's last wave wiped out (main_loop pages it in): LEVEL n COMPLETE,
   6+ C000              ; the weapons rearmed, those aboard rescued, the humans saved and the
   7+ C000              ; salvage, and a line for each reward the salvage gives; then PRESS SPACE TO
   8+ C000              ; CONTINUE and the load-out screen (loadout_go).  After the last level, the
   9+ C000              ; game complete screen instead (game_done_go: menu.asm).  Drawn on Layer 2

  33+ C011 06 2F                ld b,'0'-1                      ; level below LEVEL_LAST: 1 or 2)

  53+ C032 ED B0                ldir
  54+ C034 D1                   pop de
  55+ C035 16 02                ld d,LE_TITLE_ROW
  56+ C037 0E FC                ld c,SCR_TITLE
  57+ C039 21 52 C0             ld hl,txt_level_done
  58+ C03C CD D0 41             call l320_print_at
  59+ C03F CD 6E C0             call rearm_all                  ; every weapon's ammo full again
  60+ C042 CD 50 32             call hum_unload_all             ; (human.asm) those aboard: rescued
  61+ C045 CD 90 C0             call salvage_award              ; the humans saved: salvage, unlocks
  62+ C048 CD F5 C3             call le_space

  77+ C06E              ; End of a level: every slot's weapon gets its full load again (wpn_cfg,

  97+ C090              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  98+ C090              ; Salvage, at the end of a level: each human saved this level (saved) adds
  99+ C090              ; a salvage point (salvage_points).  Every point total in salvage_tab that
 100+ C090              ; the new total reaches (passed over from the old one) gives its rewards: a
 101+ C090              ; weapon unlocked (one more of that type in wpn_stock, for the load-out page)
 102+ C090              ; and / or (SA_* flags) a full repair (vtol_hp = VTOL_HP) or the booster
 103+ C090              ; module (fitted at once, its tank full).  After the table's last total,
 104+ C090              ; SALVAGE_TAIL, every SALVAGE_STEP more points is a full repair.  Shown on
 105+ C090              ; the LEVEL COMPLETE screen: the humans saved, the salvage, and a line for
 106+ C090              ; each reward (rows SA_ROW0..SA_ROW_MAX; any more aren't shown).
 107+ C090              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 108+ C090              SA_REPAIR       equ 1               ; salvage_tab rewards (flags): full repair,
 109+ C090              SA_BOOSTER      equ 2               ;   the booster module,
 110+ C090              SA_NV_GREEN     equ 4               ;   vision modes (vision_owned): night
 111+ C090              SA_NV_MONO      equ 8               ;   vision green, monochrome,
 112+ C090              SA_THERMAL      equ 16              ;   thermal, the vertical thrusters
 113+ C090              SA_VTHRUST      equ 32              ;   (vthrust_fitted), the lateral
 114+ C090              SA_LTHRUST      equ 64              ;   thrusters (lthrust_fitted)
 115+ C090              SALVAGE_TAIL    equ 145
 116+ C090              SALVAGE_STEP    equ 5
 117+ C090              SA_ROW0         equ 10
 118+ C090              SA_ROW_MAX      equ 21
 119+ C090              salvage_award:
 120+ C090 16 05                ld d,LE_SAVED_ROW               ; HUMANS SAVED n

 180+ C108              ; Carry set if total DE is reached this time: sa_old < DE <= salvage_points.
 181+ C108              ; Preserves BC, DE.
 182+ C108              sa_reached:

   1+ C000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ C000              ; Z-POLICE - level loading (8K page PAGE_LEVEL, game logic: runs at $C000 in
   3+ C000              ; slot 6; it pages the file handler, PAGE_FILE, into slot 7)
   4+ C000              ;
   5+ C000              ; Each level is a file, ZPDATA/LEVELnn.ZPL, naming its city, ZPDATA/CITYnn.ZPC
   6+ C000              ; (both made by gentables.py; the formats are described there).  A city is
   7+ C000              ; played for several levels.  load_level reads both:
   8+ C000              ;   * the level record into level_cur (levels.asm): city name, zombie and
   9+ C000              ;     wave counts, the draw distance, ...;
  10+ C000              ;   * the city into the city bank (page 7, slot 3): city_col at $6000 and
  11+ C000              ;     city_map at $7000, one 8K read;
  12+ C000              ;   * the level's own map changes (x, z, cell code, city_col), for hand-made
  13+ C000              ;     layouts;
  14+ C000              ;   * the city's palette and sky colour into the Layer 2 palette, then the
  15+ C000              ;     level's own palette over it, if it has one (ZPDATA/LEVELnn.ZPP);
  16+ C000              ;   * view_r / dot_r from the draw distance (2..VIEW_R tiles).
  17+ C000              ; Loading the map also clears every cell's zombie and human marks.  The
  18+ C000              ; files must be in the ZPDATA folder beside zpolice.nex on the SD card.
  19+ C000              ;==============================================================================
  20+ C000
  21+ C000              ; Level file
  22+ C000              LVF_CITY        equ 5               ; city number
  23+ C000              LVF_REC         equ 6               ; the level record (LV_SIZE bytes)
  24+ C000              LVF_NCHG        equ LVF_REC+LV_SIZE ; number of map changes,
  25+ C000              LVF_CHG         equ LVF_NCHG+1      ; then x, z, cell code, city_col each

  27+ C000              LVF_MAX         equ LVF_CHG+4*LVF_CHG_MAX
  28+ C000              ; City file

  33+ C000              LPF_PAL         equ 8               ; the palette, 256 pairs
  34+ C000              LPF_SIZE        equ LPF_PAL+512

  36+ C000              CITY_VERSION    equ 1               ;   level file's 2 (specials by wave)

   1+ C000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ C000              ; Z-POLICE - load-out screen (8K page PAGE_LOADOUT, runs at $C000 in slot 6)
   3+ C000              ;
   4+ C000              ; Before the first level (newGame) and between levels, after LEVEL COMPLETE
   5+ C000              ; (loadout_go pages it in).  On the
   6+ C000              ; left, the store: every weapon type unlocked (wpn_unlocked) with the number
   7+ C000              ; in store (wpn_stock), even 0 when the only one is fitted.  On the right,
   8+ C000              ; the VTOL's 5 weapon slots: a picture of the VTOL (ZPDATA/VTOL.ZPI, read
   9+ C000              ; from the SD card as the screen opens: l320_image) drawn first, as the
  10+ C000              ; background, with a box and the number at each slot's hardpoint (lo_hp),
  11+ C000              ; and the list of what is fitted in each.  The text is printed over the
  12+ C000              ; picture (no paper); a field that changes gets its piece of the background
  13+ C000              ; back first (l320_bg_save, l320_restore).
  14+ C000              ;   1-5    select a slot (yellow)
  15+ C000              ;   Q / A  move the highlight up / down the store list.  The highlighted
  16+ C000              ;          weapon is green if it can be fitted in the selected slot (the
  17+ C000              ;          slot allows it, wpn_fits, and one is in store), red if not; the
  18+ C000              ;          rest of the list is white.
  19+ C000              ;   SPACE  fit the highlighted weapon in the selected slot, if it can be:
  20+ C000              ;          one comes out of the store, with a full load (WCFG_LOAD), and
  21+ C000              ;          whatever was fitted there goes back into the store
  22+ C000              ;   U      unload the selected slot: its weapon back into the store, the
  23+ C000              ;          slot EMPTY (lo_unload)
  24+ C000              ;   0      done: start the level (next_level), only with a weapon in slot 1
  25+ C000              ;          (the centre slot); while it is empty 0: START LEVEL is red
  26+ C000              ; Drawn on Layer 2 at 320x256 (screen320, text.asm; layer2-320x256.asm in
  27+ C000              ; slot 2), with the keys page in slot 7: the title, help and START LEVEL in
  28+ C000              ; the large font (26 x 25 grid), the headings and lists in the 8x8 one (40
  29+ C000              ; x 32 grid: they need the columns).

# file opened: keydef.asm
   1+ C000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ C000              ; Z-POLICE - redefine keys screen (8K page PAGE_KEYDEF, runs at $C000 in
   3+ C000              ; slot 6)
   4+ C000              ;
   5+ C000              ; From the main menu (option 9, keydef_go pages it in).  Lists every control
   6+ C000              ; (K_ACTIONS of them) with its key (key_defs) and its joystick input
   7+ C000              ; (joy_defs, "-" for none; input.asm).
   8+ C000              ;   Q / A  move the highlight up / down the list (white; highlighted green);
   9+ C000              ;          KD_VIS rows of it show, scrolling to keep the highlight in view
  10+ C000              ;   SPACE  "PRESS A KEY OR JOYSTICK", a second's pause, then the next input
  11+ C000              ;          becomes the highlighted control's key, or its joystick input if
  12+ C000              ;          it is a joystick's, unless another control already uses it: then
  13+ C000              ;          "KEY ALREADY IN USE" (for a second) and no change
  14+ C000              ;   0      every key and joystick input back to its default (key_defaults,
  15+ C000              ;          joy_defaults)
  16+ C000              ;   1      back to the main menu (menu_go), saving the definitions first if
  17+ C000              ;          they changed (kd_save; "KEYS NOT SAVED" for a second if they
  18+ C000              ;          couldn't be)
  19+ C000              ; These keys are fixed (key_code_pressed), whatever the controls are set to.
  20+ C000              ; Drawn on Layer 2 at 320x256 (screen320, text.asm; layer2-320x256.asm in
  21+ C000              ; slot 2), with the input page in slot 7: the title, messages and help in
  22+ C000              ; the large font (26 x 25 grid), the headings and the list in the 8x8 one
  23+ C000              ; (40 x 32 grid: they need the columns).
  24+ C000              ;
  25+ C000              ; The definitions are kept on the SD card as ZPDATA/KEYS.ZPK (beside the level
  26+ C000              ; files): "ZPKY", KF_VERSION, K_ACTIONS, then key_defs and joy_defs (2 bytes
  27+ C000              ; each control).  start loads them (kd_load, with this page in slot 6), if the
  28+ C000              ; file is there and fits this game: else the defaults.
  29+ C000              ;==============================================================================
  30+ C000
  31+ C000              KD_TITLE_ROW    equ 1               ; (large font)
  32+ C000              KD_HEAD_ROW     equ 3               ; the columns' headings (8x8)
  33+ C000              KD_ROW0         equ 4               ; first row of the list (8x8)
  34+ C000              KD_NAME_COL     equ 2               ; control names,
  35+ C000              KD_KEY_COL      equ 18              ; their keys,
  36+ C000              KD_KEY_LEN      equ 7               ;   (key names at most this long)
  37+ C000              KD_JOY_COL      equ 28              ; their joystick inputs
  38+ C000              KD_JOY_LEN      equ 8               ;   (joystick names at most this long)
  39+ C000                      ASSERT KD_KEY_COL + KD_KEY_LEN < KD_JOY_COL && KD_JOY_COL + KD_JOY_LEN <= L320_COLS-1
  40+ C000              KD_MSG_ROW      equ 22              ; messages (large font)
  41+ C000              KD_HELP_ROW     equ 23              ; the keys' help, two lines (large)
  42+ C000              KD_PAUSE        equ 50              ; a second of 50 Hz frames
  43+ C000              KD_VIS          equ 23              ; controls shown at once (the list scrolls)
  44+ C000                      ASSERT (KD_ROW0 + KD_VIS)*8 <= F12_Y0 + KD_MSG_ROW*F12_H  ; (more than

 349+ C234              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 350+ C234              ; Saving and loading the definitions (ZPDATA/KEYS.ZPK).  They are in the

# file opened: specials.asm
   1+ C000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ C000              ; Z-POLICE - special monsters (8K page PAGE_SPECIAL, game logic: runs at
   3+ C000              ; $C000 in slot 6)
   4+ C000              ;
   5+ C000              ; Special monsters use the zombie records after the zombies' own (NZOMB ..
   6+ C000              ; NMON-1, zombie.asm), so they share the zombies' drawing (zombie_cell,
   7+ C000              ; fig_draw), map blips, cell marks (zflags), weapon hits and zdamage.  The
   8+ C000              ; record's type (+15) says which monster it is.  Each wave's specials come
   9+ C000              ; from the level file (level_cur, LV_WAVE_DATA: up to LV_SPEC_SLOTS types,
  10+ C000              ; SPEC_*, and how many of each), placed by spec_wave as the wave starts;
  11+ C000              ; the level's start is wave 1 (spec_init).  spec_update moves them each
  12+ C000              ; frame, after zombie_update.
  13+ C000              ;
  14+ C000              ; The ghost (ZT_GHOST, special monster id SPEC_GHOST): a stick man under a white
  15+ C000              ; sheet.  It can't attack the base.  It flies at twice the zombies' speed,
  16+ C000              ; at any angle, and up and down between the ground and the VTOL's ceiling
  17+ C000              ; (MAX_Y), over buildings lower than it.
  18+ C000              ;   * Roaming: it flies in a random direction (a random climb or descent
  19+ C000              ;     too) until something makes it turn: a building in the way or the map
  20+ C000              ;     edge (a new random direction at once), or, at its decision check
  21+ C000              ;     every GHOST_DECIDE (30) frames, a human or the VTOL within GHOST_SEE
  22+ C000              ;     (3 tiles) that it can see.
  23+ C000              ;   * Chasing: it flies straight at the nearest one it can see, aiming
  24+ C000              ;     again every GHOST_TRACK (5) frames.  If it loses sight of its target
  25+ C000              ;     (behind a taller building) or the target is gone, it roams again in a
  26+ C000              ;     random direction, back on the 30-frame cycle.
  27+ C000              ;   * Attacking: within ATTACK_R (0.1 tile) of its target on each axis it
  28+ C000              ;     stops and takes GHOST_DMG hit point every GHOST_HIT_FRAMES (10)
  29+ C000              ;     frames: from a human (HUMAN_HP) until it dies, or from the VTOL
  30+ C000              ;     (vtol_hp, VTOL_HP; at 0 it is destroyed and the game ends).  Its map blip is red
  31+ C000              ;     meanwhile (zatk_flags, zblip_red), as an attacking zombie's.  If the
  32+ C000              ;     target moves out of reach it chases it again; once the human is dead
  33+ C000              ;     it roams again.
  34+ C000              ;   * It has GHOST_HP (10) hit points; any weapon can shoot it.  Killed, it
  35+ C000              ;     fades out where it is, white to near black in 4 steps of 3 frames
  36+ C000              ;     (GM_DYING; zdamage starts it, zombie_draw colours it, g_dying ends
  37+ C000              ;     it), and can't be hit meanwhile.
  38+ C000              ; Ghost record fields, besides the zombies' (zombie.asm):
  39+ C000              ;   +11 frames to its next decision check, +16 mode (GM_*), +17 frames to
  40+ C000              ;   its next blow, +18 hit points, +21,+22 height of its feet, +23,+24 and
  41+ C000              ;   +25,+26 velocity x, z (signed 8.8 units a frame), +27,+28 the x and z
  42+ C000              ;   position fractions, +29 climb (signed units a frame), +30 target
  43+ C000              ;   (TG_NONE, TG_VTOL, or a human's index).
  44+ C000              ;==============================================================================
  45+ C000
  46+ C000              GHOST_HP        equ 10              ; hit points
  47+ C000              GHOST_DECIDE    equ 30              ; frames between decisions while roaming
  48+ C000              GHOST_TRACK     equ 5               ; and while chasing
  49+ C000              GHOST_SEE       equ 3*TILE_UNITS    ; it spots humans / the VTOL this near
  50+ C000              GHOST_HIT_FRAMES equ 10             ; frames between blows
  51+ C000              GHOST_DMG       equ 1               ; hit points a blow
  52+ C000              GHOST_CLIMB     equ 1               ; units a frame up or down
  53+ C000              GHOST_AIM_MIN   equ 80              ; (aiming: nearer counts as this far)
  54+ C000              GM_ROAM         equ 0               ; modes (+16)
  55+ C000              GM_CHASE        equ 1
  56+ C000              GM_ATTACK       equ 2
  57+ C000              GM_DYING        equ 3               ; killed: fading out (+17 frames left)
  58+ C000              GHOST_FADE_FRAMES equ 12            ; the fade: 4 steps of 3 frames
  59+ C000              TG_NONE         equ $FF             ; targets (+30)
  60+ C000              TG_VTOL         equ $FE
  61+ C000              TG_BASE         equ $C0             ; + a base tile's index (base_hp, 0..24)
  62+ C000              ; The banshee (ZT_BANSHEE, id SPEC_BANSHEE): a ghost that flies twice as
  63+ C000              ; fast, reaches BANSHEE_R (0.5 tile), does BANSHEE_DMG a blow and also
  64+ C000              ; attacks the base (the terrace and pad tiles).
  65+ C000              ; The ghoul (ZT_GHOUL, id SPEC_GHOUL, zombie.asm): a half-height zombie
  66+ C000              ; walking at five times the zombies' speed.  It is placed here (spec_wave)
  67+ C000              ; but moved, drawn and hit as a zombie.
  68+ C000              ; The lich (ZT_LICH, id SPEC_LICH): a city's boss, in the last wave of its
  69+ C000              ; last level (the level files).  Placed here (lich_init); walks as a zombie
  70+ C000              ; at 4 times the speed, drawn at LICH_H; shoots fireballs at the VTOL
  71+ C000              ; (lich_update, weapons.asm).  Each city's is harder: LICH_HP + LICH_HP_STEP
  72+ C000              ; hit points a city before it, and a shot every LICH_RATE frames,
  73+ C000              ; LICH_RATE_STEP fewer a city before it, at least LICH_RATE_MIN.  Its
  74+ C000              ; record: +18 and +23 (LICH_HP_HI) its hit points, 16 bits; +24 (LICH_WAIT)
  75+ C000              ; frames to its next shot; +25 (LICH_FRAMES) frames between.
  76+ C000              ; The devil (ZT_DEVIL, id SPEC_DEVIL): the final boss (devil.asm).
  77+ C000              ; (Which waves have which is the level files' business: gentables.py.)
  78+ C000              BANSHEE_HP      equ 8
  79+ C000              BANSHEE_DMG     equ 5
  80+ C000              BANSHEE_R       equ TILE_UNITS/2

  83+ C000              LICH_HP_STEP    equ 5               ; more a city

  85+ C000              LICH_RATE_STEP  equ 5               ; fewer a city
  86+ C000              LICH_RATE_MIN   equ 10

  89+ C000              ; A level's start: every special record inactive, then wave 1's specials
  90+ C000              ; (the level's start is wave 1, as any other: spec_wave)

 102+ C018 DD 36 13 FF          ld (ix+19),$FF                  ; no cell marked

 105+ C021 0C                   inc c
 106+ C022 10 E4                djnz .lp

 108+ C027 CD 1D C1             call spec_wave                  ; wave 1's specials (wave_number 1)
 109+ C02A C3 4D 22             jp zflags                       ; (zombie.asm) mark their cells

 111+ C02D              ; Special monster IX (record sp_idx) of type sp_type: at a random street
 112+ C02D              ; position and height, roaming in a random direction

 115+ C030 DD 77 0F             ld (ix+15),a

 117+ C036 CD 01 27     .try:   call zrand                      ; (zombie page)

 170+ C0AD              ; the cells again

 226+ C11D              ; A new wave began (zwave_new, zombie.asm; spec_init for wave 1): its
 227+ C11D              ; specials from the level file (level_cur, LV_WAVE_DATA: wave_number's
 228+ C11D              ; record), each of its LV_SPEC_SLOTS types (SPEC_NONE: none) as many as it
 229+ C11D              ; says, into free special records.  Waves past LV_MAX_WAVES have none.
 230+ C11D              spec_wave:

 361+ C20F              ; Special monster IX's settings, from its type (+15): g_speed (8.8 units a
 362+ C20F              ; frame: a ghost twice the zombies' zspeed, a banshee four times), gp_range
 363+ C20F              ; (its reach on each axis), gp_dmg (a blow), gp_base (1: attacks the base)
 364+ C20F              g_params:

 366+ C212 6F                   ld l,a

 370+ C217 29                   add hl,hl

 402+ C252              ; Decision check: look for a human or the VTOL to chase

 419+ C277              ; A random direction: velocity g_speed at a random angle, and a random climb
 420+ C277              ; (-1, 0, +1, 0 units a frame)

 447+ C2AD C9                   ret

 449+ C2AE              ; Fly one frame: x, z by the velocity, unless that runs into a building
 450+ C2AE              ; taller than its feet or the map edge (then a new random direction, and a
 451+ C2AE              ; chase is given up); then the climb, kept between the roof or ground under
 452+ C2AE              ; it and MAX_Y

   2++C7C2              ; Z-POLICE - the final boss: the devil (in the special monsters' page,
   3++C7C2              ; PAGE_SPECIAL, at $C000 in slot 6: specials.asm includes it)
   4++C7C2              ;
   5++C7C2              ; Quatermass's horned Martian, ten building levels tall (DEVIL_H, 46 m) and a
   6++C7C2              ; whole square wide, in the last wave of the last level (the level files:
   7++C7C2              ; SPEC_DEVIL, alone).  It rises at the entrance to hell (HELL_X, HELL_Z: a
   8++C7C2              ; circle of road the level's map changes make) or, if that isn't road, on a
   9++C7C2              ; street at random (zplace).  A special monster record (zombie.asm), type
  10++C7C2              ; ZT_DEVIL; drawn by devil_draw (city2.asm) from its own graphics, which go
  11++C7C2              ; over the other monsters' pages when its wave starts (wave_prepare,
  12++C7C2              ; devil_load: only the zombies and humans are drawn with it).
  13++C7C2              ;   * It walks the streets to the landing pad, half a tile a step
  14++C7C2              ;     (DV_STEP_FR frames each: moving for DV_MOVE_FR, then planted), every
  15++C7C2              ;     footfall shaking the view.  At a cell's middle it takes the way that
  16++C7C2              ;     brings it nearest the pad (not back the way it came unless it must);
  17++C7C2              ;     a terrace or pad tile it steps onto is crushed (base_damage: the pad,
  18++C7C2              ;     game over).
  19++C7C2              ;   * Its eyes charge, black to blue, wherever the VTOL is, for
  20++C7C2              ;     DV_CHARGE_T interrupts (10 s; a rising whine for the last DV_HUM_T,
  21++C7C2              ;     3 s: SFX_CHARGE), then it fires lightning (a crackling zap and
  22++C7C2              ;     thunder: SFX_BOLT): straight at the
  23++C7C2              ;     VTOL, instantly, through anything in the way.  A building the bolt
  24++C7C2              ;     passes below the roof of comes down (dv_topple: DV_PARTS particles,
  25++C7C2              ;     falling 1 m every 2 frames to RUBBLE_H; the humans on it killed; the
  26++C7C2              ;     map in memory only).  The VTOL takes BOLT_DMG, spins 15-90 degrees
  27++C7C2              ;     either way (spin_rate, spin_t: player.asm), is pitched full up or
  28++C7C2              ;     down, and is braked to a stop as the air brake does (bolt_brake).
  29++C7C2              ;     Then DV_REST_T interrupts (2 s) before it charges again.
  30++C7C2              ;   * DEVIL_HP hit points (16 bits, as a lich's: +18 and LICH_HP_HI); its
  31++C7C2              ;     hit box DEVIL_HIT_R either side, DEVIL_H tall (weapons.asm).  Killed,
  32++C7C2              ;     it sinks into the ground over DV_DIE_FR frames in fire, then it's gone.
  33++C7C2              ; Its record, besides the zombies' fields: +4 heading (0 +z, 1 +x, 2 -z,
  34++C7C2              ; 3 -x), +5 its legs' frame, +7 1: stuck (nowhere to go), +11 the frame in
  35++C7C2              ; its step, +16 mode (0 walking, GM_DYING), +17 frames left sinking,
  36++C7C2              ; +21,+22 its feet (below the ground as it sinks), DV_EYES (0 resting,
  37++C7C2              ; 1 charging) and DV_T0 (isr_ticks when that began).
  38++C7C2              ;==============================================================================
  39++C7C2
  40++C7C2              DEVIL_HP        equ 1000
  41++C7C2              DV_STEP_FR      equ 24              ; frames a step
  42++C7C2              DV_MOVE_FR      equ 16              ; moving for this many of them
  43++C7C2              DV_STEP_U       equ TILE_UNITS/2/DV_MOVE_FR     ; units a frame (half a tile a step)
  44++C7C2                      ASSERT DV_STEP_U * DV_MOVE_FR == TILE_UNITS/2
  45++C7C2              DV_RANGE        equ 8*TILE_UNITS    ; it fires at the VTOL this near (160 m)
  46++C7C2              DV_CHARGE_T     equ 500             ; interrupts charging (10 s),
  47++C7C2              DV_HUM_T        equ 150             ;   the last of them whining (3 s: SFX_CHARGE)
  48++C7C2              DV_REST_T       equ 100             ; and resting after a shot (2 s)
  49++C7C2              BOLT_DMG        equ 10
  50++C7C2              BOLT_FRAMES     equ 4               ; frames the bolt is drawn
  51++C7C2              DV_EYE_H        equ DEVIL_H*108/DEVIL_SRC_H     ; its eyes' height (row 20)
  52++C7C2              DV_DIE_FR       equ 40              ; frames sinking, killed
  53++C7C2              DEVIL_HIT_R     equ 100             ; its hit box: this far either side (8 m),
  54++C7C2              DEVIL_AIM_H     equ 240             ;   DEVIL_H tall; the guns' aim: its chest
  55++C7C2                      ASSERT DEVIL_HIT_R < 255 && DEVIL_AIM_H < 256
  56++C7C2              DV_SINK         equ DEVIL_H/DV_DIE_FR+1         ; units a frame, dying

  58++C7C2              DV_TALL         equ 5               ; it walks through buildings under level 5

# file opened: zombie.asm
   1+ 2000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ 2000              ; Z-POLICE - zombie page (8K page PAGE_ZOMBIE, mapped at $2000 in MMU slot 1)
   3+ 2000              ;
   4+ 2000              ; Placeholder zombies: Layer 2 stick-man silhouettes walking the streets.
   5+ 2000              ; The page stays mapped at $2000 the whole time (slot 0 is used for paging
   6+ 2000              ; Layer 2 sections, slot 7 for the other code pages), so the city page can
   7+ 2000              ; call in here while it draws.
   8+ 2000              ;
   9+ 2000              ; Each zombie is a ZREC-byte record:
  10+ 2000              ;   +0,+1  x  8.8 fixed point in cell units (high byte = cell, low = fraction;
  11+ 2000              ;             the same as world units, one cell = 256)
  12+ 2000              ;   +2,+3  z  likewise
  13+ 2000              ;   +4     heading 0 = +z, 1 = +x, 2 = -z, 3 = -x  (yaw angle = heading*64;
  14+ 2000              ;             heading+1 turns right, heading+3 turns left)
  15+ 2000              ;   +5     walk animation phase 0..3
  16+ 2000              ;   +6     step accumulator: fraction of a world unit (4 bits)
  17+ 2000              ;   +7     wait: frames left standing still (0 = walking)
  18+ 2000              ;   +8,+9  cell (x, z) of the last turn decision ($FF = none)
  19+ 2000              ;   +10    active: 1 = in play, 0 = gone (not moved, linked or drawn)
  20+ 2000              ;   +11    frames until this zombie's next decision check
  21+ 2000              ;   +12,+13  cell (x, z) of its blip on the street map
  22+ 2000              ;   +14    1 = blip plotted
  23+ 2000              ;   +15    type: 0 = zombie, 1 = fast zombie (walks at twice the speed),
  24+ 2000              ;          ZT_GHOUL (a special: 5x, half height), ZT_LICH (a special: 4x,
  25+ 2000              ;          twice the height), ZT_GHOST, ZT_BANSHEE
  26+ 2000              ;   +16    mode: 0 = walking, 1 = going for a base tile, 2 = attacking it
  27+ 2000              ;   +17    frames to its next hit on the tile
  28+ 2000              ;   +18    hit points left (ZHP, ZHP_FAST; weapons.asm zdamage)
  29+ 2000              ;   +19,+20  cell (x, z) marked with CELL_ZOMBIE in city_map ($FF = none)
  30+ 2000              ;   +21,+22  height of its feet (0 for zombies; special monsters fly)
  31+ 2000              ;   +23..+30 special monsters' own fields (specials.asm)
  32+ 2000              ;   +31    bit 0: drawn last frame (fig_seen; moved to bit 1 by lk_clear,
  33+ 2000              ;          weapons.asm); bit 1: so, once the missile lock has used bit 0, for
  34+ 2000              ;          the guns (aim_assist)
  35+ 2000              ;   +32,+33  where: the centre column and row on the view (the missile lock)
  36+ 2000              ; Records 0..NZOMB-1 are the zombies, NZOMB..NMON-1 the special monsters
  37+ 2000              ; (specials.asm), which share the drawing, cell marks, map blips and weapon
  38+ 2000              ; hits; their type (+15) says which.
  39+ 2000              ; zatk_flags (one byte per zombie, by index): TRUE while it attacks a base
  40+ 2000              ; tile, when its map dot is red; FALSE again once the tile is destroyed.
  41+ 2000              ;
  42+ 2000              ; The base: at junctions a zombie leans towards the road that points at the
  43+ 2000              ; landing pad (zbias_t, from the level).  A base tile (terrace or pad) in its
  44+ 2000              ; way isn't avoided: it walks up to ATTACK_R from it and hits it every
  45+ 2000              ; ZHIT_FRAMES frames.  A destroyed terrace tile becomes road and the zombie
  46+ 2000              ; walks on; the pad destroyed sets game_over.
  47+ 2000              ;
  48+ 2000              ; Street map blips: zblip / zblip_off (map.asm) are called on the zombie's
  49+ 2000              ; decision-check frames.  Call zblip_off for a zombie before making it gone.
  50+ 2000              ;
  51+ 2000              ; Decisions are staggered: each active zombie only checks for junctions and
  52+ 2000              ; obstacles once every zsteps frames, with the zombies' check frames spread
  53+ 2000              ; out so only about NZOMB/zsteps of them check on any one frame.  In between
  54+ 2000              ; they just walk, so the look-ahead (zlook) covers zsteps frames of walking
  55+ 2000              ; plus a margin: ZMARGIN + zsteps*zspeed/16.
  56+ 2000              ;
  57+ 2000              ; Movement (zmove), every frame:
  58+ 2000              ;   * Standing still: count the wait down and do nothing else.
  59+ 2000              ;   * Not this zombie's check frame: step forwards (see the last point).
  60+ 2000              ;   * Junctions: once per cell, when the zombie is 0.25-0.75 of the way
  61+ 2000              ;     through the cell along its heading, look for a road (street cell) to
  62+ 2000              ;     the left and to the right.  Left is tested first: if there is a road,
  63+ 2000              ;     turn left at random (1 in 2); if not taken, the same for the right.
  64+ 2000              ;     The cell is then marked as decided, so it isn't tested again until the
  65+ 2000              ;     zombie has been somewhere else.
  66+ 2000              ;   * Blocked (building or map edge within zlook ahead): turn left if there
  67+ 2000              ;     is a road there, else right; otherwise turn round and stand still for
  68+ 2000              ;     ZWAIT frames before testing anything again.
  69+ 2000              ;   * Otherwise step forwards zspeed/16 world units (the remainder is kept,
  70+ 2000              ;     so slow speeds still move smoothly on average).
  71+ 2000              ;
  72+ 2000              ; Zombies are only ever on street (empty) cells.  They are drawn by the city
  73+ 2000              ; traversal when it reaches their cell (draw_cell jumps to zombie_cell for
  74+ 2000              ; empty cells), so the painter's algorithm hides them behind nearer buildings.
  75+ 2000              ; A cell holding zombies has bit 7 (CELL_ZOMBIE) of its city_map byte set,
  76+ 2000              ; by zflags every frame; zombie_cell then searches the records for them.
  77+ 2000              ;
  78+ 2000              ; Sprites (tables_zombie.inc, generated): 8 scales from 1x4 to 8x16 pixels,
  79+ 2000              ; forward and left facings, 4 walk frames.  Rear and right are the mirrored
  80+ 2000              ; forward and left.  One byte per row, bit 7 = leftmost pixel.
  81+ 2000              ;==============================================================================
  82+ 2000
  83+ 2000              NZOMB           equ 40          ; zombie records: the most in a wave
  84+ 2000              NSPEC           equ 8           ; most special monsters (5 ghosts, banshees)
  85+ 2000              NMON            equ NZOMB+NSPEC ; records: zombies, then special monsters
  86+ 2000              ZREC            equ 34          ; bytes per record
  87+ 2000              ZT_FAST         equ 1           ; +15: fast zombie
  88+ 2000              ZT_GHOUL        equ 2           ; +15: a ghoul: a special monster that walks
  89+ 2000                                              ; as a zombie (zmove), half height, 5x speed
  90+ 2000              ZT_LICH         equ 3           ; +15: a lich, a city's boss: a special
  91+ 2000                                              ; monster that walks as a zombie (zmove),
  92+ 2000                                              ; twice the height, 4x speed; it shoots
  93+ 2000                                              ; fireballs (lich_update, weapons.asm)
  94+ 2000              ZT_GHOST        equ 4           ; +15: a ghost (specials.asm); types from
  95+ 2000              ZT_BANSHEE      equ 5           ; here on fly (specials.asm moves them)
  96+ 2000              ZT_DEVIL        equ 6           ; +15: the final boss (devil.asm), drawn by
  97+ 2000                                              ; devil_draw (city2.asm)
  98+ 2000              ZHP             equ 5           ; hit points: a zombie (level 1)
  99+ 2000              ZHP_FAST        equ 4           ; and a fast zombie
 100+ 2000              GHOUL_HP        equ ZHP         ; and a ghoul

 113+ 2000                      ASSERT ZSPEED_INIT*5+15 < 256   ; a ghoul's step (zcalc_step) fits

   1+ 3098              ;==============================================================================
   2+ 3098              ; Z-POLICE - humans to rescue (in the zombie page, after zombie.asm: kept
   3+ 3098              ; mapped in slot 1)
   4+ 3098              ;
   5+ 3098              ; Up to HUMAN_MAX humans, nhumans of them placed at random at start-up (on a
   6+ 3098              ; road, or on a roof low enough to land on).  They stand facing the player,
   7+ 3098              ; and wave their right arm while the VTOL is within WAVE_R.  On the city map
   8+ 3098              ; each is a blue dot, flashing 3 frames on, 3 off.
   9+ 3098              ;
  10+ 3098              ; Fleeing (hum_flee): a human on the road (never one on a roof) with a
  11+ 3098              ; monster within FLEE_R runs from the nearest one for FLEE_TIME frames, at
  12+ 3098              ; HUMAN_FLEE units a frame, then looks again.  Its way is picked at random
  13+ 3098              ; of the two that take it away from the monster (along x or along z); if
  14+ 3098              ; that way is blocked (a building, the base, the wall) it takes the other,
  15+ 3098              ; and if both are, it stands.  It only runs along roads.
  16+ 3098              ;
  17+ 3098              ; Base: landed on the landing pad (map code PAD_CODE), the passengers get off
  18+ 3098              ; one every DISEMBARK frames (a second) and are counted as saved.
  19+ 3098              ;
  20+ 3098              ; Rescue: when the craft has landed (speed 0, resting on the road or on the
  21+ 3098              ; roof under it), carries fewer than PASSENGER_MAX and a human stands within
  22+ 3098              ; RESCUE_R at the same height (a roof of the same height, or the road), the
  23+ 3098              ; human runs to it at HUMAN_RUN units a frame and climbs in.  A human on a
  24+ 3098              ; taller or lower roof cannot be reached.
  25+ 3098              ;
  26+ 3098              ; Each human is an HREC-byte record:
  27+ 3098              ;   +0,+1  x  (world units: high byte = cell, as for zombies)
  28+ 3098              ;   +2,+3  z
  29+ 3098              ;   +4,+5  y  height of its feet (roof height, or 0 on the road)
  30+ 3098              ;   +6     state (HS_*): 0 unused, 1 waiting in the city, 2 aboard the
  31+ 3098              ;          VTOL, 3 rescued (off at the landing pad), 4 dead
  32+ 3098              ;   +7,+8  cell (x, z) of its map dot
  33+ 3098              ;   +9     1 = map dot shown
  34+ 3098              ;   +10    hit points left (HUMAN_HP; a rocket blast, weapons.asm)
  35+ 3098              ;   +11,+12  cell (x, z) marked with CELL_HUMAN in city_map ($FF = none)
  36+ 3098              ;   +13    how it's drawn this frame: 0 standing, HUM_WAVING waving, or
  37+ 3098              ;          running (to the VTOL, or fleeing): its way + 1 (1 +z, 2 +x,
  38+ 3098              ;          3 -z, 4 -x, as a zombie's heading + 1)
  39+ 3098              ;   +14    fleeing: frames left (0: not fleeing)
  40+ 3098              ;   +15    fleeing: its way + 1 (as +13)
  41+ 3098              ;
  42+ 3098              ; Drawing: draw_cell (city page) tests the cell's CELL_HUMAN mark in
  43+ 3098              ; city_map (bit 6, set by hum_flags) and draws them with human_cell: after
  44+ 3098              ; the building on whose roof they stand, so the roof doesn't cover them.  With
  45+ 3098              ; OCCLUSION_CULL the cell goes on the draw list instead (as its city_col
  46+ 3098              ; address, $6000-$6FFF) and is drawn from there.
  47+ 3098              ;==============================================================================
  48+ 3098
  49+ 3098              HREC            equ 16
  50+ 3098              HUM_WAVING      equ 5               ; +13: waving (above the 4 ways)
  51+ 3098              HS_NONE         equ 0               ; human states (+6)
  52+ 3098              HS_WAIT         equ 1               ; waiting in the city to be rescued
  53+ 3098              HS_ABOARD       equ 2               ; aboard the VTOL
  54+ 3098              HS_SAVED        equ 3               ; rescued: off at the landing pad
  55+ 3098              HS_DEAD         equ 4               ; killed (a rocket blast, a ghost)

   2+ 3757              ; Z-POLICE - city map (in the zombie page, after human.asm: kept mapped in
   3+ 3757              ; slot 1)
   4+ 3757              ;
   5+ 3757              ; Everything that draws the GRID x GRID city map at the right of the
   6+ 3757              ; instrument panel (pixel columns MAP_X.., rows 128-191, one pixel per cell,
   7+ 3757              ; north up):
   8+ 3757              ;   * map_init / map_l2: the map itself, drawn once at start-up into both
   9+ 3757              ;     Layer 2 buffers, and the ULA set-up over it (called from ula_init);
  10+ 3757              ;   * map_player: the player's flashing white dot, on the ULA (draw_hud);
  11+ 3757              ;   * zblip / zblip_off: zombie blips, bright green (zombie.asm, weapons.asm);
  12+ 3757              ;   * hum_dots / hum_dot: humans' flashing blue dots (human.asm);
  13+ 3757              ;   * map_pix / map_under: set one map cell's pixel in both Layer 2 buffers,
  14+ 3757              ;     and the colour the map itself has there.
  15+ 3757              ; Page 7 is always mapped, so all the pages above can call in here.
  16+ 3757              ;==============================================================================
  17+ 3757
  18+ 3757              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  19+ 3757              ; City map: GRID x GRID cells at one pixel each (64x64), north up, at pixel
  20+ 3757              ; columns MAP_X.. and rows 128-191.  It is drawn on Layer 2, into both
  21+ 3757              ; buffers once (the viewport clear only touches rows 0-127), so each
  22+ 3757              ; building can be its own colour; zombie blips and human dots are written
  23+ 3757              ; into it too.  The ULA above it is transparent paper with white ink for the
  24+ 3757              ; player's flashing dot.

# file opened: interrupts.asm
   1+ 3913              ;==============================================================================
   2+ 3913              ; Z-POLICE - interrupt mode 2 (in the zombie page, after map.asm: kept
   3+ 3913              ; mapped in slot 1, so the table and routine are there whatever page is
   4+ 3913              ; swapped in; the ROM replaces slot 1 only during esxDOS calls, when
   5+ 3913              ; interrupts are off)
   6+ 3913              ;
   7+ 3913              ; In IM 2 an interrupt calls the address held in the word at I*256 + the
   8+ 3913              ; byte on the data bus, which can be anything.  So:
   9+ 3913              ;   * im2_table is 256 words, every one the address of im2_routine, at a
  10+ 3913              ;     256-byte boundary (I holds the high byte of its address): any bus
  11+ 3913              ;     byte, even $FF (bytes $FF and $100), reads a word inside it;
  12+ 3913              ;   * an odd bus byte reads a word that straddles two entries, low byte
  13+ 3913              ;     from one and high byte from the next, so im2_routine sits at an
  14+ 3913              ;     address whose high and low bytes are the same (IM2_ROUTINE, $xyxy):
  15+ 3913              ;     read either way round, it's the same address.
  16+ 3913              ; im2_init sets I and IM 2 (start calls it after init_audio); start enables
  17+ 3913              ; interrupts just before the main menu, and they stay on, 50 a second, except:
  18+ 3913              ;   * over esxDOS calls (fh_rom_in / fh_rom_out): the ROM covers slot 1, this
  19+ 3913              ;     page, so they are off and put back as they were;
  20+ 3913              ;   * the span filler borrows SP (city.asm: PUSHes into Layer 2, slot 0).  An
  21+ 3913              ;     interrupt there pushes its return address just below SP: into the
  22+ 3913              ;     part of the span still to be filled, which the PUSHes then overwrite.
  23+ 3913              ;     Interrupts are off from just before a span's last PUSH until SP is
  24+ 3913              ;     back (push_blk), and a 1-pixel span doesn't borrow SP at all.
  25+ 3913              ; The routine switches to its own stack at once, keeps every register, and
  26+ 3913              ; touches the AY ports only while the engines are on (eng_on): code outside
  27+ 3913              ; the interrupt writes the AY chips only with eng_on 0 (init_audio,
  28+ 3913              ; engine_start).  Then it also borrows slot 7 for the sound page, and the
  29+ 3913              ; NextReg ports ($243B, $253B) to find what's there: both put back as they
  30+ 3913              ; were (the selected NextReg too).
  31+ 3913              ;==============================================================================
  32+ 3913
  33+ 3913              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  34+ 3913              ; Point I at the vector table and select interrupt mode 2.  (start enables
  35+ 3913              ; interrupts later.)

  54+ 3C3C              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  55+ 3C3C              ; The interrupt routine, each video frame (50 a second): a tick counted
  56+ 3C3C              ; (isr_ticks), and with the engines on (eng_on), the engines' sound
  57+ 3C3C              ; (engine_tick) and the sound effects (sfx_tick): in the audio page
  58+ 3C3C              ; (sound.asm), mapped into slot 7 meanwhile and the page there put back
  59+ 3C3C              ; after.  The page there is read through the NextReg ports, so the main
  60+ 3C3C              ; code's selected NextReg ($243B, which it may have set and not yet read
  61+ 3C3C              ; or written through $253B) is read first and put back last.  On its own stack: SP may
  62+ 3C3C              ; be the span filler's.  It must never use the alternate registers (EXX,
  63+ 3C3C              ; EX AF,AF'): the city's cell walks keep their place in HL', DE' across
  64+ 3C3C              ; the whole drawing (draw_row, city.asm).
  65+ 3C3C              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  66+ 3C3C              im2_routine:
  67+ 3C3C ED 73 98 3C          ld (isr_sp),sp                  ; its own stack at once (no PUSH on
  68+ 3C40 31 BC 3C             ld sp,isr_stack                 ; a borrowed one)
  69+ 3C43 F5                   push af
  70+ 3C44 C5                   push bc
  71+ 3C45 D5                   push de
  72+ 3C46 E5                   push hl
  73+ 3C47 2A 9A 3C             ld hl,(isr_ticks)               ; the frames counted (wave_prepare)
  74+ 3C4A 23                   inc hl
  75+ 3C4B 22 9A 3C             ld (isr_ticks),hl
  76+ 3C4E 3A 89 3C             ld a,(eng_on)                   ; nothing to play: the AYs alone
  77+ 3C51 B7                   or a
  78+ 3C52 28 2A                jr z,.out
  79+ 3C54 01 3B 24             ld bc,$243B                     ; the NextReg the main code has
  80+ 3C57 ED 78                in a,(c)                        ; selected (it may be between its OUT
  81+ 3C59 32 96 3C             ld (isr_sel),a                  ; and its IN): put back after
  82+ 3C5C 3E 57                ld a,CODE_MMU                   ; slot 7's page, to put back after
  83+ 3C5E ED 79                out (c),a
  84+ 3C60 04                   inc b
  85+ 3C61 ED 78                in a,(c)
  86+ 3C63 32 97 3C             ld (isr_mmu7),a
  87+ 3C66 ED 91 57 11          nextreg CODE_MMU,PAGE_AUDIO     ; the sound page (sound.asm)
  88+ 3C6A CD 6F E0             call engine_tick
  89+ 3C6D CD 21 E1             call sfx_tick
  90+ 3C70 3A 97 3C             ld a,(isr_mmu7)                 ; slot 7 as it was,
  91+ 3C73 ED 92 57             nextreg CODE_MMU,a
  92+ 3C76 01 3B 24             ld bc,$243B                     ; and the NextReg selection
  93+ 3C79 3A 96 3C             ld a,(isr_sel)
  94+ 3C7C ED 79                out (c),a
  95+ 3C7E E1           .out:   pop hl
  96+ 3C7F D1                   pop de
  97+ 3C80 C1                   pop bc
  98+ 3C81 F1                   pop af
  99+ 3C82 ED 7B 98 3C          ld sp,(isr_sp)

 101+ 3C87 ED 4D                reti

 105+ 3C89              ; (The engines' and the sound effects' players are in the audio page:
 106+ 3C89              ; sound.asm, mapped into slot 7 for them, im2_routine.)

 109+ 3C89 00           eng_on:     db 0                        ; 1: the engines run and sound
 110+ 3C8A                                                      ; effects play (engine_start); 0: the
 111+ 3C8A                                                      ; interrupt leaves the AYs alone

# file opened: sprite_data.asm
   1+ E000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ E000              ; Z-POLICE - sprite pattern banks (8K pages, assembled at $E000)
   3+ E000              ;
   4+ E000              ; Hardware sprite patterns are only needed when they are loaded into the
   5+ E000              ; sprite pattern memory, so they live in their own pages, out of the way,
   6+ E000              ; each with its own loader so that no resident memory is used:
   7+ E000              ;
   8+ E000              ;       nextreg CODE_MMU,PAGE_SPR0      ; the bank into slot 7
   9+ E000              ;       call spr_load_bank              ; copy its patterns
  10+ E000              ;
  11+ E000              ; Call it from outside slot 7 (resident code or a game logic page in slot
  12+ E000              ; 6), and page back whatever slot 7 had afterwards if it is still needed.
  13+ E000              ; spr_load_bank is the same address ($E000) in every bank.
  14+ E000              ;
  15+ E000              ; Each bank (SPRBANK_ADDR = $E000):
  16+ E000              ;   +0          spr_load_bank: the loader (SPRB_LOADER), the same in each
  17+ E000              ;   SPRB_COUNT  number of patterns (1..31: 256 bytes each, 8-bit 16x16)
  18+ E000              ;   SPRB_FIRST  the pattern number the first one loads to (0..63)
  19+ E000              ;   SPRB_DATA   the patterns, one after another
  20+ E000              ; More sprites: add a bank (the next free page, its own PAGE_SPRn in
  21+ E000              ; memory_bank_defs.asm, the MMU / ORG lines in zpolice.asm and a block here
  22+ E000              ; starting with SPRB_LOADER).
  23+ E000              ;==============================================================================
  24+ E000
  25+ E000              ; Copy this bank's patterns into the sprite pattern memory.  Runs from the
  26+ E000              ; bank itself: reads only, so it needs no variables.
  27+ E000                      MACRO SPRB_LOADER
  28+ E000 ~                    ld a,(SPRBANK_ADDR+SPRB_FIRST)  ; from this pattern
  29+ E000 ~                    ld bc,SPR_SLOT_PORT
  30+ E000 ~                    out (c),a
  31+ E000 ~                    ld a,(SPRBANK_ADDR+SPRB_COUNT)
  32+ E000 ~                    ld d,a
  33+ E000 ~                    ld hl,SPRBANK_ADDR+SPRB_DATA
  34+ E000 ~                    ld c,SPR_PAT_PORT
  35+ E000 ~            .lp:    ld b,0                          ; 256 bytes a pattern
  36+ E000 ~                    otir
  37+ E000 ~                    dec d
  38+ E000 ~                    jr nz,.lp
  39+ E000 ~                    ret
  40+ E000                      ENDM
  41+ E000
  42+ E000              spr_load_bank   equ SPRBANK_ADDR        ; the loader, in every bank
  43+ E000              SPRB_COUNT      equ spr_bank0_hdr-spr_bank0
  44+ E000              SPRB_FIRST      equ SPRB_COUNT+1
  45+ E000              SPRB_DATA       equ SPRB_COUNT+2
  46+ E000
  47+ E000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  48+ E000              ; Bank 0 (PAGE_SPR0): the human status sprites (patterns 0-3), then the
  49+ E000              ; compass bar's letters, dots and pointer (CSPR_*, hud_sprites.asm)
